Job title: Head of Medical Value & Organized Systems Engagement


  • Location: Remote

About the Job


The Head of Medical Value & Organized Systems Engagement leads Sanofi's medical engagement strategy across payer and health-system stakeholders, overseeing three field-facing teams: National Payer Account Directors, Regional Payer Account Directors, and Medical OHS Account Directors. This role is accountable for positioning Sanofi as a strategic medical partner to payers, PBMs, GPOs, and organized health systems — moving beyond product-focused discussions to help address system- and population-level healthcare challenges and advance care delivery and patient outcomes. This high-visibility role plays a key part in building the team's future-state capabilities and ways of working as part of Integrated Evidence & Patient Outcomes.


Join the engine of Sanofi’s mission — where deep immunoscience meets bold, AI-powered research. In R&D, you’ll drive breakthroughs that could turn the impossible into possible for millions.

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.


Main responsibilities:


  • Lead and develop the Medical Value & Organized Systems Engagement team — National Payer Account Directors, Regional Payer Account Directors, and Medical OHS Account Directors — ensuring a cohesive, compliant One Sanofi approach to payer and health-system engagement.
  • Engage with and direct scientific exchange with national payers, PBMs, and GPOs through the National Payer Account Director team to inform coverage and formulary decisions.
  • Direct engagement with regional and state plans through the Regional Payer Account Director team, tailoring clinical and value evidence to each plan's population.
  • Serve as the enterprise medical lead for assigned health systems through the Medical OHS Account Director team, bringing Sanofi evidence into care pathways, quality improvement, clinical decision support, and research partnerships spanning translational, pre-clinical, and clinical research, and driving care gap initiatives and quality measure alignment in partnership with Population Health.
  • Partner across the Integrated Evidence & Patient Outcomes pillars — Integrated Evidence, Real World Evidence, Population Health, and Data Foundation — so payer and health-system teams can act on real-world evidence, AI/ML-enabled insights, and data built for emerging tools like LLM-based scientific exchange.
  • Help guide real-world evidence, outcomes research, and clinical trial partnership priorities relevant to payer and health-system engagement, in partnership with the Real World Evidence and Medical Evidence teams.
  • Partner with commercial leadership to ensure medical and commercial strategy are fully integrated at the account level, while preserving medical independence and the medical/commercial firewall.
  • Collaborate with Market Access, HEVA, Population Health, TA Medical Units, and Medical Evidence teams to align field engagement and resources with medical and access priorities.
  • Capture and relay insights from payer and health-system stakeholders to inform internal medical, access, and R&D priorities.
  • Define and track impact measures and KPIs that demonstrate medical value to the business and to customers; provide performance oversight through monitoring, reporting, and field engagement.
  • Own field budgets for the Medical Value & Organized Systems Engagement team, ensuring strategic alignment with commercial account counterparts.
  • Ensure full compliance with all relevant policies, regulations, and governance processes across the team's activities.
  • Travel as required to support customers, external meetings, trainings, and other internal meetings (up to 50%).

About You


  • Advanced medical or scientific degree required (MD, PharmD, PhD, or equivalent).
  • 10+ years of related industry and clinical experience, including field medical, MVO, payer, or health-system engagement roles, with field team leadership experience required.
  • High degree of knowledge of relevant healthcare systems, the evolving medical landscape, regulatory and payer environment, and public health and industry trends.
  • Deep understanding of data analytics, real-world evidence, quality improvement, and clinical informatics.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to forge effective business partnerships and participate in multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Fluency in spoken and written business English.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Additional advanced degree in business, HEOR, health policy, or population health.
  • Prior experience in a health system, pharmacy, population health, managed care, or quality leadership role.
  • Experience with EHR-based clinical decision support, AI-driven care pathways, and other digital health and analytics technologies.
  • Proven track record of team leadership and people development.
  • Demonstrated change management experience, with a track record of building a team or function from present to future state.
  • Proven ability to utilize time and project management strategies to manage a complex environment and guide teams with varied skill levels.
  • Experience operating compliantly at the medical/commercial interface.

Why Choose Us

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.
  • Be part of a pioneering biopharma company that engages patients early in drug development and uses their insights to design studies that reflect real-world needs.
  • Help improve the lives of millions of people globally by making drug development quicker and more effective.
  • Work at the forefront of drug discovery, harnessing cutting-edge AI, data, and digital platforms to push the boundaries of science.

Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

raw.excerpt: About ReapReap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong with employees across multiple countries.
raw.description:
About Reap

Reap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong with employees across multiple countries. We enable financial connectivity and access for businesses worldwide by combining traditional finance with stablecoins for efficient money movement.

Through our stablecoin-powered corporate cards, payments, and expense management tools, we streamline financial operations and help businesses scale. Our APIs enable businesses to integrate stablecoin-enabled finance into their own products and services—from issuing Visa cards to facilitating cross-border payments.

Backed by leading investors including Acorn Pacific, Index Ventures and HashKey Capital, Reap is building the future of borderless, stablecoin-enabled finance.

Why Reap?

We are seeking a hands-on Subject Matter Expert in Transaction Monitoring to lead complex investigations while building the next generation of our monitoring capability. You will clear critical backlogs, tune and design detection logic, and establish SOPs that scale our program across card schemes and digital asset flows. This is a builder role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, and brings order to complexity.

What You’ll Do

1) Transaction Monitoring & Investigations (hands-on)

  • Lead investigations into high-risk and complex alerts spanning AML, fraud, and crypto-specific typologies.

  • Triage and clear existing backlogs for card scheme (Visa) and digital asset alerts within SLAs, documenting rationale and outcomes.

  • Prepare and file SARs/STRs with the JFIU and other authorities where required, maintaining robust audit trails.

  • Perform deep-dive forensic analysis across fiat and blockchain transaction webs, leveraging blockchain analytics where appropriate.

2) System Optimization & Rule Tuning

  • Serve as the primary operational stakeholder for the Transaction Monitoring vendor as we migrate to automated systems.

  • Analyze alert performance, reduce false positives, and propose rule-tuning changes in partnership with Product and Engineering.

  • Design, test, and promote new scenarios/typologies tailored to PSP and crypto-asset risks, with clear success metrics.

3) Process Governance & Procedure Creation

  • Draft, maintain, and own SOPs for the TM function, aligned with policies owned by FCC.

  • Translate regulatory and scheme requirements into actionable process steps and control points.

  • Define L1 vs. L2 escalation matrices, investigation standards, and QC checkpoints.

4) Mentorship & Leadership

  • Serve as subject matter expert for TM, mentoring peers and setting investigation quality standards.

  • Provide on-call guidance for complex cases, perform spot checks and QC reviews, and document best practices.

  • Lead knowledge-sharing sessions, write playbooks, and uplevel the team's capability through example and coaching.

What We’re Looking For

Must-haves

  • 8-12+ years focused on Transaction Monitoring.

  • Background in Fintech, Payments (card issuing and/or acquiring), or Web3/Crypto with a clear grasp of differences between fiat rails and blockchain flows.

  • Deep knowledge of Visa/Mastercard scheme monitoring obligations and relevant AML and fraud typologies.

  • Hands-on experience with modern TM and blockchain analytics tools (e.g., Unit21, Flagright, Chainalysis, Elliptic) and the ability to articulate rule logic.

  • Start-up mindset: willing to clear alerts while building strategy, comfortable operating in evolving environments.

Nice-to-haves

  • CAMS, CFE, or ICA International Diploma in AML.

  • Prior experience standing up a TM function or migrating from manual to automated monitoring.

  • Working proficiency in SQL and/or data visualization for rule performance analysis and experiment design.

Why You'll Love it Here

  • Flexible hybrid/remote work environment with a global, collaborative team.

  • Use of AI tools at work — and the space to learn, experiment, and grow with them.

  • A culture of innovation, inclusion, and continuous learning.

Founded in 1997, Victoria headquartered Charter has grown into one of Canada’s foremost fastest growing Information Technology providers in the country, providing a broad array of high value product and service solutions to clients operating some of the most mission critical networks and applications.

If you are looking to be an integral part of a vibrant, success-based environment with the core values of empowerment, flexibility, agility, innovation, high knowledge based, life balanced, and high ethics deeply embedded into the everyday culture then Charter is a place for you to look. We are a high energy business focused team, providing the highest possible customer experience, with best-in-class engineering support.

Overview

Charter is seeking a high-performing IT Recruiter with experience in staff augmentation to support our growing delivery team. In this role, you will partner closely with account managers, clients, and internal stakeholders to quickly identify and deliver top-tier IT talent for contract and project-based engagements.

You thrive in a fast-paced, client-driven environment and understand the urgency, quality, and relationship management required to succeed in staff augmentation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Account Managers and clients to understand technical requirements, timelines, and project expectations
  • Source, screen, and qualify IT professionals for contract and contract-to-hire opportunities
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of pre-qualified candidates across key skill areas (e.g., cloud, DevOps, cybersecurity, software development, data)

  • Conduct technical and behavioral screenings to ensure alignment with client needs and project scope
  • Prepare candidates for client interviews and manage the interview process end-to-end
  • Negotiate rates, terms, and onboarding logistics for contract placements
  • Maintain consistent communication with consultants during assignments to ensure engagement and retention
  • Track and manage candidate activity in ATS/CRM systems
  • Stay current on IT market trends, in-demand skills, and competitive talent landscapes

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in IT recruiting, preferably in a staff augmentation or agency environment
  • Strong understanding of IT roles, technologies, and project-based hiring needs
  • Experience working with demanding timelines and multiple open requirements
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills
  • Proficiency with sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, Boolean search) and ATS platforms

Charter is an equal-opportunity employer committed to inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection processes. Senior Revenue Operations Systems Analyst

Who we are:

We provide the world's engineers mission-critical intelligence, safeguarding the technology of today and enabling the breakthroughs of tomorrow. Accuris transforms the world's largest repository of standards and supply chain data into AI-driven insights and connected workflows - enabling engineers to work smarter, stay compliant, and innovate faster. Behind every world-changing innovation - there's Accuris - the most trusted intelligence platform for engineers.

The Impact:

As our Senior Revenue Operations Systems Analyst, you will treat our go-to-market tech stack like a product, not a maintenance job. You will own the infrastructure behind Salesforce and every system that touches it - Gong, HubSpot, LeanData, and Cloudingo - and make sure they work as one connected engine. Rather than waiting for a broken workflow to disrupt pipeline, you will be in the data finding what is slow, messy, or about to break, using AI and automation as first-class tools. Partnering with Sales, IT, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, you will turn business needs into scalable, intuitive systems and show the business what is possible when we invest in the right processes and bring data into our decisions.

Responsibilities:

  • GTM Systems Ownership: Own the GTM technology stack, ensuring Salesforce and adjacent systems (Gong, HubSpot, LeanData, Cloudingo) operate as one connected system - with clean data flows, healthy integrations, and a stack that scales with the business.
  • Proactive Analysis & Optimization: Use internal data to investigate gaps, uncover root causes, prioritize areas of greatest impact, and recommend paths forward to optimize GTM processes.
  • Requirements & Solution Delivery: Define requirements and partner with Salesforce developers on architecture, testing, and enablement plans for enhancements and projects. Lead cross-functional GTM systems projects end to end - from scoping and technical approach through stakeholder buy-in and a shipped outcome.
  • Automation: Build and manage automation workflows that reduce manual work, improve team efficiency, and support commissions, territory management, and data enrichment.
  • Data Integrity: Drive data quality across systems, workflows, and reporting through deduplication, standardization, and enforcement of data entry standards.
  • Change & Incident Management: Manage incident response with change management, monitoring and alerting automation, and documented processes so knowledge is never siloed.

What We're Looking For:

  • 3+ years of business experience, including deep experience in a go-to-market operations role (Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, or Revenue Operations) or a forward-deployed role setting up operational flows for GTM clients. A bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or equivalent is preferred.
  • Deep Salesforce administration experience - configuration, Flow building, data modeling, and reporting at minimum; Salesforce Administrator certification a plus.
  • Experience building and managing modern GTM systems and integrations such as HubSpot, Gong, Sales Navigator, Cloudingo, and LeanData.
  • Strong SQL or data analysis skills to investigate data quality issues and build reporting independently, plus experience with BI tools (Looker, Snowflake, Tableau, or similar) beyond native CRM reporting.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to drive priorities from ideation to execution and to prioritize based on business impact rather than inbound requests alone.
  • Curious and evidence-driven - you enjoy digging into quantitative and qualitative data to spot gaps, generate solutions, and back decisions with data.
  • Self-motivated, resourceful, and detail-oriented, able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and the willingness to support final decisions that go a different direction.

The Location:

US - Remote

Compensation/Benefits Information:

Accuris states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $110,000 to $130,000. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual's geographical location as well as experience and qualifications for the role. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan as well as comprehensive benefits. For more information on benefits, please reach out to the recruiter assigned to the role.

The Senior Epic Configuration Analyst will support Utilization Management (UM) and Long-Term Services and Support (LTSS) in the configuration, testing, and implementation of Epic solutions that enhance the provider experience. You will partner closely with clinical, operational, and technical stakeholders to deliver scalable digital healthcare capabilities. The ideal candidate combines hands-on configuration expertise with strong testing, validation, and cross-functional collaboration skills to ensure successful go-live readiness, operational stability, and long-term adoption.

What You'll Do:

  • Configure and maintain Epic workflows including UM letters, work queues, and routing rules.
  • Gather and translate business and clinical requirements into configuration specifications.
  • Facilitate design sessions to support compliant and user-focused workflows.
  • Analyze change requests and recommend scalable, standardized configuration solutions.
  • Maintain configuration documentation, testing evidence, and decision records.

TopDog Law is a nationally scaling personal injury firm that owns the client experience end to end, from marketing and intake through litigation. People come to TopDog Law at one of the hardest moments of their lives: injured, overwhelmed, and unsure of what comes next. Join Baines Simmons

Baines Simmons builds the competence behind aerospace and defense safety. For 25 years we have delivered expert, approachable training and consulting to civil and military aviation organisations worldwide: more than 750 organisations served, over 200,000 professionals trained, and 40 or more regulatory authorities advised.

We work as one with our clients, sharing serious know-how, rigor and expertise. Across every sector, and alongside global regulators, we help organisations continuously improve safety, airworthiness and compliance. We go beyond helping them comply with regulations; we empower them to excel in operational and safety performance.

We look for curiosity, passion, leadership and impact. Our people do not just advise on safety. They change how clients manage it. If you want your work to make a measurable difference to aviation safety, we would like to hear from you.

One organisation, four brands

Baines Simmons is one of four TrustFlight brands. TrustFlight is the Aerospace Safety Intelligence Platform, building the technology that helps aviation operate safely and stay compliant. Redline Assured Security delivers government-standard aviation security, and Kenyon International delivers crisis management and response. Each brand keeps its own name, heritage and team. Together we share one platform, one set of values and one purpose: closing the gaps between disconnected tools and providers, because those gaps are where risk accumulates. Working at Baines Simmons means your expertise connects to all four.

Why people stay

We believe people do their best work when they have the freedom to do their job without too many rules and barriers getting in the way. Our culture is built on empowerment and trust: we hire good people and expect them to make the right calls for the customer, company, and themselves. Transforming an industry means our people have to keep learning. We earn our clients' confidence by being honest and dependable with each other, and that includes caring about the important things in life outside of work.

Our offices in the UK, Canada, the US and Jersey are where teams meet to collaborate and plan. People who deliver earn more say in how their career develops, from the path they take to the flexibility they need.

If you want to make a real difference to safety, this is the place to be.

Why this role matters

As a Technical Editor, you will develop specialist expertise in technical documentation within the aviation industry while enjoying the flexibility of a fully remote working environment. You will play a key role in transforming complex technical and corporate information into professional, structured and user-friendly documentation, working closely with subject matter experts, colleagues and clients across our global business to ensure documentation meets the highest standards of quality, consistency and compliance.

This role will suit someone who enjoys taking ownership, learning quickly and working through complex or unfamiliar information without needing constant supervision, with a keen eye for detail. You should be comfortable asking good questions, using sound judgement and making steady progress even when source information is incomplete, priorities change or deadlines are tight.

We are looking for people who are naturally curious, patient and resilient: people who enjoy new challenges, are willing to step outside their comfort zone, and take pride in producing accurate, structured and professional documentation that supports safety, compliance and customer outcomes.

What you will do

  • Structure, format, edit and publish complex technical and corporate documentation using Microsoft Word alongside MadCap Flare and MadCap Central.

  • Create, maintain and update technical content based on information provided by subject matter experts and project stakeholders.

  • Transform complex, technical or incomplete source information into clear, professional and well-structured documentation.

  • Ensure documentation is accurate, consistent, compliant with company standards and delivered on schedule.

  • Manage and edit large documentation sets, typically ranging from 200 to 800 pages.

  • Collaborate with colleagues across multiple departments and geographic locations to gather information and validate content.

  • Liaise with other functional areas of the business to ensure technical content remains accurate and up to date.

  • Identify opportunities to improve documentation quality, efficiency, consistency and publishing processes.

  • Support the development and implementation of new documentation standards, workflows and best practices.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance both customer outcomes and internal productivity.

What success looks like

  • You are working confidently and independently in MadCap Flare and MadCap Central, having completed the structured onboarding and training programme.

  • You are delivering large documentation sets (typically 200 to 800 pages) that are accurate, consistent, compliant with company standards and on schedule, within allocated project hours.

  • You have contributed practical improvements to documentation quality, standards, workflows or publishing processes.

Training and progression

No previous experience with MadCap software is required. A structured onboarding and training programme will give you the knowledge, tools and support you need to succeed in the role.

This is a role where you will be supported but also trusted to take ownership. We will provide training, guidance and access to subject matter experts, while encouraging you to build confidence, use initiative and develop your judgement over time.

We are committed to supporting long-term development and creating genuine opportunities for progression within the team, in terms of both pay and responsibility. As you develop in the role, there may be opportunities to take on more complex documentation projects, contribute to process improvements, support new documentation standards, mentor others, and build deeper expertise in aviation technical documentation and publishing tools.

How we work with AI

TrustFlight is an AI-first organisation, and we provide AI training where it is appropriate for your role.

Where and how you will work

  • Working hours: Full-time, with a degree of flexibility to accommodate personal circumstances

  • Work pattern: Fully remote, from a home office that supports remote working and virtual meetings

How to apply

Click Apply and send us your CV and a short cover note on why this role and why Baines Simmons. We read every application and will contact candidates selected for interview.

TrustFlight is an equal opportunities employer. We are building a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives and skills, and we welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, nationality, gender, age, disability, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Requirements

What you will bring

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

  • A proactive approach to learning, with the confidence to work independently and ask questions when needed.

  • Experience creating, editing or maintaining professional technical documentation.

  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a focus on accuracy, consistency, formatting and presentation.

  • Strong editing, proofreading, formatting and document structuring skills.

  • Confidence working with large, detailed documents and managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to meet deadlines and work within allocated project hours.

  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to build productive relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • A home office environment that supports remote working and virtual meetings.

Nice to have

  • Experience using MadCap Flare, MadCap Central or similar technical authoring tools.

  • Adaptability and confidence using multiple systems (Jira, Zendesk, Word and other business applications).

  • Experience interpreting technical specifications, procedures or operational documentation.

  • Experience in technical writing, business analysis, engineering, software development, web development or related fields.

  • Familiarity with structured content, content management systems, XML, HTML or documentation publishing tools.

  • Experience working within highly regulated industries such as aviation, engineering, software, manufacturing technology, AI, safety, compliance or other complex technical environments.

raw.description:
Summary

The Professional Billing CDI Clinical Specialist is an advanced practice provider role responsible for optimizing documentation practices within provider workflows. This role engages directly with providers to identify barriers, refine workflows, enhance EHR tools, and support adoption of efficient documentation practices. The Clinical Specialist also partners with CDI, coding, physician advisors, informatics, analytics, and revenue cycle leaders to ensure that documentation expectations remain clinically relevant, operationally practical, and aligned with coding and reimbursement requirements.


Primary Responsibilities

Independent Clinical Assessment of Documentation:

  • Performs independent clinical evaluation of patient records to determine whether documentation accurately reflects diagnostic reasoning, treatment decisions, severity of illness, risk adjustment conditions, and medical necessity.
  • Applies advanced practice clinical judgment to identify missed diagnoses, evolving conditions, treatment implications, and documentation gaps not readily identifiable through coding review alone.
  • Serves as the clinical authority for complex documentation scenarios requiring provider-level interpretation of patient care.

Provider-to-Provider Clinical Consultation:

  • Provides peer-level consultation to physicians and APPs regarding clinical documentation, diagnostic specificity, medical necessity, and documentation supporting professional billing services.
  • Facilitates provider-to-provider discussions regarding clinical rationale and documentation practices in complex or disputed cases.

Documentation Impact on Clinical Care Delivery:

  • Evaluates how documentation workflows impact patient care delivery, care coordination, treatment planning, and clinical decision-making.
  • Recommends and validates documentation workflow changes based on direct clinical practice expertise and current standards of care.

Clinical Governance and Policy Authority:

  • Serves as a clinical representative on documentation governance committees.
  • Reviews and approves clinical documentation standards, educational content, and workflow recommendations requiring advanced clinical expertise.
  • Advises CDI leadership, physician advisors, and operational leaders regarding clinical implications of documentation policies

Advanced Medical Necessity and Denial Prevention:

  • Performs advanced review of chronic condition documentation and risk adjustment accuracy utilizing provider-level clinical assessment.
  • Validates clinical appropriateness of HCC capture opportunities and diagnostic specificity recommendations.

Population Health / Risk Adjustment Expertise:

  • Conducts clinical validation reviews requiring advanced provider-level assessment of diagnoses, treatment plans, and medical necessity.
  • Partners with physician advisors and providers to address complex clinical denials and documentation disputes.
  • Provides clinical support for appeals involving determination of diagnosis validity, treatment appropriateness, and documentation integrity.

Provider Engagement & Workflow Integration:

  • Conduct provider-to-provider assessment of clinical workflow barriers impacting documentation integrity, medical necessity capture, and diagnostic specificity.
  • Serve as an APP liaison to physicians and APPs to evaluate workflow changes through the lens of direct patient care delivery.

EHR Optimization & Documentation Tools:

  • Provide clinical approval and validation of provider documentation tools, templates, prompts, and workflow designs to ensure alignment with clinical practice standards and provider workflow realities
  • Partner with IT, informatics, and operational teams to implement solutions that improve efficiency while supporting accurate capture of patient acuity, medical decision making, and work effort.
  • Evaluate effectiveness of documentation tools and recommend enhancements based on provider feedback and data.

CDI Strategy & Interdisciplinary Collaboration:

  • Serve as the clinical workflow expert within the CDI team and serves as the designated APP clinical subject matter expert for enterprise documentation initiatives requiring provider-level clinical assessment, medical necessity expertise, and clinical practice interpretation
  • Collaborate with physician advisors, reimbursement leaders, analysts, and operational stakeholders to align documentation improvement with clinical realities and financial goals.
  • Support targeted educational initiatives and workflow change management across service lines or departments.

Knowledge – Skills – Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of clinical workflows, provider documentation practices, pathophysiology, and medical decision making principles.
  • Understanding of professional billing documentation requirements and the impact of workflow design on documentation quality and coding outcomes.
  • Ability to translate coding and regulatory requirements into practical clinical workflow solutions.
  • Strong interpersonal, facilitation, and change-management skills.
  • Ability to educate both providers and non-clinical stakeholders on clinical concepts and documentation practices.
  • Proficiency in EHR systems (EPIC preferred) and Microsoft Office tools.

Qualifications

Appropriate experience may be substituted on equivalent basis.

Minimum Required Education: Master's or Doctoral degree in nursing or other applicable advanced practice discipline

Minimum Required Experience: 5 years of Recent clinical practice experience required.

Preferred Experience: Experience working in ambulatory, professional billing, or provider-facing documentation environments preferred. Experience with EHR optimization, workflow redesign, education, or clinical informatics strongly preferred.

Required Certification/Licensure(s): Active Advanced Practice Provider license/certification consistent with organizational requirements (for example, Nurse Practitioner/APNP; other APP credentials may be considered if aligned with the role design).

Preferred Certification/Licensure(s): Knowledge of CDI, coding, informatics, or documentation improvement principles; coding/CDI certification is a plus.



Physical Requirements

Work requires occasionally lifting moderate weight materials, standing, or walking continuously.


Work Environment

Occasional exposure to dust, noise, temperature changes, or contact with water or other liquids. Work is performed in an environmentally controlled environment.


Sensory Acuity

Ability to detect and translate speech or other communication required. May occasionally require the ability to distinguish colors and perceive relative distances between objects.

raw.description:
We are seeking a Laboratory Informatics Consultant with hands-on experience implementing and supporting enterprise LIMS platforms such as Sapio or similar systems. This role is focused on delivering sample‑centric LIMS solutions, supporting the full sample lifecycle in regulated laboratory environments. Consultants in this role are expected to be able to operate independently on medium-complexity projects as well as collaborating with a global support team on larger projects.

As a consultant on our team, you will work with pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO, and regulated laboratory environments to design, configure, and deploy informatics solutions that improve data integrity, compliance, and operational efficiency. The ideal candidate understands how laboratories operate day to day and can design LIMS solutions that support compliant, efficient, and traceable laboratory workflows, while also configuring supporting entities such as instruments and inventory as needed.

Requirements

  • Lead or support requirements gathering with laboratory stakeholders, emphasizing end‑to‑end sample lifecycle management
  • Analyze laboratory processes related to sample receipt, testing, review, approval, and disposition
  • Translate business and regulatory requirements into LIMS functional designs and configuration specifications
  • Configure LIMS solutions ( Sapio) independently or as part of a national or global team to support:
    • Sample login, accessioning, and chain of custody
    • Test assignment, execution, calculations, and result entry
    • Specifications, limits, and result evaluation
    • Review, approval, release, and reporting workflows
  • Configure supporting LIMS entities required for sample workflows, including tests, methods, materials, products, and locations
  • Configure instrument and inventory data as required to support compliant sample testing
  • Develop and execute system testing and validation deliverables (IQ/OQ/PQ, test scripts, traceability matrices)
  • Support user acceptance testing and defect resolution
  • Assist with production deployment and go‑live activities
  • Provide post‑implementation support focused on sample processing, results management, and workflow execution
  • Troubleshoot issues impacting sample lifecycle workflows and data integrity
  • Deliver end‑user training and documentation
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, compliance, and usability within the LIMS

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience working with laboratory informatics systems Sapio.
  • Strong experience implementing and supporting sample lifecycle management in LIMS
  • Solid understanding of laboratory workflows (QC, analytical, stability, manufacturing, or R\&D)
  • Experience working in regulated environments (GxP, FDA, ISO; ALCOA+ principles)
  • Strong communication skills and experience working directly with laboratory and QA stakeholders
  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, technical, or related field

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on laboratory experience or a background in chemistry or biology
  • Experience with complex sample models (e.g., stability programs, high‑volume QC, or multi‑site labs)
  • System validation and CSV documentation experience
  • Exposure to LIMS integrations or configuration scripting
  • Consulting or client‑facing experience
  • Experience supporting instrument or inventory data in the context of sample workflows, rather than asset‑centric implementations
  • Experience working across multiple informatics systems (e.g., LIMS, ELN, CDS, SDMS)

Benefits

CURIOSITY DRIVEN, SCIENCE FOCUSED, EMPLOYEE BUILT. Our culture is unlike any other, one where we debate, challenge ourselves, and interact with all alike. We are a curious bunch, characterized by our passion to learn and spirit of teamwork. Zifo is a global R&D solutions provider focused on the industries of Pharma, Biotech, Manufacturing QC, Medical Devices, specialty chemicals and other research-based organizations. Our team’s knowledge of science and expertise in technology help Zifo better serve our customers around the globe, including 18 of the Top 20 Biopharma companies.

We look for Science – Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Technology, Biomedical Engineering, Microbiology etc. We possess scientific and technical knowledge and bear professional and personal goals. While we have a “no doors” policy to promote free access within, we do have a tough door to walk in. We search with a two-point agenda – technical competency and cultural adaptability.

We offer a competitive compensation package including accrued vacation, medical, dental, vision, 401k with company matching, life insurance, and flexible spending accounts.

If you share these sentiments and are prepared for the atypical, then Zifo is your calling!

Zifo is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

raw.description:
Performance & Growth Marketer – eCommerce & DTC

This isn't a traditional media buying role.

We're looking for a performance marketer who understands that profitable growth goes far beyond ROAS.

You'll work with established DTC, eCommerce, Shopify and consumer brands, connecting paid media performance to the numbers that actually matter to the business: CAC, LTV, MER, contribution margin, payback, forecasting, attribution and profitability.

You'll have real ownership over performance, testing, budget allocation and growth decisions, while working closely with experienced strategists and senior stakeholders.

What You'll Do

  • Own and optimize paid acquisition across Meta, Google and TikTok

  • Develop and execute testing strategies across media, creative, audiences, offers and funnels

  • Manage and allocate meaningful paid media budgets based on performance and commercial objectives

  • Diagnose performance issues and identify opportunities for profitable growth

  • Analyze CAC, LTV, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, payback and other commercial metrics

  • Connect channel performance to broader business and P&L outcomes

  • Develop forecasts, performance models and budget recommendations

  • Contribute to attribution, incrementality and measurement initiatives

  • Partner with creative, CRO and broader growth functions to improve full-funnel performance

  • Turn complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations for founders and senior stakeholders

  • Continuously test, learn and improve using structured growth frameworks

What You'll Bring

  • 3+ years of hands-on paid media experience specifically with product-based DTC/eCommerce brands

  • Strong hands-on experience across Meta, Google and TikTok Ads

  • Experience personally managing and scaling meaningful paid media budgets

  • In-house/brand-side DTC or eCommerce experience is strongly preferred

  • Strong understanding of the eCommerce customer journey, from acquisition through conversion and retention

  • Commercial understanding of CAC, LTV, MER, contribution margin, payback and profitability

  • Ability to look beyond platform metrics and understand the impact of paid media on the overall business

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to translate data into clear strategic and commercial recommendations

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills

  • Comfortable working directly with founders, senior leaders and clients

  • Highly organized, proactive and comfortable taking ownership

  • Able to work full-time and exclusively

  • Able to consistently work the required 4:00–6:00 PM Melbourne-time overlap

What Makes This Different

You'll be joining a team that treats performance marketing as a commercial growth function, not just a media buying function.

You'll get exposure to:

  • 8- and 9-figure eCommerce and DTC brands

  • Paid media, commercial strategy and financial planning

  • Weekly live strategy sessions with experienced growth leaders

  • A structured 6-week onboarding and development program

  • Proprietary P&L-integrated reporting and growth tools

  • Structured experimentation and testing frameworks

  • Career progression based on impact and capability, not tenure

  • A fully remote, APAC-friendly working environment

  • Opportunities to develop into a broader growth and strategy role

Growth Path

Performance Marketer → Growth Performance Marketer → Senior Performance Marketer → Growth Strategist

Your level will depend on your experience, capability and demonstrated commercial impact.

We're particularly interested in marketers who have owned growth for real DTC/eCommerce brands, understand the numbers behind the business, and want to move beyond simply optimizing campaigns.

If you know how to turn paid media into profitable business growth, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply with examples of the DTC/eCommerce brands you've worked with, the channels you've managed, and the scale of budgets you've personally owned.

We are seeking a Laboratory Informatics Consultant with hands-on experience implementing and supporting enterprise LIMS platforms such as Sapio or similar systems. This role is focused on delivering sample‑centric LIMS solutions, supporting the full sample lifecycle in regulated laboratory environments. Consultants in this role are expected to be able to operate independently on medium-complexity projects as well as collaborating with a global support team on larger projects.

As a consultant on our team, you will work with pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO, and regulated laboratory environments to design, configure, and deploy informatics solutions that improve data integrity, compliance, and operational efficiency. The ideal candidate understands how laboratories operate day to day and can design LIMS solutions that support compliant, efficient, and traceable laboratory workflows, while also configuring supporting entities such as instruments and inventory as needed.

Requirements

  • Lead or support requirements gathering with laboratory stakeholders, emphasizing end‑to‑end sample lifecycle management
  • Analyze laboratory processes related to sample receipt, testing, review, approval, and disposition
  • Translate business and regulatory requirements into LIMS functional designs and configuration specifications
  • Configure LIMS solutions ( Sapio) independently or as part of a national or global team to support:
    • Sample login, accessioning, and chain of custody
    • Test assignment, execution, calculations, and result entry
    • Specifications, limits, and result evaluation
    • Review, approval, release, and reporting workflows
  • Configure supporting LIMS entities required for sample workflows, including tests, methods, materials, products, and locations
  • Configure instrument and inventory data as required to support compliant sample testing
  • Develop and execute system testing and validation deliverables (IQ/OQ/PQ, test scripts, traceability matrices)
  • Support user acceptance testing and defect resolution
  • Assist with production deployment and go‑live activities
  • Provide post‑implementation support focused on sample processing, results management, and workflow execution
  • Troubleshoot issues impacting sample lifecycle workflows and data integrity
  • Deliver end‑user training and documentation
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, compliance, and usability within the LIMS

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience working with laboratory informatics systems Sapio.
  • Strong experience implementing and supporting sample lifecycle management in LIMS
  • Solid understanding of laboratory workflows (QC, analytical, stability, manufacturing, or R\&D)
  • Experience working in regulated environments (GxP, FDA, ISO; ALCOA+ principles)
  • Strong communication skills and experience working directly with laboratory and QA stakeholders
  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, technical, or related field

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on laboratory experience or a background in chemistry or biology
  • Experience with complex sample models (e.g., stability programs, high‑volume QC, or multi‑site labs)
  • System validation and CSV documentation experience
  • Exposure to LIMS integrations or configuration scripting
  • Consulting or client‑facing experience
  • Experience supporting instrument or inventory data in the context of sample workflows, rather than asset‑centric implementations
  • Experience working across multiple informatics systems (e.g., LIMS, ELN, CDS, SDMS)

Benefits

CURIOSITY DRIVEN, SCIENCE FOCUSED, EMPLOYEE BUILT. Our culture is unlike any other, one where we debate, challenge ourselves, and interact with all alike. We are a curious bunch, characterized by our passion to learn and spirit of teamwork. Zifo is a global R&D solutions provider focused on the industries of Pharma, Biotech, Manufacturing QC, Medical Devices, specialty chemicals and other research-based organizations. Our team’s knowledge of science and expertise in technology help Zifo better serve our customers around the globe, including 18 of the Top 20 Biopharma companies.

We look for Science – Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Technology, Biomedical Engineering, Microbiology etc. We possess scientific and technical knowledge and bear professional and personal goals. While we have a “no doors” policy to promote free access within, we do have a tough door to walk in. We search with a two-point agenda – technical competency and cultural adaptability.

We offer a competitive compensation package including accrued vacation, medical, dental, vision, 401k with company matching, life insurance, and flexible spending accounts.

If you share these sentiments and are prepared for the atypical, then Zifo is your calling!

Zifo is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Performance & Growth Marketer – eCommerce & DTC

This isn't a traditional media buying role.

We're looking for a performance marketer who understands that profitable growth goes far beyond ROAS.

You'll work with established DTC, eCommerce, Shopify and consumer brands, connecting paid media performance to the numbers that actually matter to the business: CAC, LTV, MER, contribution margin, payback, forecasting, attribution and profitability.

You'll have real ownership over performance, testing, budget allocation and growth decisions, while working closely with experienced strategists and senior stakeholders.

What You'll Do

  • Own and optimize paid acquisition across Meta, Google and TikTok

  • Develop and execute testing strategies across media, creative, audiences, offers and funnels

  • Manage and allocate meaningful paid media budgets based on performance and commercial objectives

  • Diagnose performance issues and identify opportunities for profitable growth

  • Analyze CAC, LTV, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, payback and other commercial metrics

  • Connect channel performance to broader business and P&L outcomes

  • Develop forecasts, performance models and budget recommendations

  • Contribute to attribution, incrementality and measurement initiatives

  • Partner with creative, CRO and broader growth functions to improve full-funnel performance

  • Turn complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations for founders and senior stakeholders

  • Continuously test, learn and improve using structured growth frameworks

What You'll Bring

  • 3+ years of hands-on paid media experience specifically with product-based DTC/eCommerce brands

  • Strong hands-on experience across Meta, Google and TikTok Ads

  • Experience personally managing and scaling meaningful paid media budgets

  • In-house/brand-side DTC or eCommerce experience is strongly preferred

  • Strong understanding of the eCommerce customer journey, from acquisition through conversion and retention

  • Commercial understanding of CAC, LTV, MER, contribution margin, payback and profitability

  • Ability to look beyond platform metrics and understand the impact of paid media on the overall business

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to translate data into clear strategic and commercial recommendations

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills

  • Comfortable working directly with founders, senior leaders and clients

  • Highly organized, proactive and comfortable taking ownership

  • Able to work full-time and exclusively

  • Able to consistently work the required 4:00–6:00 PM Melbourne-time overlap

What Makes This Different

You'll be joining a team that treats performance marketing as a commercial growth function, not just a media buying function.

You'll get exposure to:

  • 8- and 9-figure eCommerce and DTC brands

  • Paid media, commercial strategy and financial planning

  • Weekly live strategy sessions with experienced growth leaders

  • Proprietary P&L-integrated reporting and growth tools

  • Career progression based on impact and capability, not tenure

Growth Path

Performance Marketer → Growth Performance Marketer → Senior Performance Marketer → Growth Strategist

Your level will depend on your experience, capability and demonstrated commercial impact.

We're particularly interested in marketers who have owned growth for real DTC/eCommerce brands, understand the numbers behind the business, and want to move beyond simply optimizing campaigns.

If you know how to turn paid media into profitable business growth, we'd love to hear from you.

raw.description:
Freelance Writer

How do we make decisions? argue? persuade? research? evaluate? Basically, how do we think? This course will pull together insights across disciplines to explore all the ways we can think about thinking and apply it in our lives. If you’re an experienced writer, researcher, and thinker who can explain complex topics in clear and creative ways, we’d love to hear from you!

Crash Course, owned by Complexly, is an award-winning YouTube channel that invites students, teachers, and lifelong learners to tackle subjects they might have had trouble with or are curious to learn more about. Our videos take traditional classroom concepts and combine them with engaging and insightful narratives to help people learn and understand.

More details on the position:

Job Title: Writer

Status: Freelance

Reports to: Script Editor

Location: Remote, US-Based

Term: Beginning January 2027

Pay: $800 per script

What you'll do:

Write approximately 10 scripts, each ~1800-2000 words for our Crash Course How to Think series. These scripts will be based on episode outlines created by the Complexly editorial team, but writers are expected to provide additional research, insights, and ideas to create accurate and engaging scripts.

We’re looking for a deep thinker who can take an interdisciplinary approach, pulling from the sciences and humanities to help us guide viewers to reflect and deepen their understanding of how to ask questions, build knowledge, evaluate and share information, and make decisions. We’re particularly interested in candidates with experience “thinking about thinking.” Fields that come to mind include philosophy, education, psychology, or communication.

About Complexly:

Complexly is a media company that produces shows like Crash Course, SciShow, Eons, Ask Hank Anything, Bizarre Beasts, Study Hall, and more. We were founded by John and Hank Green with a mission of creating trustworthy stuff and lowering barriers to knowledge building. The world is not simple. And that can seem like a burden sometimes. The reality is, the human species will never fully understand itself or its universe, let alone any individual. But instead of seeing that as a failing, we'd like to suggest that the process is as powerful as the outcome.

Complexly was a company privately owned by Hank and John Green. As of 2026, they have donated the company to the public as a new nonprofit 501c3 organization, which will help Complexly fulfill its mission for decades to come. Becoming a nonprofit means we will be able to lean into public support, supercharging our mission to make content the world needs, not what is optimized for advertisers.

To learn more about Complexly, visit our website:

Complexly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe in, and are dedicated to, the principles of equal opportunity in any term, condition or privilege of employment. We do not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender including gender identity or expression, ancestry, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, military/veteran status, citizenship, arrest and court record, genetic information, credit history, or any other status protected by federal, state or local law.

raw.description:
Releaf is the UK's leading medical cannabis clinic. With over 170 staff, we connect patients with specialist clinicians, streamline access to prescriptions, and support thousands of people across the UK. We're on a mission to rethink healthcare - making specialist medical care more accessible, more human, and more effective.

The role

You'll report into our Head of Performance Marketing and sit within the performance team, working closely with our Paid Search and Paid Social Specialists. This is a hands-on design role split across two areas:

UX for paid media landing pages. You'll have full accountability for the design of our paid media landing pages: the experience someone has the moment they click an ad. User flows, wireframes, final designs, testing and iteration are all yours, and so is making them convert.

Design for paid channels. You'll create the static and video creative that runs across our paid media, predominantly Meta ads, with other channels likely to follow as we grow.

Owning both ends of the journey means you control the message from first impression to conversion. The best person for this job understands that a great ad isn't just one that looks good. It stops the scroll, earns the click, and lands on a page that converts. You'll be doing it in a category where advertising is tightly regulated, so accuracy and compliance matter as much as performance.

Main responsibilities

Paid media landing pages

  • Own the UX and design of our paid media landing pages end to end, from user flows, wireframes and prototypes through to final designs and QA on the live page
  • Design mobile-first, fast, accessible pages with a clear path from first click through to booking a consultation
  • Plan and run a continuous landing page testing roadmap with the performance team: layouts, messaging, forms, page structure and offers
  • Use GA4, heatmaps and session recordings to understand how people actually use our pages and where they drop off, and turn that into the next iteration
  • Build and maintain a landing page design system and component library, so new pages and variants can go live quickly
  • Work with our developers and partners to get pages built accurately, and own the quality of what goes live

Paid channel creative

  • Produce static and video creative for Meta, built to perform and iterate on quickly: hooks, formats, angles, static vs video
  • Work closely with our Paid Social Specialist on the creative testing roadmap, turning briefs and performance data into the next round of creative
  • Edit and produce short-form video, from UGC assembly through to fully motion-designed pieces, with sound and subtitling for social
  • Adapt and extend creative for other paid channels as we grow, such as display, YouTube, TikTok or digital out-of-home

Across both

  • Make sure the message matches from ad to landing page, so the journey feels like one joined-up experience
  • Work within the advertising regulations specific to our sector, making sure every ad and page is compliant before it goes live, and working with our compliance team on reviews and amends
  • Build and maintain templates and brand assets so the team can move faster
  • Keep output consistent with brand guidelines while adapting to the demands of each channel
  • Stay current on platform formats, UX best practice and what's actually working

What we're looking for

Essential

  • At least 3 years' professional design experience (ideally 5), covering both UX or web design and paid or performance creative
  • A portfolio that shows both: landing pages or web journeys you've owned (with results if you have them), and paid social creative that ran
  • Solid UX fundamentals: user flows, wireframing, prototyping, information hierarchy, and mobile-first, accessible design
  • Hands-on experience testing and optimising landing pages and ad creative, and an instinct for performance: you understand why a hook or a page works, not just how to execute one
  • Strong static and motion craft: typography, layout, hierarchy, motion graphics and short-form editing
  • A scientific approach to performance data, where the data informs your next design decision, not just your weekly report
  • High output: you produce volume and iterate without losing quality
  • Comfortable juggling briefs from several stakeholders and pushing back when a brief isn't clear enough
  • Proficient in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) plus After Effects or Premiere

Desirable

  • Experience in a highly regulated industry, including designing within advertising compliance rules. It's not essential, but it's a big advantage, and healthcare experience specifically would be a huge benefit
  • Comfortable with GA4 and CRO tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity or VWO
  • Able to build or edit pages yourself, whether in HTML/CSS or tools like Webflow, Framer or AI site builders
  • Familiarity with AI creative tools
  • Experience designing for display, YouTube, TikTok or digital out-of-home

We're open on background. If your portfolio shows pages that convert and ads that perform, we want to hear from you.

raw.description:
The Director, Supply Chain Planning leads the development and continuous improvement of enterprise supply chain planning across Builders FirstSource, with responsibility for demand planning, supply planning, inventory planning, replenishment, Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) and Integrated Business Planning (IBP). The role applies established supply chain planning principles and practices to improve customer service, inventory productivity, operational performance, and business decision-making. The Director partners across Sales, Operations, Procurement, Finance, Logistics, Data, and Technology to translate business strategy, customer demand, and operational realities into coordinated, executable plans. The role provides leadership for planning standards, governance, performance management, and organizational capability across a large, distributed operating environment. This is a business and supply chain leadership role enabled by data and technology. The Director owns the business planning processes, requirements, and outcomes while partnering with Technology and Data teams to ensure SAP IBP, SAP S/4HANA, analytics, and other planning capabilities effectively support the company’s evolving planning model. What You’ll Do Lead Enterprise Supply Chain Planning

Lead enterprise planning across demand, supply, inventory, replenishment, and MRP, establishing clear processes, governance, standards, and accountability. Translate business strategy, customer demand, and operational constraints into coordinated, executable supply chain plans. Establish planning practices that balance enterprise consistency with legitimate differences across products, markets, and operating models.

Lead S&OP / Integrated Business Planning

Lead and mature the S&OP / Integrated Business Planning process, connecting demand, supply, inventory, operational, and financial perspectives. Establish effective planning reviews that surface gaps, risks, opportunities, scenarios, and trade-offs requiring business decisions. Partner with Finance and business leaders to align operational plans with business objectives and drive clear ownership of resulting decisions and actions.

Advance Demand & Supply Planning

Strengthen demand planning, forecasting, supply planning, and replenishment practices across the enterprise. Improve forecast quality through appropriate statistical, collaborative, segmentation, and exception-based planning methods. Proactively identify supply constraints, capacity considerations, inventory risks, and planning exceptions requiring cross-functional intervention.

Govern Inventory, Replenishment & MRP

Establish inventory and replenishment strategies that balance product availability, customer service, working capital, and operational requirements. Provide business leadership for MRP, replenishment methods, safety stock, service levels, lead times, lot sizing, reorder points, and other critical planning parameters. Establish governance for planning policies, parameters, and master data that materially influence inventory and replenishment outcomes.

Drive Planning Performance & Continuous Improvement

Establish meaningful measures of planning effectiveness and business outcomes, including forecast performance, service, inventory productivity, and replenishment effectiveness. Use analytics, exception management, and root-cause analysis to identify systemic performance gaps and improvement opportunities. Drive continuous improvement across planning processes, policies, data, organizational capabilities, and ways of working.

Build Organizational Capability & Partnership

Lead and develop the Supply Chain Planning organization, strengthening capability, accountability, succession, and professional development. Build strong partnerships across Sales, Operations, Procurement, Finance, Logistics, Data, and Technology to improve end-to-end planning and decision-making. Strengthen planning knowledge and adoption across the broader organization while clarifying roles, decision rights, and accountability.

Enable Planning Through Data & Technology

Define business requirements and priorities for the data, analytics, and technology capabilities that enable Supply Chain Planning. Partner with Technology and Data teams to ensure SAP IBP, SAP S/4HANA, analytics, automation, and other planning capabilities effectively support business processes and decisions. Ensure planning technology investments are driven by business requirements, measurable outcomes, and sustainable ways of working.

What Success Looks Like

Trusted Plans: Business leaders rely on demand, supply, inventory, and replenishment plans to make informed decisions and manage the business. Better Decisions: Risks, constraints, opportunities, scenarios, and trade-offs are surfaced early enough to enable proactive, fact-based decisions. Productive Inventory: Planning policies and practices appropriately balance product availability, customer service, operational requirements, and inventory investment. Integrated Planning: Sales, Operations, Procurement, Finance, Logistics, and Supply Chain operate through connected S&OP / IBP processes with clear assumptions, decisions, ownership, and accountability. Sustainable Capability: Planning performance, talent, processes, data, and enabling technology continuously mature and deliver measurable business value.

In Your First Year

You will have the opportunity to:

Define the future-state Supply Chain Planning operating model and prioritized roadmap across demand, supply, inventory, replenishment, MRP, and S&OP / IBP. Establish the enterprise planning cadence and governance model, creating clearer decision rights, accountability, and cross-functional planning forums. Advance demand, supply, inventory, and MRP maturity, prioritizing the planning practices, policies, and improvements with the greatest business impact. Establish a planning performance framework that connects forecast quality, service, inventory productivity, and planning effectiveness to business outcomes. Build organizational planning capability, developing the Supply Chain Planning team while strengthening planning disciplines and adoption across the broader organization. Shape how data, analytics, SAP IBP, and related capabilities enable the planning operating model, ensuring technology investments follow business process and decision requirements.

Required Qualifications Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. 10+ years of progressive supply chain experience, including significant experience in Supply Chain Planning and related disciplines such as demand planning, supply planning, inventory management, replenishment, MRP, and S&OP / Integrated Business Planning. Demonstrated experience leading and developing supply chain planning teams within a complex, multi-location organization. Deep practical knowledge of supply chain planning principles, forecasting, inventory management, replenishment, MRP, and planning performance management. Demonstrated experience leading or materially contributing to S&OP / Integrated Business Planning processes that connect commercial, operational, supply chain, and financial perspectives. Strong business and analytical acumen with the ability to translate complex planning information into business implications, trade-offs, recommendations, and decisions. Demonstrated ability to influence leaders and drive alignment across multiple functions and organizational levels. Experience leading significant planning process, organizational, or operating-model change.

Preferred Qualifications

ASCM/APICS certification, particularly Certified in Planning and Inventory Management (CPIM) and/or Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP). Advanced degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or a related discipline. Experience leading Supply Chain Planning within a large, complex, multi-location or decentralized operating environment. Experience maturing S&OP / Integrated Business Planning processes across multiple functions and organizational levels. Experience advancing inventory segmentation, replenishment strategies, MRP practices, safety-stock policies, and planning parameter governance. Experience leading a significant Supply Chain Planning transformation involving process, organization, data, analytics, and ways of working. Experience within building products, distribution, manufacturing, retail, or another complex, inventory-intensive industry. Experience with SAP IBP, SAP S/4HANA, or comparable enterprise planning and ERP platforms.

Leadership Competencies & Responsibilities

Enterprise & Strategic Leadership: Connects Supply Chain Planning priorities to broader customer, operational, financial, and business outcomes. Influence & Collaboration: Builds alignment across functions and organizational levels through credibility, effective partnership, and constructive challenge. Decision Quality & Accountability: Uses data and business judgment to frame trade-offs, drive decisions, establish clear ownership, and deliver results. Change Leadership: Creates clarity through transformation and builds commitment to new processes, capabilities, and ways of working. People Leadership & Development: Leads, coaches, and develops team members through clear expectations, meaningful feedback, career development, succession planning, and performance accountability.

About Okendo

We believe happy customers make the best marketers.

That’s why we built Okendo – the customer marketing platform that creates stronger connections between consumers and the brands they love.

Using Okendo, Shopify brands can grow faster and more efficiently by cultivating brand advocacy and maximising lifetime value.

Our unified platform and unique suite of products for Reviews, Referrals, Quizzes, Loyalty, and Surveys is trusted by 19,000+ Shopify brands to turn one time shoppers into revenue-driving Superfans.

Position Summary

As an Enterprise Onboarding Manager, you will set Okendo's most strategic brands up for long-term success. You will own each launch from the moment the deal closes to the handoff to Customer Success: turning the brand's goals into a clear launch plan, guiding them through setup, integrations, and go-live, and making sure they see value quickly.

This is an individual contributor role. You will pick up the momentum Sales has built, and you will work hand in hand with Solutions Engineering, Support, Customer Success, and Account Executives. The first impression you create sets the tone for the whole relationship.

How you'll create impact:

Own the enterprise launch from kickoff to go-live

  • Be the dedicated lead for each new enterprise brand, from sales handoff to go-live, keeping the plan, timeline, and expectations clear
  • Turn each brand's goals into a launch plan across Reviews, Loyalty, Referrals, Quizzes, and Surveys, tailored to their business, tech stack, and retail calendar
  • Run several complex launches at once, clearing blockers early so brands go live on time and on brand

Design programs that deliver value fast

  • Advise each brand on how to set up their programs, and guide them through data migration, theme customization, and integrations with their tech stack, including Shopify, Klaviyo, TikTok Shop, Google, Meta, and Attentive
  • Work with Solutions Engineering on custom builds and APIs, writing clear requirements so the work lands right
  • Train brand teams to run their programs with confidence, and make sure every brand reaches first value by the go-live date

Partner across the business

  • Work with Sales before close on scope and timelines, and join late-stage calls where trust in our onboarding matters
  • Hand off each brand to Customer Success with a clear summary of goals, stakeholders, and next steps, and flag growth opportunities across the suite
  • Give Product feedback on gaps you see during enterprise launches, and partner with Marketing on customer stories

Keep raising the bar on how we onboard

  • Build templates, checklists, and playbooks for enterprise launches, so what works for you becomes how the team works
  • Become a deep expert on the Okendo platform and the ecommerce tools brands use alongside it, and share what you learn with the team

What we need from you:

  • 5+ years in customer onboarding, implementation, or project management at a B2B SaaS company, ideally with ecommerce brands or marketing and retention tools
  • A track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder launches for larger customers, on time and to a high standard
  • Strong project management and organisation: you can plan, track, and prioritise many moving parts across many launches at once
  • Technical comfort: the words CSV, HTML, and APIs do not scare you, they excite you
  • Knowledge of ecommerce tech stacks and metrics, such as conversion, AOV, and repeat rate
  • Confidence working with senior marketing and ecommerce stakeholders, and the assertiveness to drive action plans to completion
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and a resourceful, positive, resilient approach when launches get complicated
  • Bonus: familiarity with Shopify (especially Shopify Plus), Klaviyo, Google Shopping, and headless or custom storefront setups

1-Month Success Markers

  • You've completed onboarding, earned your Okendo Product Expert certification, and can confidently demo all five Okendo products
  • You've shadowed enterprise launches from kickoff to go-live and are running your first launches with support
  • You understand the ecommerce industry and the brands we work with well enough to hold a credible conversation

6-Month Success Markers

  • You've led multiple enterprise launches from kickoff to go-live, on time and to a high standard
  • Every launch has a clear plan, named stakeholders, a go-live date, and a clean handoff to Customer Success
  • You've built strong working relationships with Solutions Engineering, Account Executives, and Customer Success, and contributed templates the team is using

1-Year Success Markers

  • You consistently launch enterprise brands on time, and those brands describe the experience as smooth and well run
  • The brands you launched are healthy, growing accounts, with clear growth plans handed to Customer Success
  • You're the go-to resource inside Okendo for complex enterprise launches, and your playbooks are part of how the team works
