Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Your Career


As the Director of Public Sector Business Development & Capture, you will manage and scale a high-impact team aligned with US Federal and SLED markets. Your mandate is clear: drive pipeline, bookings, and annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth across federal, state, and local governments.


You will move the organization beyond opportunistic wins toward deliberate platform expansion within multi-year enterprise programs. You will partner with field sales to establish repeatable growth models that convert initial footprints into strategic positions and transform single-product deployments into full platform adoption. This is a forward-leaning leadership position focused on large IDIQ/GWAC task orders, statewide modernization initiatives, Enterprise License Agreements (ELAs), and Zero Trust cloud transformation programs. You will define how Palo Alto Networks wins at scale.


Your Impact


  • Lead, mentor, and scale Business Development and Capture Managers, fostering a high-accountability culture.
  • Execute strategies that accelerate pipeline, bookings, and ARR growth while driving multi-product platformization across target customers while partnering closely with the field sales organization.
  • Lead team in serving as trusted domain experts to navigate complex procurements, drive proactive BD campaigns, and align with prime contractors leading major solicitations.
  • Lead a team that partners with sales leadership 6–18 months pre-RFP to qualify high-impact pursuits, build proactive pipeline, and execute capture strategies that maximize P-Win.
  • Lead a team partnering with Solution Consultants and Architects to validate technical fit, shape partner architectures, and embed PANW platform capabilities across all capture pursuits.
  • Track and evaluate programmatic impact using data-driven insights to optimize capture performance and align field sales, partner ecosystems, and end customers.

Qualifications

Your Experience


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, business development, or capture leadership, with 7+ years specifically leading teams in the US Public Sector (Federal and SLED).
  • Proven track record of building, scaling, and leading high-performing BD and capture teams.
  • Demonstrated success overseeing the capture and winning of major government programs while driving expansion across multi-year contracts; deep expertise in Shipley or equivalent capture methodologies.
  • In-depth knowledge of federal acquisition regulations and processes (FAR/DFARS), GWACs, IDIQs, GSA Schedules, and state- and local-level procurement vehicles.
  • Proven ability to influence senior government and industry executives while delivering strategic guidance to internal C-suite stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience leveraging generative AI platforms (e.g., Google Gemini, OpenAI ChatGPT, Anthropic Claude).

Preferred Qualifications


  • Master of Business Administration (MBA) or relevant advanced degree.
  • Strong background in cybersecurity, SaaS, cloud, or enterprise infrastructure, with direct exposure to Zero Trust frameworks and AI-driven security platforms.
  • Proven track record working directly within or alongside Federal Systems Integrators (FSIs) and the broader public sector partner ecosystem.
  • Demonstrated history of developing 12- to 36-month growth strategies aligned with federal and state budget cycles and digital modernization initiatives.

raw.description:
Overview

Cotiviti Healthcare is a leading provider of payment accuracy services to the most recognized companies in the healthcare and retail industries. We are seeking innovative thinkers and creative problem solvers who are interested in making a contribution to improving healthcare and want to be part of a team that is expanding rapidly and providing opportunities for career growth. If you want to make a difference and contribute to the improvement of healthcare payment integrity, consider an opportunity to join our healthcare recovery team as a Senior Payment Accuracy Specialist.

The Senior Specialist position is responsible for developing new and existing audit concepts, gaining client acceptance, training all audit levels to execute audit projects and evaluating the effectiveness of audit concepts. The goal of the position is to generate high quality recoverable claims for the benefit of Cotiviti and our clients. Conducts and documents more complex audit projects independently. This is the most senior skill level which may include supervisory responsibility. Assists Audit Managers in managing audit productivity, achieving expected quality and revenue goals. Considered a mentor, trainer, developer of less tenured Audit team members.

Responsibilities

  • Generates and Develops New Audit Concepts. Utilizes healthcare and auditing experience to perform audit procedures that include identifying and defining issues, developing criteria, reviewing and analyzing evidence with the intent to audit standard medium and complex reports. Leader in concept development across multiple audit verticals. This includes specifying the concept, interact with client to test and gain acceptance. Will execute on the expansion of the concept based on customer requirements. Focused on growing concept approval.
  • Develops New Tools and Processes. Collaborates with Business Optimization and audit team in developing new reports. Fosters and implements new ideas, approaches, and technological improvements to support and enhance audit production, communication and client satisfaction.
  • Directs ownership for Quality Control. Reviews all level auditor claims prior to and after client submission. Set by the audit: for the auditing concept, audit against the expected level of quality and quantity (i.e.; hit rate, # claims written, ID per hour).
  • Prepares Responses to Client Disputes. Provides oversight to audit team for verification of claims validation, insurance or employer validation in concise written or oral manner. Makes determinations based on advanced experience of client knowledge of contract terms, likelihood of acceptance recovery.
  • Reviews provider Contracts. Subject matter expert in contracts and research requirements. Implements recommendations on contracts to fit projects within standard reports such as medical policies, state and federal statutes.
  • Validates New Claim Types. With proficiency, utilizes audit tools to evaluate, document and validate to audit and client new claims and concept effectiveness. Ensures that any new and existing concepts are achieving desired goals in terms of recoveries, collectability and client acceptance.
  • Auditor Development. Key participants in the development of audit staff. Actively trains audit team to execute basic, intermediate and complex audit projects with focus on new and existing audit concepts. May participate in auditor assessment, progression process, staffing functions.
  • QA Claim Association/Concepts. Responsible for performing quality control process. Makes determinations based on advanced expertise and comprehension (knowledge) of claim categories, claim types. Ensures submission and execution of quality work, proper use of available proprietary software, reports and IT resources to conduct audits.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and the requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree preferred Three (3) years of Cotiviti direct audit experience OR four (4) years related experience (healthcare billing, healthcare/medical claims, reimbursement, analytics) required.
  • Experience using SQL required.
  • Computer proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Access and system databases are required.
  • Ability to mentor staff and enhance performance as it relates to the quality and productivity of their auditors.
  • Prior Healthcare Billing and/or claims experience desired. Requires working knowledge of and applicable industry based standards.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work well in an individual and team environment.

Mental Requirements:

  • Communicating with others to exchange information.
  • Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
  • No adverse environmental conditions expected.

Base compensation ranges from $37.75 to $40.25 per hour. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.

Nonexempt employees are eligible to receive overtime pay for hours worked in excess of 40 hours in a given week, or as otherwise required by applicable state law.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

raw.description:
As a Data Analyst in the Business Analytics team, you’ll be the dedicated analyst for our B2B commercial direction. You’ll work as an independent contributor, side by side with the commercial team. You’ll find growth opportunities in the data, form and test hypotheses, and measure the impact of business initiatives that are not product features. Your first projects will be supporting and developing our pricing override and cost modifier processes, designing experiments around the credit limits we give B2B partners to help grow their booking volumes, and evaluating the financial and customer impact of opening local legal entities in new markets. A/B testing alone often isn’t enough here, so you’ll choose and apply other methods, such as difference-in-differences or causal impact. There is no ready-made playbook. You’ll set your own approach, and project managers on both sides will help you run the work. The role suits a self-driven analyst who wants real ownership and visible impact on commercial decisions, and it can grow as the direction expands.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in business, data or product analytics.
  • Strong SQL, including writing efficient, fast-running queries.
  • Confident Python and its data libraries: Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Scikit-learn and others.
  • Hands-on experience with difference-in-differences.
  • Experience with causal inference methods: Causal Impact, Propensity Score Matching and similar.
  • Solid knowledge of statistics and experience designing and running A/B tests and other experiments.
  • Ability to dive deep into business processes, solve non-standard problems and work independently.
  • Fluent Russian and English B2.

Nice to have

  • Experience with time series forecasting (Prophet, ARIMA, Exponential Smoothing or similar).
  • Experience in B2B, commercial or partner analytics.
  • Experience onboarding or mentoring junior colleagues.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools, such as Copilot or agents, to speed up your work.

Benefits

  • Flexible schedules and opportunity to work remotely.
  • Ambitious and supportive team who love what they do, appreciate each other, and grow together.
  • A structured onboarding, a personal development plan, and regular internal lectures and demos from the team.
  • Internal programs for adaptation and training, development of soft skills, and leadership abilities.
  • Partial compensation for participating in external training and conferences.
  • Corporate English school: Group and individual lessons, speaking clubs with colleagues from all over the world.
  • Corporate prices on hotels and travel services.
  • MyTime Day Off - an extra non-working day without loss of compensation.

The Director, Client Experience (Director, CX) leads 4-6 Client Experience Managers (CXMs), ensuring high-quality account management and strategic client engagement. This role focuses on driving client satisfaction, retention, and revenue growth through effective portfolio management and team leadership. The Director, CX collaborates with the other Director, CX and leadership team members to align client experience initiatives with company objectives while addressing critical gaps in value communication, automation adoption, and internal knowledge sharing. Director, CX reports to the CEO.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of CXMs to deliver exceptional client experiences and achieve business goals
  • Provide mentorship and career development opportunities to CXM team members
  • Hold teammates accountable to established KPIs and maintain high standards of performance

Value Communication & ROI Demonstration

VP, Global Deal Desk & Renewal Operations


Why this role


This team sits at the center of every Workiva deal, direct or through a partner. As VP, you will set the standard for how we price, structure, and renew business, and make it faster and simpler for our sellers and customers. You’ll lead the Deal Desk, Commercial Strategy, and Renewal Operations organizations and own the integrity of our commercial engine, while transforming how we get from quote to order to renewal. We’re looking for a strategic commercial leader and technology-minded process architect who sees deal friction as a problem to engineer away, uses data and AI to drive decisions, and turns governance into a competitive advantage for our sellers.


What you’ll own


You’ll be accountable for deal structuring, governance, and negotiation, pricing compliance, renewal execution, and the end-to-end quote-to-order process across Workiva’s global commercial organization. You’ll build a team and operating model that lets Sales move quickly without compromising deal quality, margin, or retention.


Responsibilities


Deal Desk & Commercial Negotiations


  • Own deal governance and approval authority across all partner and direct deals, applying commercial policy consistently while keeping approvals fast and predictable
  • Lead structuring and negotiation of complex commercial terms, partnering directly with Sales leadership on strategic, high-value deals
  • Act as the primary commercial thought partner to Sales Leadership and Product Marketing on multi-solution enterprise deal architecture, custom terms, and value-based pricing
  • Own pricing compliance and policy oversight, partnering with Pricing & Packaging to turn pricing and discounting strategy into enforceable, scalable deal desk practice
  • Partner with Legal and Accounting to define rules and criteria for deal structure, order approvals, and revenue recognition readiness
  • Drive continuous improvement in deal cycle time and seller experience without compromising governance

Renewal Operations


  • Own renewal operations and the customer retention motion, partnering with Customer Success and Field Operations to protect and grow existing revenue
  • Build a proactive, data-driven renewal forecasting and risk-detection model, aligned with Customer Success (CPX), that unifies retention strategy and customer health insights 6–12 months before contract expiration
  • Ensure renewal terms, pricing, and contract structures align with commercial policy and pricing governance, and identify expansion opportunities within the renewal motion

Business Transformation & Innovation


  • Serve as the thought leader and change agent for the quote-to-order-to-renewal lifecycle, setting the vision and multi-year roadmap to reduce deal friction and simplify commercial structures
  • Lead the quote-to-order transformation with Sales Planning & Performance, Business Technology, Legal, and Finance, eliminating manual handoffs and improving speed and accuracy
  • Apply AI, automation, and advanced analytics to deal desk and renewal operations, such as intelligent deal routing and approvals, contract and terms analysis, pricing guidance, and renewal risk prediction
  • Define the KPIs, dashboards, and insights that drive decisions on deal governance, discounting, and retention
  • Design scalable operating models that absorb growth, new products, and new go-to-market motions without proportional headcount increases
  • Lead change management across Sales, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success to drive adoption and lasting results

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership


  • Lead and develop the Deal Desk, Commercial Strategy, and Renewal Operations teams, building a high-performing, globally distributed organization with strong leaders and clear succession
  • Partner with senior sales leadership to identify opportunities to improve commercial strategy, competitive pricing, and deal process
  • Coach and develop team members, matching talent to the work that best uses their skills, and foster a culture of respect, continuous learning, and commitment to customers
  • Own team planning and management, including hiring, performance management, and development

What you’ll bring


Experience


  • 12+ years of progressive Deal Desk, Commercial Operations, and/or Renewal Operations experience in a high-growth technology company, ideally at a publicly traded SaaS company
  • Track record of leading deal desk and renewal operations at scale and transforming them from policy administrators into strategic business enablers that accelerate deal velocity
  • Demonstrated experience participating in a quote-to-cash or quote-to-order transformation, including CPQ/CLM implementation or optimization
  • Hands-on experience applying automation, analytics, or AI to commercial operations processes
  • Experience negotiating complex commercial terms directly with customers and partners
  • Experience managing analytically rigorous, cross-functional corporate initiatives
  • Working knowledge of subscription revenue recognition (ASC 606) and how deal structure affects it

Skills


  • Strategic thinker and process designer who can set a vision, build the roadmap, and execute
  • Strong technology fluency and the ability to partner credibly with IT and business-systems teams
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Strong commercial negotiation skills, with the ability to represent the company in complex deal discussions
  • Ability to influence at all levels and across Sales, Legal, Accounting, Finance, and Customer Success
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into decisions on deal governance and renewal risk
  • Attention to details around contract terms and pricing structures
  • Ability to set priorities and manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced, changing environment

Education


  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA preferred (equivalent experience considered)

Working conditions


  • Up to 20% travel as needed
  • Reliable internet access when working remotely

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ Salary range in the US: $252,500.00 - $365,000.00

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Why Join Workiva

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

Bilingual Payroll & HR Assistant

About the role

We are hiring bilingual (English/Spanish) payroll and HR assistants to work 100% remotely from Mexico for companies in Madison, Wisconsin with large hourly and Spanish-speaking workforces: construction, landscaping, cleaning, food processing and manufacturing.

Payroll

raw.description:
Brief Description:

The Senior Learning Specialist role will focus on several critical areas:

  • Designing and creating content (Facilitator Guides, Participant Workbooks, Job Aids, Exercises, Coaching Guides, blended learning solutions, and e-learning modules)
  • Designing and creating knowledge resources that are effective for front line staff utilization. This position provides consultation through the assessment, evaluation, and development of both existing and new training programs and materials for internal and external use.
  • Facilitating training sessions (in classroom and virtually) from on-boarding to continued development to refresher training and pull-through of training concepts into practical everyday work.. This position provides subject matter expertise through the assessment, evaluation, and development of both existing and new training programs and materials as well as creating client facing training curricula and schedules..
  • Leading learning design and development offerings across the business unit and multiple client programs

This position focus can change between these key areas to support the needs of the business and specific areas of expertise and time allocation will vary. The role is responsible for the development and delivery of learning experience across the assigned area of responsibility as well as providing subject matter expertise and consultation for all aspects of training development and facilitation through the assessment, evaluation, and development of both existing and new training programs and materials. The role will also be called upon to deliver internal business unit training materials to help ensure all teams/programs have consistent foundational learnings and are operating from similar ‘Ways of Working’ principles.

Specific job duties:

  • On-boarding employees and contingent workers to ensure they have the knowledge, skills and abilities to meet customer expectations and enterprise goals.
  • Develop and deliver standardized system and process training via classroom/virtual methods. This may include travel to other UBC sites and/or to client hosted locations.
  • Consult with program participants and management to evaluate impact of training programs. Review quality and performance records to determine opportunities for review and retraining needs that may be associate specific.
  • Respond to specific training requests by leadership team, program managers, or quality in a timely manner.
  • Develop, maintain and update training program and materials to reflect updated systems or processes.
  • Provide feedback and conduct periodic retraining where quality or performance issues are noted or when system or process changes require training.
  • Author and deliver customized program training and simulation scenarios/cases via classroom or other methods.
  • Author and administer practical exercises to evaluate trainee’s comprehension. Ensure training objectives and goals are related to business objectives or client needs.
  • Responsible for ensuring all training records are documented and maintained
  • Maintains overall training documentation records including creation, revisions, reviews and archival.
  • Researching, authoring, publishing, and maintenance of Process and other related documents in compliance with established content standards using various authoring tools (KMS, MS Word, Dreamweaver, Flare, etc.).
  • Works closely with various departments and related groups, Business Owners and SMEs to document procedures and related content, including the translation of business needs into user instructions and reference content.
  • Leads a variety of projects including systemic improvements/enhancements to existing documentation flow and storage including authoring and contributing to training related SOP revisions..
  • Independently manage or participate in several projects in support of Operations Learning goals.
  • Collaborates and cross-trains with Learning and quality team to leverage organizational efficiency
  • Build and maintain effective partnerships with internal clients through needs assessments and discussions to proactively identify issues that impact training needs from both a competency and knowledge base.
  • Build and deliver content – Facilitator Guides, Participant Workbooks, Worksheets, Job Aids, Exercises, Coaching Guides, blended learning modules, and e-learning modules to meet Program Specific Procedures, Compliance, Standard Operating Procedures, knowledge, and adherence.
  • Work collaboratively with internal clients and IT on system builds and other data points to assess needs, UAT test, coordinate, design, develop interactive learning solutions through a variety of mediums in support of the overall strategy and goals of the business.
  • Learning interactions will focus on competencies such as presentation, negotiation, communication, conflict resolution, and procedural knowledge.
  • Play a key role across the business unit in authoring, designing, developing, and supporting the roll out of strategic initiatives and enhancements from a learning perspective.
  • Use clear communication and cross-functional process management skills to ensure timely delivery of effective training programs and sessions that add value in supporting the goals and initiatives of the business.
  • Independently manage or participate in projects determined in conjunction with business partners, Directors and/or Managers.
  • Maintain awareness of new developments in training and instructional design and recommend modifications in our curriculum and practices.
  • Solves complex problems; takes a new perspective using existing solutions. Works independently to represent the organization in providing solutions to difficult technical issues associated with specific projects.
  • Develop and maintain expert knowledge of critical tools and learning requirements
  • Ability to travel as needed
  • Actively participates in in-person and virtual meetings/events (internal and external)

Relevant Systems and Tools:

  • Adult Learning: ADDIE and SAM Methodologies, Technical design, Needs Analysis Skills, Objective Building, Test Creation
  • Instructional Development: Storyline, Articulate, Captivate, Photoshop – Graphical manipulation, Video Production, SharePoint/Web Development, PowerPoint, WebEx , Process Mapping/Visio, Technical Writing
  • Knowledge Management: Search Appliance/ Metadata, HTML/CSS, Web Development, Process Mapping/Visio, Technical Writing
  • LMS Administration: eQMS, SumTotal, Survey Monkey, Excel pivot tables and charts, Analytical analysis to tie evaluation data to business production

Supervisory Responsibility:

No supervisory responsibility is required although team leadership and influencing without authority as well as strong project management skills are critical to the role.

Desired Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, training or related field or equivalent work experience
  • 5 to 8 years relevant experience or Master’s degree; operations or business environment and 3-5 years’ experience in training
  • Certification in facilitation, instructional design, adult learning, PMP preferred
  • Ability to motivate employees, provide thought leadership and forward thinking
  • Demonstrated ability to meet multiple deadlines and manage heavy workload
  • Strong organizational skills, detail oriented and ability to multi-task
  • Strong focus on Patient & Client Satisfaction
  • Expert prioritization skills, able to handle multiple projects at once
  • Excellent presentation, facilitation and communication (verbal and written) skills
  • Expert proficiency and knowledge of Microsoft package, particularly on Word, Excel and PowerPoint
  • Proven ability to develop training courses and supporting documentation
  • Experience in conducting needs analysis and operations application functionality
  • Strong knowledge of adult learning principles and techniques
  • Excellent internal and external customer service skills
  • Proven ability to identify customized strategies and tactics for success in training delivery
  • Experience with e-learning authoring tools, HTML expertise, knowledge management tools
  • Proven experience in conducting needs analysis and operations application functionality
  • Proven ability to identify customized strategies and tactics for success in training delivery
  • Demonstrated problem solving and analytical thinking skills

Benefits:

At UBC, employee growth and well-being are always at the forefront. We offer an extensive range of benefits to ensure that you have everything you need to thrive personally and professionally.

Here are some of the exciting perks UBC offers:

  • Remote opportunities
  • Competitive salaries

  • 401K with company match*
  • Tuition reimbursement (after 90 days of employment)
  • Flexible work environment

  • Telemedicine (Virtual doctor appointments)
  • Wellness program

raw.excerpt: Stacklok is led by CEO Craig McLuckie and CTO Joe Beda, two of the creators of Kubernetes.
raw.description:
Stacklok is led by CEO Craig McLuckie and CTO Joe Beda, two of the creators of Kubernetes. Kubernetes helped give enterprises more freedom over where and how they run software. Now we're bringing that same open approach to AI agents.

As AI agents take on more autonomous, long-running work, enterprises need infrastructure to run them securely and reliably at scale, without giving up control of their data, systems, or models. We're building open, Kubernetes-native infrastructure that brings together agent execution, secure access to tools and systems, and centralized controls for identity, permissions, and policy. This is an opportunity to help shape a foundational layer for enterprise AI while the architecture is still being defined.

We build in the open alongside the community. Our open source projects include ToolHive, an MCP platform that secures more than 20 million tool calls each month, and Mecatl, a cloud-native agent harness. Our commercial offering, Stacklok Enterprise, extends these capabilities with an AI gateway, centralized identity, policy enforcement, and observability.

Location

This is a remote role based in North America, with a strong preference for candidates located in the U.S. Eastern Time Zone.

The Opportunity

Enterprises are moving AI agents into production, and they want to run them the way they run everything else: on their own Kubernetes clusters, behind their firewall, and connected to the identity systems they already use. Stacklok Enterprise, our commercial platform for running and governing AI agents, is built for that, by a team whose founders co-created Kubernetes.

As a Senior Engineer on the core platform team, you will design and build major parts of the platform and own them from design through production. That work runs in customers' Kubernetes environments, so your design tradeoffs shape how the product holds up in the field. The areas you own will shift as the product grows, and you will mentor the engineers building alongside you.

Customers are onboarding now. As one of the key engineers helping them reach production, you will also work with some as design partners on our newest features and products. It is a high-ownership role in an emerging category, with a short path from customer feedback to what ships.

What Success Looks Like: First 6-12 Months

  • Designed and shipped a complete subsystem end to end that is now running in production for enterprise customers.
  • Helped take one or more customers from proof-of-concept to production on their own Kubernetes, and turned their feedback into a platform feature.
  • Raised the team's bar by mentoring engineers and strengthening the product engineering culture.
  • Improved how the team ships changes to customers, including where AI-assisted workflows helped and where they created rework.
  • Became the owner and go-to decision maker for one or more platform areas, with the team routing design questions your way.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own the design and implementation of platform subsystems in Stacklok Enterprise end to end, from technical design through production and ongoing improvement.
  • Write production Go code for commercial software that runs reliably in customer Kubernetes environments, with observability, testing, and error handling built in.
  • Make the design tradeoffs for the areas you own with product and engineering leadership, and mentor the engineers building alongside you.
  • Work with customers to successfully operationalize the Enterprise Platform and turn their feedback into product improvements.
  • Contribute to the open-source ToolHive codebase and collaborate with community contributors on shared work.
  • Apply AI-assisted workflows and strengthen reusable tooling and playbooks so each engagement moves faster for the team.

Desired Skill & Experience

We do not expect every candidate to meet every point below. If this role excites you and you bring most of it, we encourage you to apply.

  • Proficiency in Go, with a proven track record designing and shipping complete production-grade distributed systems as part of a commercial software product.
  • Hands-on experience deploying and running applications on Kubernetes in production, ideally across different customer cloud environments, such as AWS, Azure and GCP.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers, driving code review, and raising the quality of a team's work.
  • Experience working directly with customers to onboard them and to debug the product, from diagnosing issues in their environments to driving fixes back into the codebase.
  • AI-first mindset, with experience integrating AI tools into development practices and turning AI-assisted workflows into repeatable velocity gains for the team.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Startup mentality and intrinsic motivation, including a self-directed, hands-on approach and the ability to thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

Compensation: The anticipated base salary range for this position is $189,000 - $231,000. In addition to base salary, this role offers equity and a comprehensive benefits package.

Why Join Us?

At Stacklok, we believe great technology is built by teams that support, challenge, and inspire one another. We are AI maximalists, confident in AI’s potential and committed to building technology people can trust. We use AI in our own work and experiment openly.

You’ll build alongside people with deep experience in open source, cloud-native technologies, security, and developer tools. We stay close to customers, use our own products, and share what we learn to keep improving. You’ll have room to make decisions, support when you need it, and teammates who push themselves to do their best work.

We offer competitive compensation and equity, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, and a flexible hybrid or remote work environment. Our benefits include flexible PTO, paid holidays, and paid parental leave, along with team offsites to collaborate and connect in person.

If you’re excited about what we’re building and want to work with people who care about their craft, community, and each other, we’d love to hear from you.

--

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law.

raw.excerpt: Job Description A bit about this roleWe want to help members navigate the healthcare system in a better and safer way.
raw.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role

We want to help members navigate the healthcare system in a better and safer way. This means getting the right care at the right place, at the right time. As a Triage Clinical Guide (Registered Nurse), you’ll be responsible for providing telephonic advice and clinical triage when Devoted Health members call us for support. You'll serve as a fierce advocate, helping them achieve better health outcomes and connecting them with the necessary resources.

Our ideal Triage Clinical Guide is caring, compassionate, solution-oriented, and enthusiastic about providing an outstanding member experience. You possess excellent clinical judgment, are ready to innovate, and are excited about changing the way healthcare is delivered. You will be joining a team of adaptable, scrappy, and resilient professionals who are proud to be part of the Devoted family, creating a revolution in care delivery.

Schedule Details:

  • This is a full-time, night shift role.

  • You will work five (5) scheduled clinical shifts per week on a rotating basis, including weekends and holidays. Shift days are scheduled based on business needs but will primarily be: 6:00 PM – 2:30 AM ET

  • Shift assignments are subject to change based on operational needs.

Your Responsibilities & Impact:

  • Clinical Triage: Engage with members via telephone and the patient portal to provide clinical advice, educational materials, answer questions, and direct patients to the appropriate level of care.

  • Care Coordination: Connect members with the exact care they need, whether routing them to providers within Devoted Medical, primary care, urgent care, or emergency services.

  • Telehealth Support: Deliver exceptional support to patients with urgent complaints across multiple geographies, leveraging video telehealth visits to keep them safely at home whenever possible.

  • Portal Chat Monitoring: Monitor clinical chat queues and respond directly to inbound patient portal messages within established response goals. Escalate to acute clinical triage via phone for new active symptoms, create appropriate Care OnDemand support episodes, and send templated replies for non-urgent administrative or routine needs. Securely share relevant educational handouts and clinical summaries after obtaining patient consent.

  • Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Work seamlessly alongside a multidisciplinary team—including other RNs, NPs, PAs, MDs, and medical assistants—safeguarding our collaborative, team-based culture.

  • Continuous Growth: Enthusiastically participate in learning sessions and be eager to grow your own skills while teaching others.

  • Patient Advocacy: Fiercely promote our model of treating and caring for patients like they are our own family members.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Licensure: An active, unencumbered Compact RN license OR a willingness to obtain additional state licenses as needed (for non-compact states).

  • Experience: A minimum of 5 years of direct patient care experience.

  • Triage Expertise: Prior clinical triage experience in an Emergency Department, Intensive Care Unit, Primary Care, or Telephonic Triage setting.

  • Telehealth: Prior telehealth experience is required.

  • Technical Agility: Eager to learn and able to quickly master electronic medical records (EMR), remote telephone software, and virtual video systems.

  • Work Style: Exceptional communication and active listening skills. You enjoy fast-paced work, are eager to task-switch, and are always happy to help colleagues.

Desired Skills & Experience:

  • BSN (Bachelor of Science in Nursing) degree preferred.

  • Experience caring for older adult populations.

  • Experience working within population health or value-based care programs.

Attributes to Success:

  • Curious & Compassionate: You listen to others, lead with empathy, and aren't afraid to be wrong or change your mind.

  • Detail-Oriented: You hold high standards for patient care, are well-organized, and possess meticulous attention to detail.

  • Happy Warrior: As long as you’re in a great environment with smart, caring people working toward a common aim, you’re comfortable working hard and tackling tough challenges.

  • Innovative: You are wired for learning and change. You want to make a difference by testing new ways of doing things to build a better care system.

  • Agile: Agility and collaboration are critical. We are a growing organization with a start-up mentality—you believe we can do hard things together!

Salary Range: $85,000 - $110,000 / year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, marital status, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.

Role Title: Federal Civil Litigation Attorney

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging experienced Federal Civil Litigation Attorneys to contribute their legal expertise to a cutting-edge AI research initiative. In this role, you'll help improve how next-generation AI systems draft, evaluate, and refine legal arguments and court motions. We're looking for practicing attorneys with strong federal civil litigation experience and a proven track record of successful motion practice. You'll use your professional judgment to assess the quality, persuasiveness, and structure of AI-generated legal writing, providing feedback that reflects real-world litigation standards.

Scope of Work

  1. Review and compare AI-generated legal motions, assessing their persuasiveness, structure, clarity, tone, and overall quality.
  2. Rank different versions of legal motions and provide clear explanations of your preferences and reasoning.
  3. Evaluate whether AI-generated motions meet professional standards and identify areas requiring improvement.
  4. Edit and refine legal motions to a ready-to-file standard, providing feedback on the changes made.
  5. Develop realistic motion-writing assignments based on federal civil litigation scenarios.
  6. Create evaluation criteria to assess the quality and effectiveness of AI-generated legal arguments.
  7. Apply practical litigation experience to identify what makes legal writing persuasive, well-structured, and effective in court.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Juris Doctor (JD) degree and active U.S. bar membership in good standing.
  2. Practicing attorney with substantial hands-on experience in federal civil litigation and motion drafting.
  3. A proven track record of winning at least three court motions, with the ability to provide supporting court filings during the screening process.
  4. Strong experience drafting substantive motions, including motions to dismiss, motions for summary judgment, or similar federal court filings.
  5. Excellent legal research, analytical, and persuasive writing skills.
  6. Ability to critically evaluate legal arguments and clearly explain what makes one approach more effective than another.
  7. Strong attention to detail, particularly in legal reasoning, citation accuracy, document structure, and professional writing standards.
  8. Experience in appellate litigation or a previous judicial clerkship combined with litigation practice is also highly relevant.

We are a fast-moving, solutions-driven team using an AI-forward approach to solve complex operational challenges. If you are passionate about building technology that transforms traditional industries, we’d love to have you join us.

About the role

We're looking for a driven Software Engineer to join our dynamic engineering team to contribute to our mission of managing hundreds of thousands of business entities worldwide, empowering our users with a platform that inspires trust. In this role, you will contribute to designing, building, and maintaining scalable software solutions that enhance our platform's functionality and performance. Reporting to the Director of Development, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality code, optimize application performance, and support the growth of our technology stack.

What you'll do

  • Quality & Security Governance: Optimize application performance, ensure security and reliability, and conduct thorough code reviews to maintain high code quality.
  • Process Evolution: Identify and resolve technical challenges, propose solutions, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our development processes.
  • Future-Proofing: Stay up to date with industry trends, specifically LLM integrations and automated testing advancements to evaluate and adopt emerging technologies that can enhance our platform’s capabilities.
  • Technical Mentorship: Guide the team in best practices for modern engineering, from sophisticated TypeScript typing to efficient AI-prompting for complex refactors.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of software engineering experience building scalable, enterprise-grade applications.

  • Production AI Experience: Proven track record of shipping and operating real-world AI features in a live product (e.g., RAG, LLM integrations, vector search, or AI agents) not just using AI coding tools.

Location

We have embraced a distributed model of working to reach the best talent in the world. While some roles may require proximity to our Toronto, Calgary and Vancouver offices, roles based outside our office locations can be remote in Canada. Please only apply if you are able to live and work full-time in Canada.

Our Culture

Our company thrives in a fast-paced startup environment where every team member plays a critical role in driving success.

Outcome Driven: We focus on setting ambitious goals and achieving measurable results.

Wide Responsibility: Our team is empowered to take ownership from problem identification to implementation.

Learning Mindset: We embrace curiosity and reject the status quo.

Strategic Speed: We make fast, effective decisions and embrace a bias for action.

Benefits at Athennian

We’re a remote-first company built on trust, autonomy, and accountability.

Work-Life Balance: Minimum of 3 weeks vacation, 5 sick days, and 6 personal/flex days, plus a company-wide winter holiday shutdown.

Comprehensive Coverage: Health, dental, and vision, long-term disability, and a Health Spending Account (HSA).

raw.description:
We’re Sharp Performance

Sharp Performance exists so that everyone who answers the call has someone in their corner who has walked in their shoes.

We help first responders and their spouses thrive through confidential coaching from people with similar lived experience. Our coaches have carried the badge, worn the gear, or stood beside someone who did. Through our mobile platform, we connect law enforcement, firefighters, and other frontline professionals with coaches who understand the job because they have lived it.

We’re early-stage and backed by amazing investors. The team is small enough that your work shows up in the rollout, the product, and the customer’s experience within weeks. If building something that matters alongside people who hold a high standard sounds better than a safe seat somewhere else, come build it with us.

The Opportunity

We’re hiring a Talent Coordinator to run the hiring engine that brings great people onto the Sharp team. This role reports to the Senior Recruiter.

Every hire at an early-stage company matters, and every candidate forms an opinion of Sharp from how we treat them. You own the logistics that make hiring fast, organized, and human: scheduling, interview panels, candidate communication, offer letters, ATS hygiene, and the handoff to onboarding. Recruiters and hiring managers focus on finding and assessing talent. You make sure the process around them never slows down.

You will work closely with Recruiting, People Ops, and hiring managers across Sales, Product, Coaching, and Engineering.

This role is Remote, with occasional travel to Carlsbad, CA as the work requires.

What You’ll Own

  • Scheduling: Coordinate phone screens, interview loops and final rounds across time zones and busy calendars. Reschedule quickly when plans change without losing momentum.
  • Interview panels: Build balanced panels with hiring managers, send interviewers prep materials and scorecards, and chase feedback so decisions happen within 48 hours.
  • Candidate communication: Be the main point of contact for candidates in process. Send confirmations, reminders and status updates, and make sure no one is left waiting without an answer.
  • Offer letters: Draft and send offer letters from approved templates, route them for approval and track signatures through close.
  • ATS hygiene: Keep every requisition, candidate stage, disposition and note accurate in our ATS. Clean data lets us report on pipeline and time to hire with confidence.
  • Handoff to onboarding: Once an offer is signed, pass a complete, accurate record to People Ops so new hires get equipment, accounts and a warm welcome on day one.
  • Process improvement: Spot friction in our hiring process and suggest templates, automations or workflow changes that save time for candidates and the team.

The Numbers

Two numbers define success in this role. You will set the targets with your manager in your first 90 days and own them after that:

  • Candidate speed. Time from stage change to scheduled interview, interview-to-feedback turnaround (target: 48 hours), and time from verbal offer to signed offer letter. Reported by role, weekly.
  • Candidate experience and data quality. Candidate experience survey scores, no candidate waiting more than two business days for an update, and an ATS clean enough that pipeline reports need no manual fixes.

Who Thrives Here

This role is not for everyone. You will thrive if you have:

  • 2–3 years of experience in recruiting coordination, talent operations, HR or a similar high-volume scheduling role.
  • Hands-on experience with Rippling, including managing candidate stages, scheduling, offer workflows or reporting.
  • Strong command of Google Workspace, especially calendars and shared documents.
  • Excellent organization: you can juggle 20+ active candidates and several open roles without dropping details.
  • Clear, warm and professional writing for candidates, interviewers and executives.
  • Sound judgment with confidential information such as compensation and offer terms.
  • A preference for ownership over supervision, and a deep care for serving those who serve others.

Why you’ll love working here

Sharp is a small, fast-growing team, and our success starts with the people doing the work. The package is built to support your health, your finances, and your growth:

  • High Earning Potential: Competitive base salary with uncapped commission. We are offering a salary from 50-60k a year.
  • Mission That Matters: You're not selling software to a Fortune 500. You're helping protect the mental health of cops and firefighters who need it.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision.
  • Flexible PTO: Recharge and stay sharp, no micromanagement.
  • 401(k) with Company Match: We invest in your future.
  • Performance Coaching: Access to the same elite performance coaches we offer our clients.
  • A Team Built Like You: We're operators, first responders, and high-performers who don't accept average.

raw.title: Sr. SDE (Email)
raw.excerpt: About us HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale.
raw.description:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Team:

The Email team owns the Email platform behind HighLevel's email experience, which powers 40M+ emails a day. We own the full path from compose to inbox, so the reliability, speed and quality of what we ship directly decide whether emails from over a million businesses land in the inbox.

We are responsible for:

  • Email Platform: The Vue.js apps used to design, compose and send emails, plus the Node.js/NestJS services behind them.
  • Sending Infrastructure & Deliverability: IP pools, dedicated IPs, dedicated domains and shared domain pools. These let new users send from day one, while we stay accountable for getting their email into the inbox.
  • API-First Platform: Every capability is exposed through APIs, so email can be built into any product or workflow that needs it.
  • Scale & Reliability: Keeping throughput high at peak load, with high uptime and send success rates.
  • Email Statistics & Analytics: Integrating email stats with internal teams and making every release measurable on our dashboards.
  • AI in Email: Bringing LLM-powered capabilities into email creation, while weighing token cost, latency and quality

Impact & Scale

Email is one of the most critical channels on HighLevel. When it works, businesses grow; when it breaks, their customers stop hearing from them. That's the weight this role carries.

  • Businesses: Every one of the 1M+ businesses on HighLevel relies on email to reach their customers.
  • Sub-accounts: Your work runs across 1.6M+ sub-accounts, from solo operators to agencies managing hundreds of clients.
  • End users: What you ship reaches end users through 1.2B+ emails every month.
  • Volume: 40M+ emails a day flow through the systems you'll own, so a 1% gain in reliability or deliverability affects hundreds of thousands of emails daily.
  • Blast radius: One change can affect every business on the platform at once, which is why we care so much about reliability, data integrity and security.

How we work

  • Iterate fast: Go from idea to prototype to production in days, not quarters. Ship small, measure, learn and improve.
  • Use AI well: Use AI across the whole cycle (design, coding, testing, reviews and debugging) to move faster without lowering the quality bar, and pick the right model for each job based on quality, latency and cost.

About the Role:

The traditional model of siloed product managers, designers and engineers is too slow for AI-native development. At HighLevel, every engineer owns a product outcome end to end, from idea to prototype to production to scale. You will operate as a Team of One. With AI tooling and strong engineering infrastructure, one engineer can now build what used to take a whole squad. You won't be implementing tickets. You'll own the product.

Responsibilities

    Feature & Module Ownership

  • Translate business goals into working, deployable systems.
  • Propose architecture, data models, workflows and implementation plans for your modules, then refine them with Tech Leads and Engineering Managers before you build.
  • Own modules end to end: design, release, post-launch stability and ongoing improvements.
  • Design clean, versioned, well-documented APIs as a core part of every feature, so the platform can be integrated wherever it's needed.

    • Rapid Prototyping & Iteration

  • Turn ambiguous ideas into working demos quickly, using AI to build and iterate fast.
  • Validate through experiments and real user feedback, then iterate to production quality.
  • Drive feature attribution and metrics visibility so every release is measurable.

    • Scale, Performance & Reliability

  • Build and maintain the Email ecosystem, designing for scalability, reliability and data integrity at 40M+ emails/day.
  • Evolve our sending infrastructure, including IP pool management, dedicated IPs and domains, and shared domain pools, to protect sender reputation and maximize inbox placement.
  • Build robust error handling: idempotent processing, retries with backoff and graceful degradation.
  • Optimize frontend rendering, component architecture, lazy loading and state management. Tune backend queries, caching (Redis/CDN) and latency at scale.
  • Design data models and analytics on ClickHouse, MongoDB and Firestore.
  • Reason through token consumption, inference cost and infrastructure tradeoffs when integrating AI and LLMs.

    • Engineering Quality & Security

  • Practice test-driven development and hold a high bar for automated test coverage.
  • Build securely by default: authentication, secrets management and safe handling of customer data and PII.

    • Operational Excellence

  • Instrument systems with monitoring and telemetry.
  • Build evaluation loops for continuous quality improvement.
  • Automate workflows that increase engineering velocity.
  • Keep documentation clear and repeatable.

Requirements

  • 4+ years building and running production systems, including owning them when they broke: the on-call, the incident and the fix.
  • Node.js (TypeScript) at scale: You've shipped and operated high-throughput backends (queues, workers, retries, millions of events a day) and built real product UIs in Vue.js (or React).
  • Systems that grew: You've designed or re-architected a system for 10x growth and can explain the tradeoffs you made in queues, caching, partitioning and storage.
  • Data you can trust: You've built pipelines where losing or duplicating a record wasn't acceptable, using idempotency, deduplication, reconciliation and error handling that fails loudly, not quietly.
  • Data modelling & analytics: You've modelled data for transactional and analytical workloads, and made queries fast over billions of rows in ClickHouse (or BigQuery, Snowflake or similar).
  • Cloud in production: You've run services on GCP orAWS (Kubernetes, Pub/Sub or SQS, managed databases, IAM).
  • Quality & security by habit: You write tests first or alongside code (TDD), and treat auth, secrets, PII and abuse prevention as part of the design, not a review step.
  • AI in the product: You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-powered feature to real users and can walk through the model choice, prompts, evals, cost and latency.
  • AI in your workflow: You use AI coding tools every day, go from idea to working prototype in hours or days, and still own and stand behind every line that ships.
  • Problem solving & ownership: You take vague problems, break them down and get to a working answer without waiting for a ticket.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Go (Golang).
  • Experience in the email domain: email rendering, templates, SMTP/ESPs, or deliverability (IP warm-up, sender reputation, SPF/DKIM/DMARC).
  • Experience with data pipelines, analytics or telemetry.
  • Strong UX and front-end sensibility.
  • A portfolio or GitHub showing deployed systems.

raw.excerpt: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution.
raw.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are seeking a Technical Content Creator to showcase the practical power of Tether's peer-to-peer stack. This is a builder-centric role designed for an engineer or highly technical creator who bridges the gap between low-level infrastructure, cryptography, and functional application.

We are not looking for a social media marketer or an on-camera influencer. We are looking for a technical storyteller who can write code, spin up peer-to-peer nodes, build functional Bare-powered applications, and record polished, clear, screen-share demos. You will turn our core stack (Pear and Bare) into an ongoing series of visual, practical "build-in-public" prototypes that prove to the world what true decentralized, peer-to-peer infrastructure looks like.

Responsibilities

  • Build Practical Demos: Independently build functional peer-to-peer applications and infrastructure setups using the Pear platform and the Bare runtime with minimal engineering hand-holding.

  • Record Technical Demos: Record clear, engaging, and high-quality screen-share walkthroughs and video demos of your builds, highlighting how the code works, how peers discover and sync with each other, and the value the systems deliver.

  • Translate Code to Content: Turn complex protocol updates, cryptographic primitives, and technical documentation into highly visual, digestible developer content (such as code-along videos, step-by-step guides, and interactive repositories).

  • Collaborate with Core Devs: Work closely with our P2P protocol and product engineering teams to stay ahead of upcoming Pear and Bare features.

  • Prototypes: Rapidly prototype application concepts — such as spinning up a peer-to-peer chat, file-sync, or data-replication demo — to show how quickly developers can launch resilient, serverless products using our ecosystem.

  • Fuel Influencer-Led Developer Adoption: Collaborate with technical influencers, developer advocates, and content creators to amplify our ecosystem. You will provide them with turn-key technical assets, co-create code-along challenges, and arm them with the high-quality demos and prototypes needed to inspire and onboard new developers to Pear and Bare.

Requirements

  • 3 to 6+ years of experience in a technical role such as Technical Content Creation, Solutions Engineering, or Backend/Systems Development.

  • Strong Programming Skills: Proficiency in languages used across our ecosystem (such as NodeJS, C/C++) to interact confidently with peer-to-peer networking and runtime internals.

  • Domain Expertise: Solid understanding of peer-to-peer (P2P) networking, distributed systems, hypercore/append-only-log style data structures, and decentralized application architecture.

  • Demo/Video Production Skills: Experience recording and editing polished technical screen-shares, terminal recordings, or video tutorials (using tools like Loom, Camtasia, Screenflow, etc.).

  • Developer Empathy: The ability to look at a complex P2P protocol or runtime and understand exactly what kind of demo or sample project will get developers and infrastructure operators excited to start building.

  • Self-Starter Mindset: Comfortable working autonomously in a remote, distributed environment across global time zones.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

raw.description:
Thriveworks is currently seeking Licensed Clinicians to provide telehealth sessions in the evenings and on weekends in Ohio.

About the job

Thriveworks is a mental health care company founded by clinicians in 2008 and still led by them today. With 340+ locations and a nationwide hybrid care model, we serve over 175,000 clients annually through more than 1.7 million sessions, and we're growing. In addition to working directly with clients, we partner with health systems and primary care providers because we believe mental health is inseparable from physical health. As a clinician-led organization, we're built to support the people who do this work with the tools, community, and stability you need to build a career that lasts.

About the Role

We’re hiring licensed clinicians to provide compassionate, evidence-based care to our more than 175,000 clients across the country. You may be a good fit for this role if you’re:

  • Independently licensed and living in Ohio — LPCC, LMFT, LISW, PhD (Licensed Psychologist)

  • Consistently available to clients for a minimum of 10 sessions with 15 hours of availability weekly

  • A behavioral health generalist who is open to treating a variety of clients, including couples and children

  • Invested in helping your clients achieve measurable progress

  • Confident working with modern clinical technology, including telehealth and EHR tools

  • A good teammate — we’re building a clinical community and value positive contributors

Compensation

Up to $25,200.00 based on licensure type, session volume, and bonus opportunities.

How We Support You

We handle the administrative work so you can focus on what you do best: providing exceptional care. That means credentialing, billing, scheduling, and marketing support taken care of for you, plus paid orientation and training to get you started. You'll build a full caseload within 90 days of credentialing, with flexible scheduling available seven days a week from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. ET.

Benefits

As a W2 employee, you'll be eligible to receive:

  • Guaranteed bi-weekly pay for completed sessions

  • 401(k) with employer matching

  • Paid time off

  • CEU reimbursement and free in-house training

  • Opportunities for paid clinical supervisor roles in select states

Our Community

Being a clinician can feel isolating, especially in a telehealth world. We're built to make sure it doesn't. You'll have access to live clinical support, monthly case consultations, and a vibrant online and in-person community of more than 2,700 licensed providers. All clinical leadership is promoted from within, so the people supporting you have been exactly where you are.

Ready to Join Us?
Apply today to become part of a team that’s changing mental health care for clients and clinicians alike.


Interested in joining Team Thriveworks? We're thrilled to meet you!


With Job scams becoming more and more frequent, here's how to know you're speaking with a real member of our team:

  • Our recruiters and other team members will only email you from or an @thriveworks.com email address.
  • Our recruiters and other team members may also contact you via text or phone to schedule an interview.
  • A google meets interview invitation will be sent via email and will only come from an @thriveworks.com email address.
  • Our interviews will take place over Google Meet (not Microsoft Teams, Zoom, or any other platform).
  • We will never ask you to purchase or send us equipment.

If you see a scam related to Thriveworks, please report it to . You can contact with any questions or concerns.


Thriveworks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our people are our most valuable assets. We embrace and encourage differences in age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, national origin, physical and mental ability, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, and other characteristics that make our employees unique. We encourage and welcome diverse candidates to apply for any position you are qualified for to bring your unique perspective to our team.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship, either now or in the future.

By clicking Apply, you acknowledge that Thriveworks may contact you regarding your application.
