raw.excerpt: TL;DRFast-growing measurement company looking for a seller to build pipeline and win new business with agencies and brands.
raw.description:
TL;DR

Fast-growing measurement company looking for a seller to build pipeline and win new business with agencies and brands. This is a full-cycle sales role: you'll prospect, run discovery, take part in pitches, and learn to close alongside senior sellers. Ideal if you're ready for your first full AE seat, whether you're coming from an SDR/BDR role, account management, or agency-side media. You should understand how digital media works and be excited to sell a category that's still being defined.

Who we are

Adelaide is the leader in one of the fastest-growing areas of advertising: attention measurement and activation.

Since 2020, we've become the trusted media quality measurement partner for 40% of Fortune 50 brands who rely on our award-winning AU metric to plan smarter campaigns, invest in high-quality inventory, and dive stronger business outcomes. Adweek has called Adelaide's AU "the attention economy's most widely recognized metric," and AdExchanger named it "Best measurement/Analytics Capability."

Our business continues to scale rapidly, outperforming the industry with a 35% three-year CAGR. What began as a 9-person startup in 2019 is now a team of more than 75.

The past year brought meaningful expansion. We launched the AU ecosystem, giving brands, media agencies, and publishers a unified way to leverage and transact on AU. We broadened our programmatic footprint with custom bidding in GoogleDV360 and pre-bid targeting in The Trade Desk, and grew our partner roster to over 125 platforms and publishers. Leading brands like Dell, Diageo, an Jaguar Land Rover—along with premium publishers such as Hearst, Spotify, and The New York Times—continue to demonstrate AU's value across the media lifecycle.

Adelaide is backed by prominent investors such as Human Ventures (Joe Marchese), Aperiam Ventures (Joe Zawadzki & Eric Franchi), WGI (Jonah Goodhart), and Irwin Gotlieb.

We have a NYC office and a London WeWork, but operates as a remote-friendly company with flexible work options.

How we work

We're a team of action-oriented doers—management rolls up their sleeves and contributes every day. Our culture is rooted in curiosity and rigor: opinions are held lightly, debated openly, and strengthened through testing. Everyone is encouraged to play a role in shaping planning and strategy.

We're built on belonging and growth—94% of employees report a strong sense of belonging, and 87% say they’re happy at work.

Position overview

This position reports to the VP of Sales (West) and focuses on building pipeline and winning new business with agencies and brands. Your day-to-day will center on researching target accounts, running outbound outreach, and setting meetings with agency and brand decision-makers across Analytics, Activation, and Planning, then carrying those opportunities forward with support from senior sellers. You'll help prepare and deliver pitches and work with our Product, Customer Success, and Technical Account Management teams to get pilots live and support client retention. You'll keep your pipeline clean in HubSpot and represent Adelaide at industry events.

You'll start with a territory, a strong product, a category with real momentum, and senior sellers who will teach you how to run a full cycle. You won't inherit a book of business, so you'll build your own. Over time, you'll take on larger accounts and own more of the close.

This is a remote role with regional requirements; candidates must reside in the Los Angeles area to support in-market meetings and client engagement.

Compensation:

The scope and level of responsibility will be calibrated based on experience, with opportunities to take on increasing autonomy and strategic impact over time.

This role offers a competitive compensation package consisting of a base salary plus performance-based commission, with commission making up approximately 35% of total On-Target Earnings (OTE).

Base Salary Range: $95,000 - $110,000

OTE Range: $146,000 - $170,000

Final compensation will be calibrated based on experience and the level at which the candidate is hired.

What you'll learn

An important part of our culture is continuous learning and the open sharing of ideas. We offer:

  • Access to a broad network of investors and advisors who can help you and your team succeed
  • Mentorship from executives with decades of experience in adtech and media
  • Regular internal knowledge-sharing sessions
  • An education budget to support ongoing professional growth and development

In this role you'll learn:

  • The media quality ecosystem—including verification, MTA, MMM, and emerging attention-based measurement tools
  • How digital media “pipes” work and influence media quality and performance
  • How to build a territory plan and generate qualified pipeline from a cold start
  • How to run discovery with media, analytics, and investment stakeholders at agencies and brands
  • Best practices for supporting a full pitch cycle with agencies, brands, publishers, and platforms
  • How to move an account from first conversation through pilot to renewal
  • How to partner cross-functionally to solve client challenges and support successful campaigns
  • How to read a media plan and translate measurement data into a commercial story
  • Skills that drive ownership, adaptability, and resilience in a fast-moving environment

Core responsibilities

  • Sell an innovative approach to rating and measuring media quality
  • Own top-of-funnel: research target accounts, build prospect lists, and run consistent multi-channel outreach to generate qualified meetings
  • Conduct discovery calls with media planners, buyers, analytics leads, and brand marketers to understand where measurement gaps exist
  • Support and, over time, lead pitch processes that can involve publishers, agencies, and brands
  • Build and deepen relationships with day-to-day contacts across agency holding companies, major independents, and brand teams—the planners and buyers who become tomorrow’s decision-makers
  • Partner with Client Success and Technical Account Management to scope pilots, troubleshoot issues, and turn pilots into renewals
  • Maintain accurate opportunity, activity, and forecast data in our CRM (HubSpot)
  • Become fluent in the AU metric and our case studies so you can explain the methodology credibly without an engineer in the room
  • Bring market intelligence back to the team—competitive moves, objections you’re hearing, and where the pitch is landing or missing
  • Represent Adelaide at industry events and contribute to our presence in the market

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 1–3 years of experience in adtech, media measurement, digital media, or agency media, including SDR/BDR, account management (with upsell or renewal goals), media planning or buying, or account coordination roles
  • A firm understanding of how digital media works: the difference between a DSP and an SSP, what an insertion order is, why viewability and attention are not the same thing
  • Genuine willingness to prospect. This role starts with outreach, and the people who succeed here like that part
  • Strong written and verbal communication—you can write an email a busy media director actually replies to
  • Comfort with data and numbers; you can build a simple deck or pull a takeaway out of a spreadsheet without hand-holding
  • Resilience and a positive attitude. Category creation means hearing “we already have viewability” a lot and staying sharp anyway
  • Organization and follow-through: you keep your own pipeline honest without being chased

What will set you apart

  • Existing relationships at agency holding companies or large independents, at any level
  • Experience selling or supporting the sale of media measurement, verification, or analytics products
  • Understanding of programmatic advertising and knowledge of the major players
  • Agency-side experience planning or buying digital media—you’ve been the person on the other side of this pitch
  • A track record of hitting or exceeding a meetings, pipeline, or revenue target
  • Familiarity with verification, MTA, MMM, brand lift, or incrementality testing
  • Hands-on experience with a CRM and outreach tooling (HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo)
  • Comfort representing a technical or measurement product externally
  • Evidence of building something—a process, a playbook, a territory—rather than only working inside one

Benefits

Health & Wellness

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Parental leave
  • Employee development & wellness stipend
  • Holiday break
  • Volunteer time off

Financial & Compensation

  • Competitive salary
  • Performance-based quarterly bonus
  • Stock options
  • 401(k) retirement plan

Workplace & Equipment

  • Remote-first environment
  • New York office access
  • Access to available WeWork spaces

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

Adelaide is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where all employees can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Our commitment to equal opportunity employment extends beyond basic compliance to encompass the active cultivation of a workplace that values different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences.

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

As part of the Product Engineering organization, the DevOps Engineering Manager will lead a team responsible for building, operating, and continuously improving cloud platform capabilities that support highly available, scalable, and secure services.

This role blends hands-on technical leadership with people and operational management. You will be accountable for platform reliability, execution excellence, and team growth, while partnering closely with Product Engineering, Platform, and SRE leaders to deliver resilient cloud infrastructure at scale.

The ideal candidate is a strong technical leader with production experience, a passion for operational excellence, and proven ability to mentor engineers and drive outcomes in fast-paced environments.

The position involves shift-aligned coverage with U.S. Pacific Time hours and ownership of an on-call rotation, including escalation management.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the reliability, availability, and performance of cloud platforms supporting production services.
  • Provide technical direction and review for architecture, automation, and operational improvements.
  • Drive continuous improvement in reliability metrics such as availability, MTTD, MTTR, and incident reduction.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of DevOps engineers through coaching, feedback, and career development.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, learning, and operational excellence.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, performance management, and succession planning.
  • Balance workload, shift coverage, and on-call rotations to maintain team health and sustainability.
  • Own incident response processes, including escalation, coordination, and communication.
  • Work closely with Product Engineering, Platform, SRE, and Delivery teams to enable fast, reliable software releases.
  • Establish and evolve operational processes, runbooks, and documentation standards.

Requirements:

  • 8–12+ years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, SRE, or production operations.
  • 3–5+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams (formal or technical leadership).
  • Strong hands-on background supporting production systems and incident response.
  • Experience operating and managing public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, OpenStack); data center experience preferred.
  • Deep understanding of:
    • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible)
    • Containers and orchestration (Kubernetes, Helm, Docker)
    • CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows (e.g., GitLab)
    • Networking, databases, and distributed systems
  • Proven ability to balance hands-on technical depth with people and delivery management.

raw.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Please note: This is a fully remote position, open to all qualified candidates residing in the United States.



Under general direction, the Sr Business Intelligence Analyst serves as the dedicated analytics resource for the Supply Chain Consulting team, converting complex pharmacy, healthcare supply chain, financial, and operational data into insights, dashboards, models, and recommendations that support customer engagements, business cases, and performance improvement initiatives.


Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

Analytics, Business Intelligence & Modeling

  • Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting tools, and standardized analytical models to support Supply Chain Consulting engagements.
  • Analyze complex pharmacy, procurement, inventory, medication utilization, distribution, labor, and financial data to identify operational and financial improvement opportunities.
  • Create analytical methodologies, financial models, pro formas, scenario analyses, and ROI assessments to support customer business cases and strategic recommendations.
  • Translate data findings into actionable insights, executive-ready outputs, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Establish data validation, quality control, and reporting processes to ensure accuracy, consistency, and scalability of analytical deliverables.

Consulting Engagement Support

  • Serve as the analytics lead for customer-facing consulting engagements, including pharmacy operations, inventory optimization, procurement, and centralized distribution initiatives.
  • Support customer discovery, data intake, analytical scoping, and translation of customer requirements into measurable analytical frameworks and business outcomes.

raw.description:
Job Title: Amazon Content Manager (m/f/d)

Your Responsibilities

  • Analyze and optimize existing Amazon listings across eight European marketplaces.

  • Improve SEO titles, bullet points, product descriptions, and backend search terms.

  • Review and optimize product images and A+ Content.

  • Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis.

  • Identify opportunities to improve product visibility, listing quality, and conversion rates.

  • Prioritize optimization tasks and document changes systematically.

  • Monitor listing performance and evaluate the results of optimizations.

  • Use AI tools, spreadsheets, and standardized workflows to work efficiently across a large product portfolio.

Your Profile

  • Strong analytical and structured working skills.

  • Excellent attention to detail and an understanding of customer needs.

  • Good writing skills and a feel for clear, persuasive product communication.

  • Confident use of Excel or Google Sheets.

  • Interest in e-commerce, SEO, product presentation, and data analysis.

  • Ability to manage multiple products and tasks independently.

  • Willingness to learn new tools, processes, and marketplace requirements.

  • Previous Amazon experience is an advantage but not essential if the required skills can be demonstrated in other ways.

  • Knowledge of German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Swedish, or English is a plus, but fluency in all target languages is not required.

What Matters Most to Us

We are looking for someone who does not simply change product texts or images, but can identify which improvement is most likely to make a meaningful difference for a specific product.

The ideal candidate combines analytical thinking, visual judgment, attention to detail, and a structured approach to improving existing listings across multiple marketplaces.

Requirements

Role Requirements & Interview Guide

1. What Skills Should the Candidate Have?

The main responsibility of this role is to optimize existing Amazon listings across multiple European marketplaces, including Germany, France, Spain, Italy, the UK, the Netherlands, Ireland, and Sweden.

The goal is to improve product visibility, listing quality, and conversion rates by optimizing product images, SEO content, and A+ Content.

Fluency in all target languages is not required. Language skills are a bonus, but the candidate's ability to analyze, optimize, and improve existing listings is more important.

A. Amazon SEO & Keyword Optimization — Very Important

The candidate should be able to:

  • Research and identify relevant keywords for different products and marketplaces.

  • Optimize product titles, bullet points, product descriptions, and backend search terms.

  • Integrate important keywords naturally without making texts repetitive or difficult to read.

  • Understand customer search intent and distinguish between broad keywords and specific long-tail keywords.

  • Identify missing keywords and opportunities to improve organic visibility.

  • Understand how Amazon SEO differs from traditional website SEO.

B. Product Image Optimization — Very Important

The candidate should be able to:

  • Evaluate existing product images and identify weaknesses.

  • Understand what makes a strong main image and an effective set of secondary images.

  • Recommend improvements to image quality, order, messaging, and visual presentation.

  • Ensure that product benefits and features are communicated clearly.

  • Identify which product details customers need to see before making a purchase.

  • Create clear briefs for graphic designers or other team members.

  • Understand Amazon's image requirements and guidelines.

C. A+ Content Optimization

The candidate should be able to:

  • Review existing A+ Content and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Structure content in a logical and visually appealing way.

  • Communicate product benefits, materials, features, and use cases effectively.

  • Combine images, headlines, text, and comparison modules appropriately.

  • Ensure consistency between A+ Content, product images, and listing text.

  • Understand how A+ Content can support customer confidence and purchase decisions.

D. Data Analysis & Performance Measurement — Very Important

The candidate should be able to:

  • Understand key metrics such as sessions, conversion rate, orders, and sales revenue.

  • Identify potential visibility problems versus conversion problems.

  • Compare performance before and after listing changes.

  • Develop hypotheses and prioritize improvements based on their potential impact.

  • Document results and learn from successful and unsuccessful optimizations.

  • Understand that changes in performance do not automatically prove that a specific optimization caused the change.

E. International Marketplace Management

The candidate should be able to:

  • Work systematically across multiple European Amazon marketplaces.

  • Understand that search behavior, keywords, and customer expectations can differ between countries.

  • Use keyword research, translation tools, and AI tools effectively.

  • Check translated content for accuracy, completeness, and consistency with product specifications.

  • Recognize when a native speaker or professional linguistic review is necessary.

  • Maintain consistent product information and brand communication across all marketplaces.

Knowledge of German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Swedish, is an advantage, but fluency in every language is not required.

F. Organization & Implementation

The candidate should be able to:

  • Manage multiple products and marketplaces simultaneously.

  • Prioritize tasks according to their expected impact.

  • Document changes clearly and consistently.

  • Work confidently with Excel or Google Sheets.

  • Follow established workflows and quality-control procedures.

  • Check product information and variations carefully before making changes.

  • Ideally, have experience with Amazon Seller Central and bulk uploads via flat files.

Important Soft Skills

The following characteristics are particularly important:

  • Analytical thinking: Makes decisions based on data and logical reasoning.

  • Attention to detail: Identifies errors, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Customer orientation: Understands what customers need to know before purchasing a product.

  • Initiative: Identifies optimization opportunities independently instead of waiting for instructions.

  • Structured working style: Can manage many products and tasks systematically.

  • Learning ability: Learns new tools, processes, and marketplace requirements quickly.

  • Quality awareness: Checks work carefully before changes go live.

  • Results orientation: Wants to understand whether an optimization actually improves performance.

Previous Amazon experience is valuable, but it should not be the only selection criterion. A candidate with strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn may also be a good fit.

Highlights

About us

Hey there! We're Lleverage, and we're making the Autonomous Back Office actually achievable for businesses. We enable European companies to integrate AI agents into their business, because AI is only useful when it actually fits into daily operations.

We help the most strategic European industries – manufacturing, logistics, and wholesale – automate the messy, manual processes that most tools can’t handle.

We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed scale-up based in Amsterdam, with big ambitions for 2027 and beyond. This is your chance to join early, have real impact, and grow alongside the company. If that sounds something you want to help build, we'd love to have you on board!

About the role

We're looking for a Go-To-Market Lead to open and lead the German market for Lleverage. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role: you set the strategy for Germany, build the first pipeline yourself, close our first German customers and own the German number. You'll work directly with our founding team, including our CCO, and you'll be the face of Lleverage in Germany.

As the market grows, you'll lead a small German pod. A Go-To-Market Associate will join you to run revops and German-language outreach and calling, and a Forward Deployed Engineer will join once the first deals are signed, to deliver for those customers.

Responsibilities

  • Open and lead the German market: build pipeline from scratch and close our first German customers, focused on mid-size and larger manufacturing, logistics and wholesale companies

  • Own the German number: set targets with the founding team and be accountable for pipeline and revenue in Germany

  • Own the full sales cycle: from first contact to signed contract, including C-level conversations and complex, multi-stakeholder deals

  • Build the German playbook: ICP, German-language messaging, channels and partners

  • Lead the pod: coach the Go-To-Market Associate on pipeline and work with the Forward Deployed Engineer on first deliveries

  • Represent Lleverage: with German customers, partners and at industry events

  • Work directly with the founding team: on strategy, targets, approach and customer feedback

  • Bring insights: from German customers back into product development

Requirements

What we’re looking for

  • Around 10 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex deals and hitting targets

  • You have opened a market or built a sales territory from scratch before, and you have taken ownership of a number

  • A senior seller who still loves running deals yourself and is ready to lead a small team as it grows, not a sales executive who manages from a distance

  • You're an excellent relationship builder. You win trust fast, communicate with confidence at all levels, and genuinely enjoy the process of turning a cold conversation into a long-term partnership.

  • You're commercially sharp and consultative. You understand that the best outcomes come from genuinely understanding someone's pain, not pitching a product. You listen well and use data to shape your priorities.

  • You're energised by ambiguity. A new market with no playbook excites you rather than stops you.

  • Native-level German and fluent English

  • Based in Germany, or in the Netherlands

Nice to haves

A network in the German Mittelstand. Experience in B2B sales, partnerships, or business development. Background in SaaS, AI, or Consultancy. Networks in manufacturing, wholesale, distribution or the PE industry. Previous entrepreneurial experience is a big plus, built something, ran something, grew something. 50% of our team are former founders, that tells you something.

Why Lleverage?

Change the world, literally. Traditional industries are sitting on a massive AI opportunity and most of them haven't been reached yet. You'll be the one opening those doors.

Work, learn, have fun. We're building one of the strongest commercial teams in Europe. You'll work directly with the founding team, surrounded by exceptional talent, and genuinely enjoy the people around you.

Build a unique network. Lleverage is a global top AI brand. You'll connect with industry leaders and some of the most important operators in tech and traditional industry.

Get autonomy and ownership. You design the approach, build the relationships, own the results, and grow with the company.

Compensation. Competitive salary depending on experience, strong bonus structure (fi we win you win), and an excellent share package that makes this genuinely worth betting on.

raw.description:
About Learning Sandbox

We create learning experiences that engage, empower and inspire. Learning Sandbox is a global learning consultancy bringing together learning, creativity and technology to help organisations solve meaningful learning challenges.

Our work spans digital learning, education, science, technology and everything in between. We work with ambitious organisations and multidisciplinary teams to turn complex ideas into experiences that are clear, engaging and impactful.

We’re a curious, collaborative team that cares about putting people first, growing together and doing exceptional work that enriches the world.

About our client: LabXchange

LabXchange is a nonprofit education project based at Harvard University. Too many students, whether because of economic or geographic limitations, lack access to high-quality science education and the chance to engage meaningfully in the scientific process. Globally, this has led to significant gaps in diversity across scientific fields and in scientific literacy overall. LabXchange believes students everywhere should have an equal opportunity to prepare for and succeed in science.

To make that real, LabXchange offers the best of digital science education to teachers and students around the world, for free, through an advanced, flexible and interactive learning platform. It goes well beyond text, video and multiple-choice questions, with virtual lab simulations, interactive animations, experimental design simulations and a knowledge graph that can be remixed into customised learning pathways. Social features like private classes, discussion forums and mentorship connect learners with educators.

About the role

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own growth for the LabXchange platform: more learners and educators finding it, and more of them coming back. You'll set the growth strategy, turn data into a clear roadmap, and work with engineering, design, content and marketing to ship experiments that move acquisition, activation and engagement. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable in a dashboard as in a roadmap review.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the growth strategy for LabXchange across acquisition, activation, engagement and retention, and turn it into a prioritised roadmap. This will include the USA and a global strategy.
  • Grow the user base by finding and scaling the channels that bring in students, educators and institutions, including organic search, marketing, partnerships and referral loops.
  • Increase engagement by improving onboarding, discovery and the paths that bring learners and educators back week after week.
  • Lead with data. Define the growth metrics, build and maintain dashboards, run funnel and cohort analysis, and use the findings to decide what to build next.
  • Run a steady experimentation programme: form hypotheses, design A/B tests, size impact and share what you learn.
  • Drive SEO and content discoverability with content and engineering teams, so our simulations, lessons and pathways reach people searching for them.
  • Manage the core library experience: how learners and educators find, browse and reach the right content, and how the library is organised so that it happens quickly. Manage the development and redesign of the LabXchange platform.
  • Work across teams with engineering, design, content, marketing and partners, and keep stakeholders and funders informed on progress and results.
  • Manage stakeholders and projects across multiple capabilities (engineering, design, content, marketing and partners), keeping priorities, timelines, dependencies and expectations aligned from kickoff through delivery.
  • Keep stakeholders in the loop. Announce releases in various Slack channels and facilitate catchups with various stakeholders.
  • Bring in the user's voice through interviews, surveys and usability testing with students and educators around the world.
  • Manage a multi-timezone team to achieve LabXchange’s growth goals.

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager who can own growth end to end, make sense of the data and confidently lead the work that gets more learners and educators using LabXchange.

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in product management, with a strong track record in growth.
  • Proven results growing a digital product's user base and engagement, with the numbers to show for it.
  • Strong data analytics skills.
  • Hands-on experience running growth tests.
  • Ability to turn analysis into clear priorities and explain them to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working closely with engineering, design and marketing teams.
  • Experience running an outsourced engineering team alongside in-house designers and content staff.
  • Comfortable experimenting with AI tools, especially Claude and Claude Code, to speed up processes and workflows, and open to testing other tools as they emerge.
  • Must be eligible to work in South Africa.

Nice to have

  • SEO experience, including technical SEO, content strategy and keyword research.
  • Experience in education technology, online learning or science content.
  • Experience with mission-driven, non-profit or grant-funded products.
  • Familiarity with growing products for a global audience, including emerging markets.

Next steps

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace, where individual differences are respected, appreciated, and supported.

The next step for shortlisted candidates is to complete a skills alignment assessment. If you do not hear from us after three (3) weeks, please consider your application unsuccessful.

Applications: Learning Sandbox (Pty) Ltd. only accepts applications that have been completed and submitted via BambooHR. We do not accept any third-party applications or applications submitted via email.

raw.description:
Company Description

About EIT RawMaterials

As the world moves towards a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades. Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps in.

EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology, we collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's growing demand for raw materials

Position

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly analytical Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d) to transform complex market and business data into actionable insights that drive strategic decision-making. The successful candidate will lead the design and delivery of advanced analytics solutions, develop impactful visualizations, and partner with stakeholders across the business to provide data-driven recommendations. This role combines deep analytical expertise, business acumen, and strong stakeholder management skills, with a particular focus on commodities, minerals, metals, and critical materials markets.

Tasks and Responsibilities

1. Advanced Analytics, Reporting & Visualization

· Lead the design, development, and maintenance of interactive dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions using Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, Looker, or similar BI platforms.

· Translate complex commodities market data into clear, compelling visual narratives that support executive and operational decision-making.

· Define and maintain enterprise-wide reporting standards, visualization best practices, and dashboard design guidelines.

· Develop scalable self-service BI solutions that empower business users to independently access and analyze data.

· Continuously optimize reporting solutions, incorporating stakeholder feedback and evolving business requirements.

· Drive adoption of analytics solutions through user engagement, training, and continuous improvement initiatives.

2. Data Analysis & Insight Generation

· Perform advanced exploratory and diagnostic analyses across commodity prices, market indices, supply-demand indicators, trade flows, and macroeconomic datasets.

· Identify trends, patterns, correlations, risks, and market opportunities within raw materials, advanced materials, and critical minerals markets.

· Develop meaningful KPIs, scorecards, and performance metrics to monitor market developments and business performance.

· Deliver strategic ad hoc analyses to support leadership decisions, commercial initiatives, market intelligence activities, and corporate reporting.

· Present analytical findings through concise reports, presentations, dashboards, and data storytelling techniques tailored to diverse audiences.

· Provide evidence-based recommendations that support business growth, market positioning, and strategic planning.

3. Data Management, Modelling & Analytics Enablement

· Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and subject matter experts to ensure reliable, scalable, and efficient data pipelines.

· Design and optimize data models, semantic layers, reporting datasets, and analytical frameworks supporting enterprise analytics.

· Define and implement data quality standards, validation processes, and controls to ensure accuracy, consistency, and trust in analytics outputs.

· Support the integration of new internal and external data sources, including APIs, market intelligence platforms, databases, and third-party feeds.

· Document data definitions, transformation logic, business rules, and analytical methodologies to ensure transparency and knowledge sharing.

· Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting processes and improve analytics efficiency.

4. Stakeholder Consulting & Business Partnership

· Act as a trusted analytics advisor to stakeholders across Strategy, Business Development, Procurement, Innovation, Finance, Market Intelligence, and Leadership teams.

· Lead requirements gathering sessions and translate business needs into scalable analytical solutions.

· Influence decision-making by providing objective analysis, insights, and recommendations grounded in data.

· Present complex analytical concepts and findings to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders in a clear and accessible manner.

· Facilitate workshops, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing initiatives to increase data literacy across the organization.

· Mentor junior analysts and contribute to developing analytical capabilities within the team.

· Drive user adoption and engagement through regular feedback collection and enhancement of analytics products.

5. Governance, Innovation & Continuous Improvement

· Champion best practices in data visualization, data storytelling, analytics governance, and reporting standards.

· Ensure compliance with data governance, security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

· Stay current with emerging technologies, methodologies, and market trends in business intelligence, analytics, and commodities markets.

· Evaluate and pilot innovative analytical approaches, including advanced visualizations, predictive analytics, scenario modelling, and forecasting techniques.

· Contribute to the long-term analytics roadmap and continuously improve the organization's data-driven decision-making capabilities.

Qualifications & Experience

Education

· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline.

· Equivalent professional experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data visualization will also be considered.

Professional Experience

· 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Market Intelligence, Commercial Analytics, or a related analytical role.

· Experience working in consulting, professional services, market intelligence, research, commodities, resources, energy, mining, or related industries is highly desirable.

· Strong experience analyzing commodity markets, pricing data, supply-demand dynamics, market indices, trading data, or risk-related datasets.

· Experience within critical minerals, metals, advanced materials, raw materials, energy, or adjacent sectors is preferred.

· Proven track record of delivering impactful business insights, advanced dashboards, and strategic analytical solutions.

· Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and supporting executive decision-making.

Technical Skills

Essential

· Advanced expertise in Power BI or equivalent visualization platforms.

· Strong SQL skills with the ability to work across large and complex datasets.

· Proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Plotly, Matplotlib, Seaborn) and/or R.

· Strong understanding of data modelling concepts including star schema, semantic models, and KPI frameworks.

· Experience working with databases, APIs, ETL/ELT processes, and cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

· Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query, Pivot Tables, data modelling, and complex formulas.

· Strong knowledge of data quality management, validation techniques, and governance principles.

Nice to Have

· Time-series analysis, forecasting, and predictive modelling experience.

· Experience with market data providers, commodity intelligence platforms, and financial data feeds.

· Geospatial analytics and visualization expertise.

· Familiarity with version control tools such as Git.

· Knowledge of scenario modelling, risk analytics, and simulation techniques.

· Exposure to machine learning applications supporting business and market analysis.

Other information

Additional Information & Our Recruitment Process

  • Commitment to Diversity: EIT RawMaterials is committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of background.

  • Employment Type: Temporary Position on a two-year contract with the possibility of extension.

  • Position Location: Germany, Belgium

The position will stay open until a successful candidate is chosen.

  1. Application Review: Our team thoroughly reviews each application. Please make sure to submit your CV in English.

  2. Initial Interview(30 minutes): Meet with the hiring manager and recruitment team.

  3. Second Interview(60 minutes): Second interview with a presentation on a relevant topic to the hiring manager and the HR team.

  4. Offer: If successful, receive an offer to join our team.

Join our team and build your career with momentum as we champion your growth, elevate your ideas and engage you in purpose-driven work that makes a real difference every day.


Who we are

Founded in 1997, Merrick Bank is an FDIC®-insured financial institution headquartered in South Jordan, Utah, with over $10 billion in assets. A wholly owned subsidiary of CardWorks Financial Group, Merrick Bank serves roughly five million cardmembers and more than 100,000 merchant customers nationwide.


What we do

We provide credit cards, recreational loans, deposit accounts, merchant services and bank sponsorships to consumers and businesses. As a leader in non-prime lending and merchant acquiring, we combine innovative technology with data-driven insights to help underserved consumers build and strengthen credit while delivering integrated, scalable payment solutions for businesses.

Merrick Bank ranks among the top 20 FDIC®-insured credit card issuers in the U.S. and among the top 15 merchant acquirers by transaction volume.

Position Summary and Role Impact:

The Director, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), is a second-line risk leader responsible for directing the execution, oversight, and continuous enhancement of Merrick Bank’s (the “Bank”) TPRM Program. The role provides independent review and challenge across the third-party lifecycle, translates third-party risk information into decision-useful insights, and drives timely escalation and remediation of material exposures. This role partners with senior management, Vendor Relationship Owners, Vendor Management, Legal, Information Security, Compliance, Internal Audit, and other first- and second-line stakeholders to promote consistent, risk-based decisions aligned with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and the Bank’s risk appetite.

Essential Functions:

  • Directs the execution and continuous enhancement of the Bank’s TPRM framework across planning, due diligence, selection, contracting, ongoing monitoring, issue management, renewal, and termination, ensuring practices are risk-based, scalable, and aligned with regulatory expectations and internal governance standards.
  • Provides leadership, direction, workload prioritization, coaching, and performance oversight to TPRM team members and functional resources supporting assessments, monitoring, issue management, reporting, and program improvement.
  • Oversees and, when needed, performs risk-based due diligence, risk assessments, control evaluations, and ongoing monitoring across the third-party lifecycle, ensuring work is timely, evidence-based, consistently documented, and commensurate with the relationship’s risk and criticality.
  • Partners with business units, Vendor Relationship Owners, Vendor Engagement Leads, Vendor Management, and Subject Matter Experts to clarify first- and second-line accountabilities; identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate third-party risks; and ensure material changes in scope, performance, or risk profile are evaluated and escalated.
  • Provides independent review and effective challenge of third-party risk assessments, risk ratings, exceptions, control conclusions, and proposed risk responses; documents the basis for challenge and escalates matters that exceed defined thresholds, risk appetite, or approval authority.
  • Oversees monitoring of third-party performance, financial condition, control effectiveness, risk indicators, complaints, incidents, concentration risk, issues, and remediation commitments; identifies trends and emerging risks and escalates material concerns to ERM leadership and applicable governance forums.
  • Leads the development, maintenance, and periodic review of TPRM policies, standards, procedures, methodologies, and workflows to sustain a consistent enterprise operating model and clear accountability across the third-party lifecycle.
  • Develops and presents dashboards, metrics, trend analyses, risk concentrations, material exceptions, and executive summaries that provide clear, decision-useful visibility to Senior Management, risk committees, and the Board of Directors.
  • Partners with Legal, Vendor Management, Information Security, Compliance, Business Continuity, Procurement, and business stakeholders to support risk-proportionate contract provisions, audit and access rights, performance expectations, information-security requirements, resilience obligations, issue escalation, and exit or contingency planning.
  • Owns program quality assurance and regulatory readiness for TPRM, including documentation standards, records in the approved system of record, examination and audit support, management of findings, and evidence of timely corrective action.
  • Drives continuous improvement of TPRM tools, data, workflows, reporting, and GRC capabilities to strengthen data quality, traceability, cycle times, portfolio visibility, and sustainable execution.

Requirements for Success:

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Risk Management, Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, Information Systems, Supply Chain, or a related field required; advanced degree or relevant professional certification (e.g., CTPRP, CTPRA, CRVPM, CRMA, FRM, CPA, CIA, CISM, or CRISC) preferred.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of progressive experience in Third-Party Risk Management, Enterprise Risk Management, Operational Risk, vendor risk, internal audit, compliance, information security risk, or a related discipline within financial services or another highly regulated environment, including demonstrated responsibility for leading people, programs, or material cross-functional initiatives.

Knowledge, Skills and Capabilities:

  • In-depth knowledge of the full third-party lifecycle, risk-tiering methodologies, due diligence, control evaluation, ongoing monitoring, issue management, concentration risk, subcontractor risk, business resilience, and regulatory expectations applicable to financial institutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide independent review and effective challenge, make well-supported risk judgments, distinguish first- and second-line accountability, and escalate material concerns with clear recommendations.
  • Strong expertise in executive and Board-level risk reporting, including dashboards, key risk indicators, portfolio trends, concentrations, exceptions, material issues, and concise written risk assessments.
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex qualitative and quantitative information into clear, decision-useful insights and recommendations for senior management and governance committees.
  • Proven ability to lead teams and cross-functional initiatives, influence senior stakeholders, resolve accountability gaps, and maintain an independent risk perspective while enabling timely business decisions.

Compliance with Laws & Regulations

  • Responsible for complying with all the Bank’s internal control policies and procedures.
  • Responsible for understanding and complying with all laws and regulations to which the Bank is subject.
  • Responsible for communicating problems in operations, noncompliance with the code of conduct, noncompliance with laws and regulations, policy violations, or illegal acts.

We believe in putting people first by supporting our customers, employees and our partners while creating opportunities for everyone to reach their potential. From fostering work-life balance to rewarding good work and innovative ideas, we invest in what matters most, our people.

raw.excerpt: Job Title: Amazon Content Manager (m/f/d) Your Responsibilities • Analyze and optimize existing Amazon listings across eight European marketplaces.
raw.description:
Job Title: Amazon Content Manager (m/f/d)

Your Responsibilities

  • Analyze and optimize existing Amazon listings across eight European marketplaces.

  • Improve SEO titles, bullet points, product descriptions, and backend search terms.

  • Review and optimize product images and A+ Content.

  • Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis.

  • Identify opportunities to improve product visibility, listing quality, and conversion rates.

  • Prioritize optimization tasks and document changes systematically.

  • Monitor listing performance and evaluate the results of optimizations.

  • Use AI tools, spreadsheets, and standardized workflows to work efficiently across a large product portfolio.

Your Profile

  • Strong analytical and structured working skills.

  • Excellent attention to detail and an understanding of customer needs.

  • Good writing skills and a feel for clear, persuasive product communication.

  • Confident use of Excel or Google Sheets.

  • Interest in e-commerce, SEO, product presentation, and data analysis.

  • Ability to manage multiple products and tasks independently.

  • Willingness to learn new tools, processes, and marketplace requirements.

  • Previous Amazon experience is an advantage but not essential if the required skills can be demonstrated in other ways.

  • Knowledge of German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Swedish, or English is a plus, but fluency in all target languages is not required.

What Matters Most to Us

We are looking for someone who does not simply change product texts or images, but can identify which improvement is most likely to make a meaningful difference for a specific product.

The ideal candidate combines analytical thinking, visual judgment, attention to detail, and a structured approach to improving existing listings across multiple marketplaces.

Requirements

Role Requirements & Interview Guide

1. What Skills Should the Candidate Have?

The main responsibility of this role is to optimize existing Amazon listings across multiple European marketplaces, including Germany, France, Spain, Italy, the UK, the Netherlands, Ireland, and Sweden.

The goal is to improve product visibility, listing quality, and conversion rates by optimizing product images, SEO content, and A+ Content.

Fluency in all target languages is not required. Language skills are a bonus, but the candidate's ability to analyze, optimize, and improve existing listings is more important.

A. Amazon SEO & Keyword Optimization — Very Important

The candidate should be able to:

  • Research and identify relevant keywords for different products and marketplaces.

  • Optimize product titles, bullet points, product descriptions, and backend search terms.

  • Integrate important keywords naturally without making texts repetitive or difficult to read.

  • Understand customer search intent and distinguish between broad keywords and specific long-tail keywords.

  • Identify missing keywords and opportunities to improve organic visibility.

  • Understand how Amazon SEO differs from traditional website SEO.

B. Product Image Optimization — Very Important

The candidate should be able to:

  • Evaluate existing product images and identify weaknesses.

  • Understand what makes a strong main image and an effective set of secondary images.

  • Recommend improvements to image quality, order, messaging, and visual presentation.

  • Ensure that product benefits and features are communicated clearly.

  • Identify which product details customers need to see before making a purchase.

  • Create clear briefs for graphic designers or other team members.

  • Understand Amazon's image requirements and guidelines.

C. A+ Content Optimization

The candidate should be able to:

  • Review existing A+ Content and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Structure content in a logical and visually appealing way.

  • Communicate product benefits, materials, features, and use cases effectively.

  • Combine images, headlines, text, and comparison modules appropriately.

  • Ensure consistency between A+ Content, product images, and listing text.

  • Understand how A+ Content can support customer confidence and purchase decisions.

D. Data Analysis & Performance Measurement — Very Important

The candidate should be able to:

  • Understand key metrics such as sessions, conversion rate, orders, and sales revenue.

  • Identify potential visibility problems versus conversion problems.

  • Compare performance before and after listing changes.

  • Develop hypotheses and prioritize improvements based on their potential impact.

  • Document results and learn from successful and unsuccessful optimizations.

  • Understand that changes in performance do not automatically prove that a specific optimization caused the change.

E. International Marketplace Management

The candidate should be able to:

  • Work systematically across multiple European Amazon marketplaces.

  • Understand that search behavior, keywords, and customer expectations can differ between countries.

  • Use keyword research, translation tools, and AI tools effectively.

  • Check translated content for accuracy, completeness, and consistency with product specifications.

  • Recognize when a native speaker or professional linguistic review is necessary.

  • Maintain consistent product information and brand communication across all marketplaces.

Knowledge of German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Swedish, is an advantage, but fluency in every language is not required.

F. Organization & Implementation

The candidate should be able to:

  • Manage multiple products and marketplaces simultaneously.

  • Prioritize tasks according to their expected impact.

  • Document changes clearly and consistently.

  • Work confidently with Excel or Google Sheets.

  • Follow established workflows and quality-control procedures.

  • Check product information and variations carefully before making changes.

  • Ideally, have experience with Amazon Seller Central and bulk uploads via flat files.

Important Soft Skills

The following characteristics are particularly important:

  • Analytical thinking: Makes decisions based on data and logical reasoning.

  • Attention to detail: Identifies errors, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Customer orientation: Understands what customers need to know before purchasing a product.

  • Initiative: Identifies optimization opportunities independently instead of waiting for instructions.

  • Structured working style: Can manage many products and tasks systematically.

  • Learning ability: Learns new tools, processes, and marketplace requirements quickly.

  • Quality awareness: Checks work carefully before changes go live.

  • Results orientation: Wants to understand whether an optimization actually improves performance.

Previous Amazon experience is valuable, but it should not be the only selection criterion. A candidate with strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn may also be a good fit.

These include paralegal jobs in both law firms and in-house teams, from boutique firms doing niche areas of law to international and US firms, but also banks, financial institutions, media and entertainment companies and much more! Our clients cover a wide range of practice areas.

Opportunities vary from short paralegal roles of a few weeks to longer placements lasting for a few months, but also permanent positions where you would be hired directly by our clients.

The Selection Process

We would review your application and if your skills, experience and qualifications match our requirements, we will contact you to schedule an interview with a member of our recruitment team.

What we look for

  • A law degree or equivalent (LLB/GDL or SQE1) is beneficial and may mean more opportunities will be open to you as some clients require a degree of previous legal training.

  • Previous experience of working within a legal environment is an advantage, but not essential.

Additional Requirements

In general, we are looking for candidates that can demonstrate good core competencies.

  • Highly organised

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Demonstrate strong attention to detail

  • Technologically proficient

  • Capable of working on your own as well as part of a team

  • Confident with good emotional intelligence

When to apply

As paralegal job opportunities arise throughout the year, it is advisable to get your application in to us as quickly as possible. During the selection process we will discuss with you the type of experience you are looking to gain.

Qualifying Work Experience (QWE)

Please note that experience gathered under this role will not be counted as QWE. If you are interested in QWE please make a separate application for Trainee Solicitor opportunities.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Accutrainee

With over 14 years’ experience helping legal professionals find job opportunities, it is easy to understand why Accutrainee is perfectly placed to help you find your next paralegal role. Whatever your circumstances or stage of your career, we are here to help as Your Partner in Law.

We can offer you opportunities at a wide range of in-house legal teams, large city law firms, boutiques, start-ups and everything in between through our Accuflex service.

The application process is quick and easy to complete.

raw.description:
About us

Hey there! We're Lleverage, and we're making the Autonomous Back Office actually achievable for businesses. We enable European companies to integrate AI agents into their business, because AI is only useful when it actually fits into daily operations.

We help the most strategic European industries – manufacturing, logistics, and wholesale – automate the messy, manual processes that most tools can’t handle.

We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed scale-up based in Amsterdam, with big ambitions for 2027 and beyond. This is your chance to join early, have real impact, and grow alongside the company. If that sounds something you want to help build, we'd love to have you on board!

About the role

We're looking for a Go-To-Market Lead to open and lead the German market for Lleverage. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role: you set the strategy for Germany, build the first pipeline yourself, close our first German customers and own the German number. You'll work directly with our founding team, including our CCO, and you'll be the face of Lleverage in Germany.

As the market grows, you'll lead a small German pod. A Go-To-Market Associate will join you to run revops and German-language outreach and calling, and a Forward Deployed Engineer will join once the first deals are signed, to deliver for those customers.

Responsibilities

  • Open and lead the German market: build pipeline from scratch and close our first German customers, focused on mid-size and larger manufacturing, logistics and wholesale companies

  • Own the German number: set targets with the founding team and be accountable for pipeline and revenue in Germany

  • Own the full sales cycle: from first contact to signed contract, including C-level conversations and complex, multi-stakeholder deals

  • Build the German playbook: ICP, German-language messaging, channels and partners

  • Lead the pod: coach the Go-To-Market Associate on pipeline and work with the Forward Deployed Engineer on first deliveries

  • Represent Lleverage: with German customers, partners and at industry events

  • Work directly with the founding team: on strategy, targets, approach and customer feedback

  • Bring insights: from German customers back into product development

Requirements

What we’re looking for

  • Around 10 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex deals and hitting targets

  • You have opened a market or built a sales territory from scratch before, and you have taken ownership of a number

  • A senior seller who still loves running deals yourself and is ready to lead a small team as it grows, not a sales executive who manages from a distance

  • You're an excellent relationship builder. You win trust fast, communicate with confidence at all levels, and genuinely enjoy the process of turning a cold conversation into a long-term partnership.

  • You're commercially sharp and consultative. You understand that the best outcomes come from genuinely understanding someone's pain, not pitching a product. You listen well and use data to shape your priorities.

  • You're energised by ambiguity. A new market with no playbook excites you rather than stops you.

  • Native-level German and fluent English

  • Based in Germany, or in the Netherlands

Nice to haves

A network in the German Mittelstand. Experience in B2B sales, partnerships, or business development. Background in SaaS, AI, or Consultancy. Networks in manufacturing, wholesale, distribution or the PE industry. Previous entrepreneurial experience is a big plus, built something, ran something, grew something. 50% of our team are former founders, that tells you something.

Why Lleverage?

Change the world, literally. Traditional industries are sitting on a massive AI opportunity and most of them haven't been reached yet. You'll be the one opening those doors.

Work, learn, have fun. We're building one of the strongest commercial teams in Europe. You'll work directly with the founding team, surrounded by exceptional talent, and genuinely enjoy the people around you.

Build a unique network. Lleverage is a global top AI brand. You'll connect with industry leaders and some of the most important operators in tech and traditional industry.

Get autonomy and ownership. You design the approach, build the relationships, own the results, and grow with the company.

Compensation. Competitive salary depending on experience, strong bonus structure (fi we win you win), and an excellent share package that makes this genuinely worth betting on.

raw.description:
About Learning Sandbox

We create learning experiences that engage, empower and inspire. Learning Sandbox is a global learning consultancy bringing together learning, creativity and technology to help organisations solve meaningful learning challenges.

Our work spans digital learning, education, science, technology and everything in between. We work with ambitious organisations and multidisciplinary teams to turn complex ideas into experiences that are clear, engaging and impactful.

We’re a curious, collaborative team that cares about putting people first, growing together and doing exceptional work that enriches the world.

About our client: LabXchange

LabXchange is a nonprofit education project based at Harvard University. Too many students, whether because of economic or geographic limitations, lack access to high-quality science education and the chance to engage meaningfully in the scientific process. Globally, this has led to significant gaps in diversity across scientific fields and in scientific literacy overall. LabXchange believes students everywhere should have an equal opportunity to prepare for and succeed in science.

To make that real, LabXchange offers the best of digital science education to teachers and students around the world, for free, through an advanced, flexible and interactive learning platform. It goes well beyond text, video and multiple-choice questions, with virtual lab simulations, interactive animations, experimental design simulations and a knowledge graph that can be remixed into customised learning pathways. Social features like private classes, discussion forums and mentorship connect learners with educators.

About the role

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own growth for the LabXchange platform: more learners and educators finding it, and more of them coming back. You'll set the growth strategy, turn data into a clear roadmap, and work with engineering, design, content and marketing to ship experiments that move acquisition, activation and engagement. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable in a dashboard as in a roadmap review.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the growth strategy for LabXchange across acquisition, activation, engagement and retention, and turn it into a prioritised roadmap. This will include the USA and a global strategy.
  • Grow the user base by finding and scaling the channels that bring in students, educators and institutions, including organic search, marketing, partnerships and referral loops.
  • Increase engagement by improving onboarding, discovery and the paths that bring learners and educators back week after week.
  • Lead with data. Define the growth metrics, build and maintain dashboards, run funnel and cohort analysis, and use the findings to decide what to build next.
  • Run a steady experimentation programme: form hypotheses, design A/B tests, size impact and share what you learn.
  • Drive SEO and content discoverability with content and engineering teams, so our simulations, lessons and pathways reach people searching for them.
  • Manage the core library experience: how learners and educators find, browse and reach the right content, and how the library is organised so that it happens quickly. Manage the development and redesign of the LabXchange platform.
  • Work across teams with engineering, design, content, marketing and partners, and keep stakeholders and funders informed on progress and results.
  • Manage stakeholders and projects across multiple capabilities (engineering, design, content, marketing and partners), keeping priorities, timelines, dependencies and expectations aligned from kickoff through delivery.
  • Keep stakeholders in the loop. Announce releases in various Slack channels and facilitate catchups with various stakeholders.
  • Bring in the user's voice through interviews, surveys and usability testing with students and educators around the world.
  • Manage a multi-timezone team to achieve LabXchange’s growth goals.

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager who can own growth end to end, make sense of the data and confidently lead the work that gets more learners and educators using LabXchange.

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in product management, with a strong track record in growth.
  • Proven results growing a digital product's user base and engagement, with the numbers to show for it.
  • Strong data analytics skills.
  • Hands-on experience running growth tests.
  • Ability to turn analysis into clear priorities and explain them to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working closely with engineering, design and marketing teams.
  • Experience running an outsourced engineering team alongside in-house designers and content staff.
  • Comfortable experimenting with AI tools, especially Claude and Claude Code, to speed up processes and workflows, and open to testing other tools as they emerge.
  • Must be eligible to work in South Africa.

Nice to have

  • SEO experience, including technical SEO, content strategy and keyword research.
  • Experience in education technology, online learning or science content.
  • Experience with mission-driven, non-profit or grant-funded products.
  • Familiarity with growing products for a global audience, including emerging markets.

Next steps

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace, where individual differences are respected, appreciated, and supported.

The next step for shortlisted candidates is to complete a skills alignment assessment. If you do not hear from us after three (3) weeks, please consider your application unsuccessful.

Applications: Learning Sandbox (Pty) Ltd. only accepts applications that have been completed and submitted via BambooHR. We do not accept any third-party applications or applications submitted via email.

raw.description:
Company Description

About EIT RawMaterials

As the world moves towards a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades. Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps in.

EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology, we collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's growing demand for raw materials

Position

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly analytical Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d) to transform complex market and business data into actionable insights that drive strategic decision-making. The successful candidate will lead the design and delivery of advanced analytics solutions, develop impactful visualizations, and partner with stakeholders across the business to provide data-driven recommendations. This role combines deep analytical expertise, business acumen, and strong stakeholder management skills, with a particular focus on commodities, minerals, metals, and critical materials markets.

Tasks and Responsibilities

1. Advanced Analytics, Reporting & Visualization

· Lead the design, development, and maintenance of interactive dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions using Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, Looker, or similar BI platforms.

· Translate complex commodities market data into clear, compelling visual narratives that support executive and operational decision-making.

· Define and maintain enterprise-wide reporting standards, visualization best practices, and dashboard design guidelines.

· Develop scalable self-service BI solutions that empower business users to independently access and analyze data.

· Continuously optimize reporting solutions, incorporating stakeholder feedback and evolving business requirements.

· Drive adoption of analytics solutions through user engagement, training, and continuous improvement initiatives.

2. Data Analysis & Insight Generation

· Perform advanced exploratory and diagnostic analyses across commodity prices, market indices, supply-demand indicators, trade flows, and macroeconomic datasets.

· Identify trends, patterns, correlations, risks, and market opportunities within raw materials, advanced materials, and critical minerals markets.

· Develop meaningful KPIs, scorecards, and performance metrics to monitor market developments and business performance.

· Deliver strategic ad hoc analyses to support leadership decisions, commercial initiatives, market intelligence activities, and corporate reporting.

· Present analytical findings through concise reports, presentations, dashboards, and data storytelling techniques tailored to diverse audiences.

· Provide evidence-based recommendations that support business growth, market positioning, and strategic planning.

3. Data Management, Modelling & Analytics Enablement

· Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and subject matter experts to ensure reliable, scalable, and efficient data pipelines.

· Design and optimize data models, semantic layers, reporting datasets, and analytical frameworks supporting enterprise analytics.

· Define and implement data quality standards, validation processes, and controls to ensure accuracy, consistency, and trust in analytics outputs.

· Support the integration of new internal and external data sources, including APIs, market intelligence platforms, databases, and third-party feeds.

· Document data definitions, transformation logic, business rules, and analytical methodologies to ensure transparency and knowledge sharing.

· Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting processes and improve analytics efficiency.

4. Stakeholder Consulting & Business Partnership

· Act as a trusted analytics advisor to stakeholders across Strategy, Business Development, Procurement, Innovation, Finance, Market Intelligence, and Leadership teams.

· Lead requirements gathering sessions and translate business needs into scalable analytical solutions.

· Influence decision-making by providing objective analysis, insights, and recommendations grounded in data.

· Present complex analytical concepts and findings to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders in a clear and accessible manner.

· Facilitate workshops, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing initiatives to increase data literacy across the organization.

· Mentor junior analysts and contribute to developing analytical capabilities within the team.

· Drive user adoption and engagement through regular feedback collection and enhancement of analytics products.

5. Governance, Innovation & Continuous Improvement

· Champion best practices in data visualization, data storytelling, analytics governance, and reporting standards.

· Ensure compliance with data governance, security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

· Stay current with emerging technologies, methodologies, and market trends in business intelligence, analytics, and commodities markets.

· Evaluate and pilot innovative analytical approaches, including advanced visualizations, predictive analytics, scenario modelling, and forecasting techniques.

· Contribute to the long-term analytics roadmap and continuously improve the organization's data-driven decision-making capabilities.

Qualifications & Experience

Education

· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline.

· Equivalent professional experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data visualization will also be considered.

Professional Experience

· 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Market Intelligence, Commercial Analytics, or a related analytical role.

· Experience working in consulting, professional services, market intelligence, research, commodities, resources, energy, mining, or related industries is highly desirable.

· Strong experience analyzing commodity markets, pricing data, supply-demand dynamics, market indices, trading data, or risk-related datasets.

· Experience within critical minerals, metals, advanced materials, raw materials, energy, or adjacent sectors is preferred.

· Proven track record of delivering impactful business insights, advanced dashboards, and strategic analytical solutions.

· Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and supporting executive decision-making.

Technical Skills

Essential

· Advanced expertise in Power BI or equivalent visualization platforms.

· Strong SQL skills with the ability to work across large and complex datasets.

· Proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Plotly, Matplotlib, Seaborn) and/or R.

· Strong understanding of data modelling concepts including star schema, semantic models, and KPI frameworks.

· Experience working with databases, APIs, ETL/ELT processes, and cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

· Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query, Pivot Tables, data modelling, and complex formulas.

· Strong knowledge of data quality management, validation techniques, and governance principles.

Nice to Have

· Time-series analysis, forecasting, and predictive modelling experience.

· Experience with market data providers, commodity intelligence platforms, and financial data feeds.

· Geospatial analytics and visualization expertise.

· Familiarity with version control tools such as Git.

· Knowledge of scenario modelling, risk analytics, and simulation techniques.

· Exposure to machine learning applications supporting business and market analysis.

Other information

Additional Information & Our Recruitment Process

  • Commitment to Diversity: EIT RawMaterials is committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of background.

  • Employment Type: Temporary Position on a two-year contract with the possibility of extension.

  • Position Location: Germany, Belgium

The position will stay open until a successful candidate is chosen.

  1. Application Review: Our team thoroughly reviews each application. Please make sure to submit your CV in English.

  2. Initial Interview(30 minutes): Meet with the hiring manager and recruitment team.

  3. Second Interview(60 minutes): Second interview with a presentation on a relevant topic to the hiring manager and the HR team.

  4. Offer: If successful, receive an offer to join our team.
