We provide credit cards, recreational loans, deposit accounts, merchant services and bank sponsorships to consumers and businesses. As a leader in non-prime lending and merchant acquiring, we combine innovative technology with data-driven insights to help underserved consumers build and strengthen credit while delivering integrated, scalable payment solutions for businesses.

Merrick Bank ranks among the top 20 FDIC®-insured credit card issuers in the U.S. and among the top 15 merchant acquirers by transaction volume.

Position Summary and Role Impact:

The Director, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), is a second-line risk leader responsible for directing the execution, oversight, and continuous enhancement of Merrick Bank’s (the “Bank”) TPRM Program. The role provides independent review and challenge across the third-party lifecycle, translates third-party risk information into decision-useful insights, and drives timely escalation and remediation of material exposures. This role partners with senior management, Vendor Relationship Owners, Vendor Management, Legal, Information Security, Compliance, Internal Audit, and other first- and second-line stakeholders to promote consistent, risk-based decisions aligned with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and the Bank’s risk appetite.

Essential Functions:

  • Directs the execution and continuous enhancement of the Bank’s TPRM framework across planning, due diligence, selection, contracting, ongoing monitoring, issue management, renewal, and termination, ensuring practices are risk-based, scalable, and aligned with regulatory expectations and internal governance standards.
  • Provides leadership, direction, workload prioritization, coaching, and performance oversight to TPRM team members and functional resources supporting assessments, monitoring, issue management, reporting, and program improvement.
  • Oversees and, when needed, performs risk-based due diligence, risk assessments, control evaluations, and ongoing monitoring across the third-party lifecycle, ensuring work is timely, evidence-based, consistently documented, and commensurate with the relationship’s risk and criticality.
  • Partners with business units, Vendor Relationship Owners, Vendor Engagement Leads, Vendor Management, and Subject Matter Experts to clarify first- and second-line accountabilities; identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate third-party risks; and ensure material changes in scope, performance, or risk profile are evaluated and escalated.
  • Provides independent review and effective challenge of third-party risk assessments, risk ratings, exceptions, control conclusions, and proposed risk responses; documents the basis for challenge and escalates matters that exceed defined thresholds, risk appetite, or approval authority.
  • Oversees monitoring of third-party performance, financial condition, control effectiveness, risk indicators, complaints, incidents, concentration risk, issues, and remediation commitments; identifies trends and emerging risks and escalates material concerns to ERM leadership and applicable governance forums.
  • Leads the development, maintenance, and periodic review of TPRM policies, standards, procedures, methodologies, and workflows to sustain a consistent enterprise operating model and clear accountability across the third-party lifecycle.
  • Develops and presents dashboards, metrics, trend analyses, risk concentrations, material exceptions, and executive summaries that provide clear, decision-useful visibility to Senior Management, risk committees, and the Board of Directors.
  • Partners with Legal, Vendor Management, Information Security, Compliance, Business Continuity, Procurement, and business stakeholders to support risk-proportionate contract provisions, audit and access rights, performance expectations, information-security requirements, resilience obligations, issue escalation, and exit or contingency planning.
  • Owns program quality assurance and regulatory readiness for TPRM, including documentation standards, records in the approved system of record, examination and audit support, management of findings, and evidence of timely corrective action.
  • Drives continuous improvement of TPRM tools, data, workflows, reporting, and GRC capabilities to strengthen data quality, traceability, cycle times, portfolio visibility, and sustainable execution.

Requirements for Success:

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Risk Management, Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, Information Systems, Supply Chain, or a related field required; advanced degree or relevant professional certification (e.g., CTPRP, CTPRA, CRVPM, CRMA, FRM, CPA, CIA, CISM, or CRISC) preferred.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of progressive experience in Third-Party Risk Management, Enterprise Risk Management, Operational Risk, vendor risk, internal audit, compliance, information security risk, or a related discipline within financial services or another highly regulated environment, including demonstrated responsibility for leading people, programs, or material cross-functional initiatives.

Knowledge, Skills and Capabilities:

  • In-depth knowledge of the full third-party lifecycle, risk-tiering methodologies, due diligence, control evaluation, ongoing monitoring, issue management, concentration risk, subcontractor risk, business resilience, and regulatory expectations applicable to financial institutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide independent review and effective challenge, make well-supported risk judgments, distinguish first- and second-line accountability, and escalate material concerns with clear recommendations.
  • Strong expertise in executive and Board-level risk reporting, including dashboards, key risk indicators, portfolio trends, concentrations, exceptions, material issues, and concise written risk assessments.
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex qualitative and quantitative information into clear, decision-useful insights and recommendations for senior management and governance committees.
  • Proven ability to lead teams and cross-functional initiatives, influence senior stakeholders, resolve accountability gaps, and maintain an independent risk perspective while enabling timely business decisions.

Compliance with Laws & Regulations

  • Responsible for complying with all the Bank’s internal control policies and procedures.
  • Responsible for understanding and complying with all laws and regulations to which the Bank is subject.
  • Responsible for communicating problems in operations, noncompliance with the code of conduct, noncompliance with laws and regulations, policy violations, or illegal acts.

About the Hiring Group

We are seeking an early-career Associate Research Scientist to join our Patient-Centered Outcomes Assessment team. This role is ideal for someone with a strong foundation in health outcomes research, epidemiology, psychology, public health, or a related field who is eager to build expertise in patient-centered research and consulting.

Working alongside senior researchers and project managers on multidisciplinary teams, you will support study design and implementation, qualitative analyses, literature reviews, evidence generation, proposal development, and scientific communications. You will also gain exposure to client engagement, portfolio management, and consulting operations, with a structured development path toward independent scientific leadership.

What You'll Do

Essential Duties

  • Support project coordination, including timelines, scheduling, project trackers, deliverable reviews, project files, financial tracking, vendor bids, purchase requisitions, invoicing, and IRB activities under PM/PL oversight.
  • Develop kick-off meeting slides, interview guides, and qualitative analysis plans with guidance from senior scientists.
  • Perform qualitative coding and thematic analysis using established methodologies.
  • Draft sections of study protocols, reports, manuscripts, abstracts, presentations, and client deliverables.
  • Conduct targeted literature reviews and synthesize findings into clear scientific summaries and evidence tables.
  • Ensure scientific quality and adherence to established research methods, SOPs, and quality standards.
  • Build expertise in patient-centered outcomes research methodologies and consulting through progressively increasing responsibility and client engagement.
  • Participate in internal initiatives that improve scientific methods, operational efficiency, and knowledge sharing.

To be successful in this role, you will demonstrate reliability, initiative, sound judgment, and responsiveness to feedback. You will take ownership of assigned work, communicate proactively, collaborate effectively with project and operational teams, and help keep work on track.


What You'll Need

  • Master’s degree or PhD in public health, epidemiology, health outcomes, psychology, sociology, biostatistics, health services research, or a related discipline.
  • Related internship, graduate research assistantship, or consulting experience preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Excel.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet project timelines.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to synthesize scientific information and prepare clear correspondence and project deliverables.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Initiative, curiosity, and commitment to continuous learning.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills and foundational knowledge of qualitative and/or quantitative research methods.

What IT Client Services contributes to Cardinal Health

Information Technology oversees the effective development, delivery, and operation of computing and information services. This function anticipates, plans, and delivers Information Technology solutions and strategies that enable operations and drive business value.


IT Client Services provides Tier 1-3 virtual and physical support to the organization's end users for software, hardware, digital employee experience management, conference room technology and meeting support, warehouse technology, server, network, and enterprise systems issues. Frequently responding to escalated issues from the IT Service Center, this group resolves user requests through discussions with users and coordination with internal and external resources and provides education and trainings to users to facilitate knowledge transfer and prevent problem reoccurrence. IT Client Services also maintains ownership for certain end user productivity platforms and capabilities, such as virtual environments and collaboration toolsets, and addresses service outages. This area acquires, installs and upgrades PC components and software, while also performing asset management for software and hardware.


Digital Employee Experience (DEX) Product Owner Role Summary

The Digital Employee Experience (DEX) Product Owner is responsible for leading the execution and value realization of Cardinal Health's Digital Employee Experience transformation roadmap. This role will serve as the business owner and strategic leader for a multi-year DEX program focused on improving employee productivity, reducing digital friction, modernizing IT service delivery, and enabling proactive employee experiences through data, automation, AI, and journey-based design.


The Digital Employee Experience (DEX) product owner role is responsible for ensuring Cardinal Health realizes the full value of its DEX tool investment. This product owner role is responsible for converting telemetry, sentiment, and operational insights into measurable business outcomes including improved employee productivity, lower support costs, optimized technology spending (i.e. tech refresh), and enhanced employee experiences.


The DEX Product Owner will function as both a strategic transformation leader and a traditional technical Product Owner, overseeing a team responsible for DEX analytics, experience campaigns, and value realization while managing the product backlog, change controls, and release governance with Client Engineering and support teams. This role will ensure DEX insights are translated into tested and approved remediation actions, coordinate the deployment of endpoint improvements through established change management processes, and lead the development and socialization of employee communications and targeted experience campaigns that drive adoption, awareness, and continuous improvement of the digital workplace experience.


Responsibilities:

  • Own and lead the Digital Employee Experience (DEX) roadmap, backlog, and governance processes, ensuring alignment to the organization's three-year transformation objectives and value realization targets.
  • Work with business and IT partners to drive the adoption of AI-enabled solutions, self-healing automation, and proactive support models.
  • Serve as the primary business owner for DEX platform capabilities.
  • Lead a dedicated team of DEX analysts and experience specialists responsible for monitoring endpoint telemetry, employee sentiment, and digital experience data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for proactive improvement.
  • Translate DEX insights into prioritized remediation initiatives and actionable workstreams for Client Engineering, End User Computing, Service Desk, Infrastructure, IT Solution Owner application support teams, IT Asset Management, and other operational support teams.
  • Serve as the technical Product Owner for DEX-driven enhancements by managing product backlogs, defining requirements, prioritizing fixes, and ensuring solutions align to business priorities and employee experience outcomes.
  • Partner with Client Engineering and technology teams to govern change controls, release management activities, testing strategies, and production deployments associated with DEX-recommended fixes and enhancements.
  • Ensure all DEX-driven remediation activities are thoroughly validated, tested, and approved through established change management and governance processes before deployment to the enterprise.
  • Develop and execute communication, adoption, and change management strategies for major endpoint updates, operating system changes, application enhancements, and proactive remediation campaigns that impact the employee experience.
  • Lead the creation and socialization of employee-facing communications that clearly articulate upcoming changes, expected benefits, business impacts, and recommended actions associated with DEX-driven improvements.
  • Drive targeted digital experience campaigns that educate employees, improve technology adoption, gather feedback, and continuously enhance employee productivity and satisfaction.
  • Establish closed-loop processes to ensure DEX insights are converted into actions, actions are measured for effectiveness, and outcomes are continuously incorporated into future prioritization and roadmap decisions.
  • Define, monitor, and report key performance indicators related to employee productivity, digital experience scores, service desk demand reduction, automation effectiveness, device performance, and technology investment optimization.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, preferred.
  • 7+ years of experience in DEX Product Management (Nexthink, TeamViewer, or other DEX tool), preferred
  • 3+ years of experience leading enterprise-wide programs or products that span multiple technology and business functions, preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing strategic roadmaps, product backlogs, and multi-year transformation initiatives, preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead large-scale initiatives through influence, collaboration, and stakeholder alignment without direct authority, preferred.
  • Experience translating business objectives into technical requirements, operational execution plans, and measurable outcomes, preferred.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present recommendations, roadmaps, and outcomes to senior leadership, and to work with the communications team to execute end user DEX communication campaigns, preferred.
  • Strong understanding of critical endpoint management performance metrics, and enterprise end user computing environments, preferred
  • Experience with ServiceNow management and workflow automations, preferred
  • Strong knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Outlook), preferred
  • Ability to travel at least 10-15% of time, if necessary

What is expected of you and others at this level

  • Ability to analyze complex datasets and present insights into a consumable format
  • Applies advanced knowledge and understanding of concepts, principles, and technical capabilities to manage a wide variety of projects
  • Participates in the development of policies and procedures
  • Works on or may lead complex projects of large scope
  • Projects may have significant and long-term impact
  • Provides solutions which may set precedent
  • Acts as a mentor to less experienced colleagues

Role: Client Support Specialist

Location: Remote (West Bengal, Gujarat, Maharashtra)

Working Hours: Eastern Standard Time (EST)

About MediaRadarMediaRadar is an innovative, fast-paced company providing best-in-class advertising intelligence solutions to media companies and advertising agencies across North America. Through a blend of advanced technology and data insights, MediaRadar helps ad sales teams close more deals, strengthen client relationships, and streamline sales efforts. We are committed to delivering outstanding customer service that supports our continued growth and the success of our clients.

Position Overview:

As a Client Support Specialist, you will be a key player in delivering exceptional service to MediaRadar's North American clients. You will handle technical support inquiries, troubleshoot issues, and ensure timely resolution. This role demands strong communication skills, technical acumen, and the ability to work efficiently in EST hours to support our North American client base.

Key Responsibilities

Client Support & Issue Resolution

  • Provide timely and accurate responses to customer inquiries and technical issues via email, chat, and phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical problems related to MediaRadar’s suite of products.
  • Ensure all support tickets are resolved in a timely manner, adhering to SLAs (Service Level Agreements).
  • Serve as the point of contact between clients and internal teams (Customer Success, Product, Engineering) to escalate and resolve complex issues.
  • Maintain clear and concise documentation of customer interactions and resolutions within the CRM (Salesforce.com).

Process Improvement & Client Experience

  • Identify recurring customer issues and collaborate with cross-functional teams to address root causes.
  • Document and update support processes to improve efficiency and customer satisfaction.
  • Gather and report customer feedback to the Product and Engineering teams for continuous product improvement.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with the North American Customer Success team to ensure a seamless client experience.
  • Communicate effectively with clients, providing updates and solutions on technical issues and product queries.
  • Participate in regular team meetings to stay aligned on ongoing client needs and support initiatives.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in a customer support role, preferably within a SaaS, technology, or ad-tech environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
  • Excellent communication skills in English (both written and verbal) with the ability to explain technical information clearly.
  • Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce and similar platforms.
  • Ability to work Eastern Standard Time (EST) hours to support North American clients.
  • Strong organizational skills with a customer-first mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with North American clients in a support or technical troubleshooting capacity.
  • Familiarity with the advertising technology or SaaS-based products.
  • Experience providing technical support for B2B clients and working in a fast-paced environment.

description: We are seeking a User Experience Designer to help design and improve digital experiences for Ford vehicle owners.

raw.title: User Experience Designer
raw.excerpt: We are seeking a User Experience Designer to help design and improve digital experiences for Ford vehicle owners.
raw.description:
We are seeking a User Experience Designer to help design and improve digital experiences for Ford vehicle owners. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content, Analytics, and Design partners to understand customer needs and turn them into clear, accessible experiences.

You’ll contribute throughout the design process—from exploring customer problems and developing concepts to prototyping, validation, delivery, and post-launch improvement. This role is a chance to take ownership of well-scoped design work, collaborate across disciplines, and continue developing your craft.

You’ll also use AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to support ideation, design exploration, and prototyping. You’ll be responsible for reviewing AI-assisted work for accuracy, accessibility, originality, brand fit, and customer usefulness, and for following guidance on approved tools and confidential information.

User Experience Design & Delivery

  • Design and refine Ford.com experiences that help Owners find vehicle information, understand features, access services, and stay connected with Ford.
  • Translate customer problems and product requirements into user journeys, flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished interface designs.
  • Explore design options, communicate trade-offs, and incorporate feedback from customers and cross-functional partners.
  • Create prototypes at the appropriate level of fidelity to test assumptions, gather feedback, and support design decisions.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to balance customer value, business goals, accessibility, and technical feasibility.
  • Use Ford’s design system and contribute to consistent, reusable patterns across Ford.com.
  • Support design delivery and collaborate with engineering partners to clarify design intent and implementation details.

Customer Research, Validation & Continuous Improvement

  • Help identify customer needs and experience opportunities using research, customer feedback, analytics, and cross-functional input.
  • Support usability testing and other evaluative activities, applying findings before and after launch.
  • Use customer feedback and performance data to assess how experiences are working and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Iterate on designs as new information, feedback, or requirements emerge.
  • Stay curious about evolving design practices and share useful learnings with the team.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Communicate design rationale through presentations, prototypes, and clear documentation.
  • Participate in design critiques, workshops, and planning with a collaborative, open-to-feedback mindset.
  • Build productive working relationships with Product, Engineering, Research, Content, Analytics, and Design partners.
  • Explain design concepts and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

AI-Assisted Design

  • Use approved AI-enabled tools to support design work, such as exploring concepts, organizing early ideas, developing prototype content, or streamlining repetitive tasks.
  • Review AI-assisted outputs for accuracy, accessibility, originality, brand fit, and customer usefulness.
  • Follow applicable guidance for approved tools and the handling of confidential information.

We recognize that no one person will embody every quality or skill listed below. If you’re excited about making Ford ownership more helpful and connected, and enjoy learning through collaboration and iteration, we encourage you to apply.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in UX, interaction design, product design, human-computer interaction, visual design, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.

Experience

  • Approximately 2–4 years of experience in UX, product, interaction, or digital design, including relevant internships or project work.
  • A portfolio demonstrating your design process and contributions to digital experiences, including how you framed problems, explored options, used feedback, and developed solutions.
  • Experience using a design and prototyping tool such as Figma.
  • Working knowledge of interaction design, visual design, information architecture, usability, and accessibility.
  • Ability to communicate design ideas and collaborate effectively across disciplines.
  • An iterative approach to feedback, learning, and changing requirements.

Required Design Experience

  • Ability to translate customer needs and product requirements into user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and interface designs.
  • Familiarity with usability and accessibility principles.
  • Ability to explain design decisions and incorporate feedback from customers and partners.
  • Ability to collaborate with Product and Engineering on design feasibility and delivery.
  • A portfolio that clearly describes your role and contributions to design work.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience designing responsive websites or e-commerce experiences.
  • Experience working with a design system or component library.
  • Familiarity with customer research, usability testing, web analytics, or experimentation.
  • Experience working on an Agile or cross-functional product team.
  • Interest in automotive, vehicle ownership, digital services, or helping customers navigate complex information.
  • Hands-on familiarity with AI-assisted design tools, with the judgment to validate outputs and recognize when human review is essential.
  • Familiarity with front-end concepts that support collaboration with engineers and understanding implementation trade-offs.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

  • Immediate medical, dental, and prescription drug coverage
  • Flexible family care, parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
  • Vehicle discount program for employees and family members, and management leases
  • Tuition assistance
  • Established and active employee resource groups
  • Paid time off for individual and team community service
  • A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day
  • Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

For a detailed look at our benefits, click here:Benefit Summary

This position is a salary grade 6 or 7and ranges from$85,400-$166,600.

Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value.

raw.title: Läkarstudent till Velora
raw.excerpt: Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens vård för personer med övervikt/obesitas?
raw.description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens vård för personer med övervikt/obesitas?

Bygg spetskompetens inom obesitasbehandling redan under studietiden. Velora är en digital specialistklinik för behandling av övervikt/obesitas med mål är att ingen ska behöva vara fast i ofrivillig övervikt. Med en kombination av modern forskning, teknik och ett holistiskt synsätt är vi på god väg. Vi söker nu dig som är läkarstudent till vårt växande team.

Utöver möjligheten att verkligen göra skillnad för en eftersatt patientgrupp erbjuder vi både möjlighet till arbete på distans och flexibla arbetstider. Vi tror på att nöjd personal är nyckeln till nöjda patienter. Veloras arbetsklimat präglas av framåtanda, arbetsglädje och gemenskap. Vi brinner för det vi gör och har stor yrkesstolthet kring den vård vi bedriver.

Uppdraget

Du ringer patienter som har avslutat sin behandling hos oss eller har valt att inte gå vidare med den. Du följer upp hur det har gått och svarar på frågor om behandlingen. Du hjälper också patienten att förstå vad viktnedgång och fortsatt behandling kan betyda för hälsan, till exempel för blodtryck, blodsocker, blodfetter, ledbesvär och sömn. Du tränar på att möta patienter i väldigt olika situationer och att föra samtal som kräver både kunskap och lyhördhet. Den information du samlar in använder vi när vi utvecklar vården.

Vem du är

Du är trygg och lyhörd i telefonsamtal och uttrycker dig varmt och tydligt, även i känsliga situationer. Du har god självinsikt, är strukturerad i din dokumentation och hanterar patientuppgifter med hög integritet. Du bidrar med energi och engagemang, och andra trivs med att samarbeta med dig.

Kvalifikationer

  • Du studerar på läkarprogrammet, gärna termin 6 eller senare

  • Du uttrycker dig obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift

  • Du är noggrann och strukturerad i din dokumentation

  • Du kan arbeta regelbundet under en längre period

Därför stärker detta din karriär
Obesitas är en av vår tids största folksjukdomar och berör nästan alla specialiteter, från allmänmedicin och internmedicin till kirurgi och psykiatri. Hos oss får du:

  • Fördjupad kunskap om modern obesitasbehandling, inklusive GLP-1-baserade läkemedel

  • Vana att föra svåra och känsliga samtal, en av de viktigaste färdigheterna i läkaryrket

  • Konkret erfarenhet av patientkommunikation som du kan sätta på ditt CV och ta med dig till BT och vidare

  • Insikt i hur digital vård fungerar i praktiken Referenser från en specialistklinik

Meriterande

  • Erfarenhet av svåra eller känsliga samtal.

  • Intresse för eller erfarenhet av arbete med personer med övervikt eller obesitas

Arbetstid & ersättning

Rollen kräver att du kan arbeta regelbundet, till exempel 2 timmar varannan dag eller 1 timme om dagen. Du väljer själv när du arbetar, vardagar mellan 10.00 och 20.00. Du får fast timlön med möjlighet till extra ersättning

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

Vi ser fram emot att träffa dig!

raw.description:
Senior Interim Leadership Associate

Work Location:

Remote - USA

Job Type:

Full timeTo advance the mission and purpose of InterVarsity as noted above, an Interim Leadership Senior Associate has significant spiritual leadership and pastoral supervisory responsibility. The Interim Leadership Senior Associate helps provide continuity of ministry and supervision, as needed, by serving in a campus leadership role on a temporary basis.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Personal Spiritual Duties

  • Be a maturing disciple of Jesus Christ: growing in love for God, God's Word, God's people of every ethnicity and culture, and God's purposes in the world.
    • Pursue a vibrant relationship with the triune God through engagement with Scripture, prayer, and worship, both individually and in community  
    • Exercise self-leadership (growing in self-awareness, self-management, relational integrity, and resiliency)
    • Embrace and practice Scriptural standards for behavior and attitudes, including those described in the Code of Conduct
    • Experience and live out an ongoing call to ministry service with InterVarsity and its mission

Ministry Leadership

  • Create a culture of dependence on God to gain vision for establishing and advancing witnessing communities that reach every corner of every campus among ministry team members
  • Assess reality of context and then develop and articulate a vision for qualitative and quantitative growth, particularly in conversions, disciples and leaders among ministry team members
  • Model InterVarsity’s missional vision and Core Values for supervisees
  • Assure that campus ministry is continuing without interruption by providing effective interim leadership
  • Lead an assigned ministry team to:
  • Grow as a community depending on God in prayer
  • Do strategic planning, decision making and policy making as assigned
  • Work projects which advance the ministry and strengthen the relationships of the team
  • Provide learning and training opportunities for the team
  • Partner effectively with all other organizational leaders to provide support for their efforts
  • If serving as a Regional Director or Divisional Director, the Senior Interim Ministry Associate is responsible for leading the regional or divisional team in setting vision and strategy, developing student training programs and opportunities, for the care and development of staff, and recruitment and placement of staff, depending on the parameters of their interim assignment
  • Participate with and be fully engaged with other Interim Ministry Associates:
  • Model mature leadership and solid partnership with the Director of Interim Ministry and other Interim Ministry Associates
  • Advance and strengthen campus ministry and to assure that it is in alignment with our purpose
  • Participation in regional and/or national issues or projects as assigned
  • Work with organizational leaders at all levels to:
  • Access and assist regional strategies for growth and accomplishment of the national mission such as planting and building ethnically diverse communities
  • Facilitate partnership and collaboration across regional lines and with senior leaders by building relationships, assisting with projects, and providing feedback for ministry team endeavors
  • Address team concerns and, when needed, facilitate a resolution
  • Provide assistance to national leaders, including but not limited to the Interim Ministry Director, through additional projects on a regular basis
  • Engage in ministry with students
  • Engage positively with the supervision you receive from your staff director

Pastoral Supervision (related to ministry assignment):

  • Model solid pastoral support and supervisory skills for your team
  • Provide for the ministry and professional training and development of your team

Provide coaching, strategic leadership and pastoral support to staff under your supervision in interim assignments

  • Oversee the supervision, leadership of ministry partnership development of your team
  • Provide ongoing feedback and evaluation of your team (including annual performance reviews as needed)
  • Work effectively with other senior leaders to build an effective partnership between your interim assignment team and Advancement and other InterVarsity Field Ministries

Administration:

  • Promote partnership among the National Service Center, the ministry departments and the field
  • Ensure adherence to national policies, procedures, and reporting requirements

Fund Development and Public Relations:

  • Ensure sound financial status of the Interim Ministry Program through adherence to national fund development guidelines
  • Secure personal financial and prayer support
  • Raise funds to underwrite launching and training of the interim ministry program.
  • Serve as an ambassador of InterVarsity to individual donors, church groups, etc. through prayer, discussion of ministry, mission and accomplishments
  • Accept speaking engagements
  • Represent InterVarsity within the wider Christian community

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Annually affirm InterVarsity’s Statement of Agreement (Doctrinal Basis and Purpose Statement). Abide by InterVarsity’s Code of Conduct. Believe and behave consonantly with InterVarsity’s Human Sexuality Theological Paper. Affirm and behave consonantly with InterVarsity’s “Women in Ministry Statement of Affirmation”. Ongoing call to InterVarsity and its mission.
  • Bachelor's degree required; graduate degree preferred
  • Prior experience with InterVarsity strongly preferred
  • Prior experience at the Divisional Director position or above (or the equivalent in outside organizations)
  • At least 5 years experience supervising teams, people development, and coaching strongly preferred
  • Strong ministry skills (including the ability to communicate spiritual vision, teach spiritual and biblical principles, plan ministry programs, and spiritually disciple, coach and mentor)
  • Proven ability to work well with others and the ability to develop a team of campus ministers.
  • Affirmation of ongoing call to ministry service with InterVarsity and its mission
  • Strong interpersonal skills (including ability to minister to diverse ethnic communities and faculty)  
  • Evidence the characteristics of a life-long learner
  • Experience in management and people development.
  • Willing to receive ongoing training
  • Ability to contribute to an open and supportive relationship with team members
  • Strong interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability and commitment to work in a diverse team environment
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and conflict resolution/mediation skills
  • Ability to organize events and manage the details involved
  • Detail and task orientation
  • Ability to take charge of teams and tasks; work independently without close supervision
  • Ongoing call to InterVarsity and its mission
Pay Range: $63,672.00 - $84,888.00 per year

Pay: This position is funded through personal fundraising. Accordingly, compensation will vary based on the ability of the individual to secure a donor team to fund the cost of his/her salary. The anticipated salary range for this position on a full-time basis (40 hours/week) is dependent on a variety of factors, including location and cost of living. The actual salary received,including any geographic adjustment to account for location and cost of living, is subject to the individual’s ability to raise funds necessary to cover the full amount of such salary within the range set forth in the job posting details.

Benefits:

We offer a competitive benefits package, including health care and retirement savings with a match. Eligibility is based on employee type and hours worked. Benefits include the following:

  • 403(b) Retirement Savings Plan

  • 403(b) matching contributions

  • Dental insurance

  • Employee assistance program

  • Employee discounts

  • Flexible work schedule

  • Flexible spending accounts

  • Health insurance

  • Health savings account

  • Life insurance

  • Paid time off

  • Parental leave

  • Professional development assistance

  • Vision insurance

Equal Employment Opportunity:

InterVarsity Christian Fellowship/USA is both an equal opportunity employer and a faith-based religious organization. We conduct hiring without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, sex, marital status, parental status, membership in any labor organization, political ideology, or disability of an otherwise qualified individual. The status of InterVarsity Christian Fellowship/USA as an equal opportunity employer does not prevent the organization from hiring staff based on their religious beliefs so that all staff share the same religious commitment.  Pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e 1(a)) InterVarsity Christian Fellowship/USA has the right to, and does, hire only candidates who agree with InterVarsity’s Statement of Agreement: Purpose and Doctrinal Basisbecause InterVarsity believes that each and every staff plays a vital role in advancing InterVarsity’s mission and purposes.

"De zin van het zorgen, zit in de zin om te zorgen"

Het is de lijfspreuk van Zeno, maar het is vooral een belofte! Aan onszelf. Aan de zorgprofessionals die bij ons werken. Aan de zorginstellingen waarmee we samenwerken. En aan de mensen die we ondersteunen op het gebied van gehandicaptenzorg, GGZ, jeugdzorg, ouderenzorg. Hen geven we een Z'tje in de rug. De Z van Zeno.

Wij willen passie, persoonlijke aandacht en deskundigheid vanzelfsprekend maken in de zorg. Dat doen we door kwalitatief hoogwaardige ondersteuning te bieden, met een team van ruim 1000 zorgprofessionals die verschillende specialisaties hebben, maar ook dezelfde zin om te zorgen. We bieden flexibele oplossingen bij roosterverstoringen, maatwerk bij complexe zorgvragen op cliënt- of groepsniveau en unieke thuisbegeleiding via Zeno Ambulant.

Zeno. Zin om te zorgen.

Over de vacature

Werkplek: Nederland

Dienstverband: 30 tot 40 uur

Opleidingsniveau: MBO 4

Wat bieden wij?

Kort of lang. Ad hoc of structureel. Complexe of reguliere zorg. Wij bieden kwalitatieve zorgprofessionals met zin om te zorgen in de gehandicaptenzorg, GGZ, jeugdzorg en ouderenzorg.

Zin om te zorgen als zelfstandige?

Meer regie over je eigen tijd. En daardoor meer energie en plezier in je werk. Als zelfstandige bij Zeno bepaal je zelf op welke dagen en tijden je wilt werken. Hoe chill is dat? Overtuig ons ervan dat je een goede toevoeging bent voor ons team. Interesse? Meld je nu aan via de onderstaande button. Laat ons zien hoe proactief je bent!

Requirements

Job Title: Services Engagement Manager - Development Cloud

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

The Services Engagement Manager is an experienced, results-driven professional to drive the strategy, positioning, and delivery model for Veeva’s Professional Services. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to both internal teams and external executive leadership—helping life sciences organizations understand the value of partnering with Veeva to achieve their business objectives. You will own the end-to-end engagement design, collaborate across functions, and drive a high-volume pipeline with precision, velocity, and diplomacy.
With a passion for Software Implementation and (preferred) expertise in Life Sciences/Healthcare/IT sales cycles, you’ll draft and deliver RFx Responses, Proposals, and Statements of Work, driving alignment with internal cross-functional subject matter experts and customer leadership.
This is a remote, full-time permanent role with Veeva. This is a customer-facing role and we have no work location requirement if you are in close proximity to an airport and able to meet potential travel requirements when they arise.

What You'll Do

    • Selling Value of Veeva Services: Educate customers on methodology and the value of Veeva’s Professional Services - why should they want to work with us? Set appropriate expectations of what we can/should/won’t do
    • Engagement Design: Define and prescribe the best Professional Services model for a given customer, based on an in-depth understanding of their needs and business objectives, through Proposals, Statements of Work, and RFx responses
    • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional stakeholders across sales, strategy, services, business consulting, solutions consulting, and others to ensure optimal engagement approach and positioning
    • Operational Excellence: Take strong ownership of a high-volume pipeline through consistent execution, a sense of urgency/speed, flawless data management, and appropriate stakeholder communication (from internal Associates to external C-Suite)
    • Leadership Through Influence: Provide thought partnership to the broader business and drive meaningful results without a direct reporting structure; embrace creative conflict with diplomacy and humility

Requirements

    • 3+ years of experience delivering software implementation and enhancement projects (Program Manager, Project Manager, Functional/Business Analyst, Practice Manager, etc.)
    • 1+ years of experience scoping/defining project plans, resource models, and negotiation of Statements of Work for software implementation projects a plus
    • Background in Life Sciences, Health Care, or Tech preferred; Experience working with Clinical Operations, Pharmacovigilance, or Regulatory Information Management (RIM) software applications a plus
    • A problem-solving and customer services-oriented mentality to drive the positioning and sales of professional services; Consulting, Tech Sales, and Program/Project Management experience
    • Remote role based in North America, with ability to work across time zones and travel when required (~10-15%)

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $85,000 - $170,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at .

The Team:

We are Datadog's in-house product experts. The technical solutions team enables Datadog's worldwide growth by educating potential clients and ensuring that existing customers are happy and successful. We share our technical and product expertise with customers through demos, presentations, technical evaluations, and ongoing support. Technical solutions is a growing global team that collaborates constantly to share knowledge and continuously advance our technical skillset.

The Opportunity:

The Partner Solution Architect (PSA) is a Datadog expert who will work closely with Datadog’s Director, Adoption Services, and is aligned to our Channels & Alliances business segment. The PSA is responsible for supporting a variety of technical initiatives and activities for our partners (for example: cloud migration, application modernization, DevOps transformation). They are accountable for the outcome of these initiatives, and frequently collaborate with both Datadog and Partner resources to drive success. The PSA is a trusted technical advisor for our Partner channel.

You Will:

  • Ensure the successful onboarding, training, enablement, and certification of partner technical resources;
  • Participate in periodic joint business planning and review sessions to ensure direct alignment between Datadog and Partner technical teams;
  • Collaborate internally to support Partner technical initiatives such as end-customer demonstrations and proofs of value; partner team enablement workshops; assessment, advice, and coaching on lead practices;
  • Advocate on behalf of Partners’ technical concerns (use cases, feature requests, support issues, e.g.) with Datadog internal teams and personnel, helping to bring those concerns to resolution;
  • Analyze and understand Partner service offerings on a regular basis and provide recommendations to enhance the value of those services through greater or improved adoption of Datadog features and capabilities;
  • Collaborate with Datadog’s product management, engineering and technical services teams to help identify and prioritize new features and capabilities;
  • Continuously help curate and evolve lead/best practices for Datadog platform adoption and success.

You Are:

  • Possess a solid technical grounding with hands-on experience of IT Development and/or Operations;
  • A demonstrable track-record and never-ending passion for learning;
  • A self-starter, tech-savvy professional with solid business acumen; ability to articulate Datadog value from server room to boardroom;
  • Confident presentation skills;
  • Must be a current EU resident
  • Desired hands-on experience in two or more of the following areas:
    • Observability: Datadog, Splunk, AppD, New Relic or Dynatrace
    • Public Cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP, or Alibaba
    • Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Cloud Foundry
    • Dev/Scripting: Python, Javascript, Ruby, Perl, PHP, Go
    • Config Mgmt: Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, Chef
    • CI / CD: Jenkins, Gitlab

Bonus Points:

  • Previous experience working in a technical role for or supporting channel partners (Systems Integrators, Managed Services Providers, e.g.);
  • Previous experience using Datadog and/or other cloud monitoring tools (APM, Infrastructure, Logs, Synthetics, NPM);
  • Previous experience with root-cause-analysis, troubleshooting, debugging

Why You Should Apply:

  • Generous and competitive global and US benefits
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan
  • Continuous career development and pathing opportunities
  • Product training to develop an in-depth understanding of our product and space
  • Best in breed onboarding
  • Internal mentor and buddy program cross-departmentally

About Datadog:

Datadog is the monitoring and security platform for cloud applications. Our SaaS product is used by organizations of all sizes across a wide range of industries to enable digital transformation, cloud migration, and infrastructure monitoring of our customers’ entire technology stack, allowing for seamless collaboration and problem-solving among Dev, Ops and Security teams globally. Given the resilience of cloud technologies and importance placed today in digital operations and agility, Datadog continues to innovate and is well positioned for the long term.

About Datadog:

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

raw.description:
Vollzeit | Remote möglich | 4.700–5.800 Euro brutto pro Monat

Ein Kunde möchte einen Ablauf automatisieren. Bevor unsere Entwickler loslegen, muss klar sein, wie der Prozess heute funktioniert, was sich verbessern soll und woran wir eine gute Lösung erkennen. Bei Flow Factor übernimmst du diese Klärung gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden.

Du arbeitest direkt mit unseren Kunden und unserem Entwicklungsteam. Wir unterstützen mittelständische Unternehmen im deutschsprachigen Raum bei der Prozessautomatisierung und beim Einsatz von KI. Deine Aufgabe ist es, aus Kundenwünschen konkrete, abgestimmte Anforderungen zu machen und die Umsetzung fachlich zu begleiten.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst Gespräche und Workshops mit Kunden, um Ziele, Abläufe und Probleme zu verstehen.

  • Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse, beteiligte Systeme und Datenflüsse und schlägst praktikable Verbesserungen vor.

  • Du formulierst Anforderungen, stimmst die Prioritäten mit dem Kunden und dem Entwicklungsteam ab und hältst Umfang sowie Abnahmekriterien fest.

  • Du besprichst die Anforderungen mit unseren Entwicklern, klärst fachliche Rückfragen und bewertest gemeinsam mit ihnen die Umsetzbarkeit.

  • Du machst Auswirkungen von Änderungswünschen transparent und sorgst dafür, dass Entscheidungen dokumentiert werden.

  • Du begleitest die Umsetzung, prüfst Ergebnisse und führst Kunden durch Demonstrationen und fachliche Abnahmen.

Requirements

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast bereits Anforderungen in IT- oder Digitalisierungsprojekten aufgenommen und mit einem Umsetzungsteam abgestimmt – etwa als Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer, IT-Berater oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle.

  • Du kannst Kundengespräche strukturieren und auch unklare oder widersprüchliche Wünsche so klären, dass daraus umsetzbare Aufgaben werden.

  • Du verstehst betriebliche Abläufe und kannst dich in Software, Schnittstellen und Datenflüsse einarbeiten.

  • Du dokumentierst präzise und kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch mit fachlichen Ansprechpartnern und Entwicklern.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, sprichst Unklarheiten früh an und hältst Absprachen nach.

Erfahrung mit Prozessautomatisierung oder KI-Anwendungen ist hilfreich. Die technische Architektur entwickelst du gemeinsam mit unserem Entwicklungsteam. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der fachlichen Klärung und der Zusammenarbeit mit dem Kunden.

Das erwartet dich

  • 4.700–5.800 Euro brutto pro Monat in Vollzeit.

  • Die Möglichkeit, remote zu arbeiten; unser Standort ist Grevenbroich.

  • Direkten Austausch mit Kunden und kurze Wege zu den Entwicklern.

  • Eigene Verantwortung für die fachliche Betreuung von Kundenprojekten in einem kleinen Team.

  • Projekte, bei denen du von der ersten Analyse bis zur Abnahme mitwirkst.

Du möchtest Kunden beraten und dafür sorgen, dass Entwickler mit klaren Anforderungen arbeiten können? Dann bewirb dich über das Bewerbungsformular. Besonders interessiert uns, welche Rolle du bisher in Kunden- oder IT-Projekten übernommen hast.

raw.description:
Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence, helping decision makers and operators navigate what’s happening now and shape what’s coming next. Vantor is a place for problem solvers, changemakers, and go-getters—where people are working together to help our customers see the world differently, and in doing so, be seen differently. Come be part of a mission, not just a job, where you can: Shape your own future, build the next big thing, and change the world.

Please review the job details below.

Vantor is seeking an experienced GEOINT Analyst / Pattern Analysis Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support intelligence, operational planning, and decision-making efforts in GCC. The successful candidate will leverage geospatial intelligence (GEOINT), remote sensing, and pattern analysis methodologies to assess activities, identify trends, and provide actionable intelligence in support of military operations and strategic objectives.

The GEOINT Analyst will analyze satellite imagery, aerial photography, geospatial datasets, and other intelligence sources to identify patterns of life, assess threats, monitor operational environments, and support mission planning. This position requires advanced analytical skills, expertise in geospatial technologies, and the ability to produce high-quality intelligence products for senior military and government stakeholders.

Working Conditions:

  • Position based in GCC.
  • May require periodic travel within the region.
  • Ability to support mission requirements in dynamic operational and military environments.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct geospatial intelligence (GEOINT) analysis in support of military operations, security assessments, and strategic planning activities.
  • Analyze satellite imagery, aerial photography, full-motion video, and other geospatial data sources to identify significant activities, trends, and anomalies.
  • Perform pattern-of-life and pattern analysis to support intelligence collection, targeting, threat assessments, and operational planning.
  • Develop geospatial products, maps, overlays, briefings, and intelligence reports for operational and strategic decision-makers.
  • Integrate geospatial intelligence with multiple intelligence disciplines to provide comprehensive assessments.
  • Conduct predictive geospatial analysis using advanced applications and workflows
  • Evaluate infrastructure, terrain, transportation networks, military installations, and other geographic features relevant to mission requirements.
  • Monitor emerging developments and provide timely assessments of activities impacting regional security and military operations.
  • Support contingency planning, mission analysis, and operational readiness efforts.
  • Present findings and brief intelligence assessments to senior military, government, and organizational leadership.
  • Maintain proficiency with geospatial tools, imagery exploitation techniques, and intelligence methodologies.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Geospatial Intelligence, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Geography, Data Science, Remote Sensing, or a related field.
  • Minimum 8 years of relevant professional experience in geospatial intelligence, imagery analysis, geographic information systems, or related disciplines.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience conducting GEOINT analysis in support of military operations.
  • Demonstrated expertise in imagery interpretation, geospatial analysis, and pattern analysis methodologies.

raw.excerpt: For over 35 years, Youth Villages has transformed the lives of children and families nationwide through innovative, research-based programs focused on preserving and restoring families.
raw.description:
For over 35 years, Youth Villages has transformed the lives of children and families nationwide through innovative, research-based programs focused on preserving and restoring families.

As a national leader in children’s mental and behavioral health, we serve more than 47,000 youth, young people, and their families annually across 29 states and Washington, D.C. Our proven treatment models drive long-term success in child welfare, juvenile justice, and mental health systems. At Youth Villages, we do what works — partnering with others to expand our impact and advocate for meaningful, lasting change.

We're seeking purpose-driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference. With a dedicated team of more than 5,000 staff, Youth Villages is committed to investing in and supporting our employees by offering opportunities to build a fulfilling career through professional growth, personal development, and a mission that matters— helping children and families live successfully.

For more information, please visit

Position Overview:

Youth Villages is seeking a strategic, highly organized Senior Evaluation Manager for Sponsored Research to lead complex evaluation initiatives that support program improvement, service expansion, and child welfare system change. Reporting to the Director of Research, the person in this role will provide scientific and project leadership for evaluations conducted in partnership with external researchers, ensuring that studies address meaningful organizational questions, use rigorous and appropriate methods, and produce findings that can inform implementation, scaling, practice, and policy.

The Senior Evaluation Manager for Sponsored Research will serve as Youth Villages’ primary liaison with external evaluation partners as part of one or more externally funded projects and will integrate evidence across evaluations, administrative data analyses, implementation findings, and other sources. A key responsibility will be synthesizing this evidence into comprehensive products that explain what is changing, how strategies are being implemented, whether expected results are occurring, and what can be learned to strengthen future efforts.

This is a remote position, with occasional travel required for meetings, presentations, conferences, and other dissemination activities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:


I. Provide Strategic and Scientific Leadership for Evaluation

  • Develop and manage evaluation learning agendas that identify priority questions, evidence needs, measurement strategies, and major milestones.
  • Ensure evaluations address specific strategic, programmatic, implementation, practice, or policy questions.
  • Provide scientific guidance on evaluation design, measurement, quantitative and qualitative methods, analytic approaches, and interpretation.
  • Critically evaluate methodological approaches, assumptions, findings, and limitations and facilitate resolution of methodological questions with research partners.
  • Ensure evaluation partners have the programmatic, operational, organizational, and system context needed to design studies and appropriately interpret findings.
  • Identify emerging evaluation needs and work with partners to refine research questions, measures, and analytic approaches as findings and priorities evolve.

II. Lead Sponsored Evaluation Partnerships and Projects

  • Serve as Youth Villages’ primary liaison with the external evaluator for the Intercept Scaling and Practice/Policy Change investment.
  • Coordinate evaluation activities across Youth Villages teams, external evaluators, research partners, and other collaborators.
  • Manage project plans, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, responsibilities, decisions, and communications across multiple evaluation workstreams.
  • Ensure partners receive timely feedback, decisions, contextual information, data coordination, and access to appropriate Youth Villages staff and stakeholders.
  • Maintain clear documentation of research questions, methodological decisions, findings, open questions, and next steps.
  • Proactively identify competing priorities, barriers, and delays and assess implications for commitments, staffing, budgets, and timelines.
  • Lead regular partnership check-ins and contribute to assessment of partnership effectiveness and progress toward shared goals.

III. Integrate Evidence Across Sources

  • Integrate findings across evaluation studies, administrative data analyses, implementation measures, qualitative research, and other evidence sources to develop a comprehensive understanding of progress and outcomes.
  • Coordinate with colleagues leading complementary research and evidence-building initiatives to align questions, measures, timelines, and interpretation where work intersects.
  • Examine evidence across multiple levels, including implementation, program outcomes, organizational and system change, and broader child welfare outcomes.
  • Help distinguish whether unexpected findings may reflect the strategy itself, implementation, underlying assumptions, measurement, or contextual factors.
  • Identify areas of convergence, inconsistency, and remaining uncertainty across evidence sources and work with research partners to determine appropriate next questions.
  • Lead development of integrated evaluation products that synthesize findings across research partners and data sources.

IV. Translate Evidence into Organizational Learning and Action

  • Help teams use evaluation findings to assess whether strategies should be continued, strengthened, adapted, or reconsidered.
  • Translate findings into clear implications for implementation, scaling, program improvement, practice, policy, and future research.
  • Develop presentations, executive summaries, reports, and other evidence products for leadership, practitioners, funders, public-system partners, and other non-technical audiences.
  • Coordinate interpretation and dissemination of findings across research partners and Youth Villages teams, collaborating with Communications and other teams as appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities to synthesize lessons across projects and contribute to broader organizational learning about effective implementation and scaling.

Qualifications:

  • Doctorate in psychology, public policy, public administration, social work, epidemiology, or a related social or behavioral science field is required, with 5+ years of relevant experience.
  • Strong knowledge of research design, quantitative methods, program evaluation, and qualitative or mixed-methods research is required.
  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate research methods, measurement strategies, analytic approaches, and the strength and limitations of evidence is required.

"De zin van het zorgen, zit in de zin om te zorgen"

Het is de lijfspreuk van Zeno, maar het is vooral een belofte! Aan onszelf. Aan de zorgprofessionals die bij ons werken. Aan de zorginstellingen waarmee we samenwerken. En aan de mensen die we ondersteunen op het gebied van gehandicaptenzorg, GGZ, jeugdzorg, ouderenzorg. Hen geven we een Z'tje in de rug. De Z van Zeno.

Wij willen passie, persoonlijke aandacht en deskundigheid vanzelfsprekend maken in de zorg. Dat doen we door kwalitatief hoogwaardige ondersteuning te bieden, met een team van ruim 1000 zorgprofessionals die verschillende specialisaties hebben, maar ook dezelfde zin om te zorgen. We bieden flexibele oplossingen bij roosterverstoringen, maatwerk bij complexe zorgvragen op cliënt- of groepsniveau en unieke thuisbegeleiding via Zeno Ambulant.

Zeno. Zin om te zorgen.

Over de vacature

Werkplek: Nederland

Dienstverband: 30 tot 40 uur

Opleidingsniveau: MBO 4

Wat bieden wij?

Kort of lang. Ad hoc of structureel. Complexe of reguliere zorg. Wij bieden kwalitatieve zorgprofessionals met zin om te zorgen in de gehandicaptenzorg, GGZ, jeugdzorg en ouderenzorg.

Zin om te zorgen als zelfstandige?

Meer regie over je eigen tijd. En daardoor meer energie en plezier in je werk. Als zelfstandige bij Zeno bepaal je zelf op welke dagen en tijden je wilt werken. Hoe chill is dat? Overtuig ons ervan dat je een goede toevoeging bent voor ons team. Interesse? Meld je nu aan via de onderstaande button. Laat ons zien hoe proactief je bent!

Requirements

Vind jij jezelf een op-en-top zorgprofessional met oprechte passie voor de zorg? Kun jij daarnaast sensitief aansluiten en bezit je over een flinke portie lef? Oftewel, sta jij je mannetje of vrouwtje en wil je écht het verschil maken in de zorg? Heb jij een gerichte afgeronde zorgopleiding en minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in loondienst bij een zorgorganisatie? Dan gaan we heel graag met je in gesprek!

Aanmeldproces Zeno

Een EVC-traject doorlopen? Alleen wanneer je ervaringscertificaat is omgezet naar een diploma kunnen wij je aanmelding in ontvangst nemen. KvK-inschrijving alleen met SBI codes beginnend met 86, 87 en/of 88.

Ben jij klaar om deze uitdagende rol op je te nemen?

Je kan je aanmelden via onderstaande button. Heb je vragen?

raw.description:
Job Title: Services Engagement Manager - Development Cloud

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

The Services Engagement Manager is an experienced, results-driven professional to drive the strategy, positioning, and delivery model for Veeva’s Professional Services. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to both internal teams and external executive leadership—helping life sciences organizations understand the value of partnering with Veeva to achieve their business objectives. You will own the end-to-end engagement design, collaborate across functions, and drive a high-volume pipeline with precision, velocity, and diplomacy.
With a passion for Software Implementation and (preferred) expertise in Life Sciences/Healthcare/IT sales cycles, you’ll draft and deliver RFx Responses, Proposals, and Statements of Work, driving alignment with internal cross-functional subject matter experts and customer leadership.
This is a remote, full-time permanent role with Veeva. This is a customer-facing role and we have no work location requirement if you are in close proximity to an airport and able to meet potential travel requirements when they arise.

What You'll Do

    • Selling Value of Veeva Services: Educate customers on methodology and the value of Veeva’s Professional Services - why should they want to work with us? Set appropriate expectations of what we can/should/won’t do
    • Engagement Design: Define and prescribe the best Professional Services model for a given customer, based on an in-depth understanding of their needs and business objectives, through Proposals, Statements of Work, and RFx responses
    • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional stakeholders across sales, strategy, services, business consulting, solutions consulting, and others to ensure optimal engagement approach and positioning
    • Operational Excellence: Take strong ownership of a high-volume pipeline through consistent execution, a sense of urgency/speed, flawless data management, and appropriate stakeholder communication (from internal Associates to external C-Suite)
    • Leadership Through Influence: Provide thought partnership to the broader business and drive meaningful results without a direct reporting structure; embrace creative conflict with diplomacy and humility

Requirements

    • 3+ years of experience delivering software implementation and enhancement projects (Program Manager, Project Manager, Functional/Business Analyst, Practice Manager, etc.)
    • 1+ years of experience scoping/defining project plans, resource models, and negotiation of Statements of Work for software implementation projects a plus
    • Background in Life Sciences, Health Care, or Tech preferred; Experience working with Clinical Operations, Pharmacovigilance, or Regulatory Information Management (RIM) software applications a plus
    • A problem-solving and customer services-oriented mentality to drive the positioning and sales of professional services; Consulting, Tech Sales, and Program/Project Management experience
    • Remote role based in North America, with ability to work across time zones and travel when required (~10-15%)

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $85,000 - $170,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at .
